articleTitle: H/sub /spl infin//-PID controller parameter tuning via genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The parameter tuning of H/sub /spl infin//-PID controller is presented, the model of the controller is illustrated, and the characteristics are analyzed. The parameter-uncertain systems are made into the standard H/sub /spl infin// control systems obtained by the H/sub /spl infin//-PID output-feedback method. The parameter tuning of H/sub /spl infin//-PID controller via genetic algorithms is obtained. It is shown that general plants can effectively be controlled by this method.

articleTitle: The AI software's exploitation of coal preparation using CAD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Together with characteristics of coal preparation, the article utilizes a tool provided by AUTOCAD R14 for Windows, which uses AUTOLISP language and a dialog control language. It is made up of the beginning of a drawing environment module, a standard equipment graphic module, dim module, and process flow chart calculating and autodrawing module. This software and chart has characters, such as parameter inputting through DCL, three-dimension drawing program, artificial intelligence of dim, preferences drawing and moving together three views etc.

articleTitle: Simplified dynamical neuro-fuzzy network controller and application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The authors previously presented a dynamical neuro-fuzzy network (DFNN). Based on the forward neuro-fuzzy network ANFIS, it combines the advantages of fuzzy system, neural network and PID algorithm by adding a recurrent layer between the normalized layer and output layer of ANFIS. This paper simplified the structure of DFNN and a simplified dynamical fuzzy neural network (SDFNN) is proposed. SDFNN adopts only one recurrent neuron in recurrent layer by connection to the outputs of fuzzy zero rules, so a kind of PID controller is realized by SDFNN. The simulation results show SDFNN has the quick response as ANFIS does but possess the higher performance accuracy than ANFIS.

articleTitle: Robust nonlinear MPC based on simplified second-order Volterra series model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A robust nonlinear MPC was proposed for a class of nonlinear systems that can be modeled by a second-order Volterra series model with parametric uncertainty in the time domain, based on a simplified second-order Volterra series model. Sufficient conditions were developed for the robust stability of the closed-loop system. Compared with MPC using the regular second-order Volterra series model, computation burden is highly decreased without the cost of much performance degradation. To prove the conclusion, a local form of small gain theorem for discrete-time Volterra series systems was proposed. A case study of a chemical reactor was presented to show the effectiveness of the controller proposed.

articleTitle: The iterative learning control and convergence analysis for nonlinear industrial process control systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the paper, based on hierarchical control structure in steady-state optimization of industrial processes and iterative learning control law for linear industrial process control systems, the iterative learning control is applied to saturated nonlinear industrial control systems and nonlinear industrial control systems with changing gains. The weighted PD-type closed-loop iterative learning control algorithm and weighted power-type open-closed-loop iterative learning algorithm are discussed respectively. The definitions of /spl delta/-reachability of objective trajectory and /spl epsi/-convergence of the iterative learning control algorithm are suggested. By means of Bellman-Gronwall inequality and /spl lambda/-norm theory, the convergence of the algorithms is also proved. The numerical simulation shows that the iterative learning control can remarkably improve the dynamic performance of industrial control systems in steady-state optimization.

articleTitle: An adaptive predictive control algorithm based on Hammerstein models
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An approximate Hammerstein model of a nonlinear system expanded as an infinite Laguerre series and an adaptive predictive control algorithm based on it are presented. With the character of non-structure and good approximation of time delay, the model has the ability to approximate to the unknown system. It is shown by simulations that the algorithm makes the control system to be robust for the variation of time delay, system-order and nonlinear character.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control of multivariable systems based on fuzzy dynamic model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A fuzzy control system for multivariable complex nonlinear systems is presented, which is based on a fuzzy dynamic model. Firstly, the fuzzy state feedback control law is designed for each local linear model and the control law for the overall system is determined through fuzzy inference. A set of local linear models are linked together by a fuzzy membership function to obtain the continuous global model. By considering the fuzzy system as a set of nominal linear systems subject to perturbations contributed by other interacting subsystems, a sufficient condition for the stability of the closed-loop fuzzy system is derived via the concept of connective stability in decentralized control of a large-scale system. The validity of the fuzzy model based control technique is illustrated by a simulation example.

articleTitle: The design and realization of real-time control sub-system in the multi-level trial command decide network system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper introduces the structure, work mode and real-time control function of the the multi-level trial command decide network system (ML-TCDNS). In detail, it mostly discusses, the ML-TCDNS's realizable mechanism which includes such technology as clock setup, message control etc.

articleTitle: One method of translating the fuzzy rules into neural network of the fault diagnosis system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the analysis of fuzzy rules and the certainty factor transitive algorithm of the fault diagnosis system, one method of translating the fuzzy rules into an artificial neural network is researched. According to the fuzzy rules and its certainty factor transitive algorithm, the teacher samples of the neural network can be obtained. The weights and thresholds matrix of the neural network can be obtained by samples learning, so the new fault samples can be diagnosed. According to the diagnosis result obtained from the testing samples, this method can diagnose rapidly, it also has strong generalization ability and high accuracy, at the same time the method can eliminate the conflict in the reasoning process.

articleTitle: Motion control of robot manipulators under sensor failure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In a robot control system there are dynamics and sensor faults, modeling errors, and system and measurement noises. This paper addresses several techniques to control the robot manipulator under the uncertainty model and sensor failure. First, a neural network is proposed to control the robot to follow the generated path. This network model is able to compensate the structured and unstructured dynamic uncertainties of the robot by using both online and off-line training. The PD controller, computed torque controller and adaptive controller with and without exact model are used to control the robot and compared with the proposed method. Next, a residual generator for detection and isolation of the sensor failure is designed. Assuming one fault at a time, the proposed method can detect and isolate the fault sensor. The simulation study based on a 2-DOF planar robot is included.

articleTitle: Robust decentralized control for a class of uncertain interconnected systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The problem of robust decentralized control for a class of uncertain interconnected systems is investigated. The proposed continuous state feedback controllers ensure the global exponential stability of the closed loop system. Finally, an example is presented to illustrate the results given in the paper and simulation shows that the method is very effective.

articleTitle: Optimal control policy of an unreliable manufacturing system with setup time
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper describes the optimal control policy of a partial flexible manufacturing system with random demand. The system considered involves an unreliable machine that can produce two different types of product. The switch-over from one type to the other incurs an non-negligible time. The case study on this paper shows the optimal control policy is of a switching curve control. We can then induces a suboptimal control policy-hedging point control.

articleTitle: A kind of NN form presentation and disposal of experience control rule
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A neural network rules control method based on artificial experience for a complex control system is discussed. A direct organized, simple and effective 6 layers NN expressing and disposing form is presented, which gets rid of the shortcomings of the conventional BPNN.

articleTitle: Variable structure control of distributed vibration systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, author present the theory and methodology of sliding mode-variable structure control of the distributed vibration systems, including the control design at the modal state space and robustness conditions, a discussion on independent modal space control (IMSC) with sliding mode control strategy, etc. The methodology presented in the paper will open a new way for the active robust control of distributed vibration systems.

articleTitle: The performance analysis of leaky bucket algorithm with Markov-modulated Bernoulli process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In ATM networks, the time axis is divided into equal intervals called time slots, so most references assume that the Markov chain makes a transition from state i to state j in the boundary of time slots in view of Markov-modulated Bernoulli process (MMBP). This paper considers a more general situation, i.e., the Markov chain makes a transition from state i to state j in the boundary of frames whose length are an integral multiple of length of one time slot. Under this MMBP model, the paper develops a four-dimensional discrete-time Markov chain, and obtains results of the performance analysis of leaky bucket algorithms.

articleTitle: Robust stability of Lurie-type uncertain control systems with delays
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The robust stability of Lurie-type uncertain control systems with multiple time-varying delays is discussed. Based on Razumikhin's technique, delay-dependent and delay-independent criteria are provided to guarantee the robust absolutely stability of such systems.

articleTitle: HDL program design style and skill in LSI control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: When using the HDL for the design of LSI control circuit, due to the limiting factors such as the language syntax, synthesis tools and circuit constraints, and in the absence of the system algorithm, the language structure will vary when modeling the different devices or circuits, even for modeling the same device or circuit under different constraints. For this reason, this paper propose the concept of the design style and skill, and also explains this concept using the practical Verilog HDL model.

articleTitle: A design of virtual realizing for enterprise's CIPS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper introduces properties and construction of CIPS and put out a design of virtual realizing for CIPS. The aim of virtual CIPS is to provide with a powerfully supporting technology, so as to make an enterprise be able to adapt agilely to environment changes, decide quickly and produce efficiently.

articleTitle: Neural network for roller gap setup in rolling steel mill
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper the methods to control steel strip thickness setup are analyzed for rolling process. By considering many factors that influence the steel strip thickness accuracy, the final thickness error functional formula is obtained. A BP neural network prediction model of final thickness error is presented, high order algorithm is adopted. We train the neural network according to steel strip classification. The combination of this model with others enhances greatly thickness accuracy control.

articleTitle: The study of establishing the NN models for operating conditions inside grinding mill and response factors outside
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The grinding process has many uncertain factors and nonlinear characteristics that are hard to describe precisely. This dissertation is based on our researches about operating conditions inside grinding mill (which are the charge volume ratio of balls to the mill, the weight ratio of solid to water, the fraction of the spaces between the balls at rest which is filled with powder) and response factors (sound intensity and spectrum distributions) outside, and has been established the neural network models of the grinding mill by using radial basis networks with the ability of approximating the nonlinear function. Besides we have done further investigation of the shortages of conventional models, we use the trial results to train the neural networks again with its learning capability, to give the networks a more precise approximate ability (sum-squared error less than 0.02). Compared with the conventional models, the simulating results had showed that the neural networks not only have achieved very good approximation capability at the associated targets, but also have very good approximation capability between them.

articleTitle: Using ODIIPSA98 to design the computer-supporting environment for integrated human-machine discussion system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The study of an integrated human-machine discussion system for supporting economic decisions requires establishing a computer-supporting environment, which can discover the knowledge about economics from heterogeneous information sources, and then utilize them to provide useful information for the experts in different locations. It also should allow real-time discussion among such economic experts and finally upgrade the overall correctness of economic decisions. ODIIPSA98 (Open Distributed Intelligent Information Processing System Architecture '98), a pragmatic structural model of open intelligent systems, is MAS-based and information (including multi-media information, knowledge and such like) accessing oriented. The paper first introduces the fundamental ideas and design principles of ODIIPSA98, and then moves to the computer supporting system for upgrading economic decisions, in which ODIIPSA98 serves as its basic framework. After some analyses and comparisons, it is obvious that, such a system, established under the instruction of ODIIPSA98, would gradually show its advantages of open flexibility, reliability, efficiency, and so on.

articleTitle: The application of expert system on electrochemistry rectifying power supply CAD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents an intelligent method for designing a power rectifier. Based on an expert system and database, an intelligent CAD software package is developed. A computer based high-efficiency calculation and analysis function is combined with the knowledge of engineers, so the automatic intelligent design is realized.

articleTitle: Fuzzy neuron model-free control for continuous steel casting processes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on a neuron model and a neuron control method, the fuzzy neuron model-free control method for the mold level control of continuous steel casting processes is proposed in this paper. The fuzzy algorithm is used to tune the neuron gain, and the nonlinear transfer is adopted to produce the neuron inputs. The simulation experiments with an example are made. This paper illustrates that this new model-free method has strong robustness, adaptability and satisfied performances.

articleTitle: Bilinear modeling of delayed cooking by using genetic algorithm and robust control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A method is proposed to realize a bilinear modeling of a delayed cooking process with genetic algorithms. The bilinear model with uncertain parameters is equivalent to the device faults of the delayed cooking process. Based on an accurate linearization method of the bilinear system a robust control strategy is provided to keep the system stability.

articleTitle: Digital approximation of fuzzy model via the Walsh function
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We apply the Walsh function to approximate the linear and nonlinear consequent parts of a fuzzy model. For the digital implementation of the fuzzy model, we use the Walsh function to approximate each fuzzy rule under the proposed structure. That is, the consequent part of the fuzzy model can be approximated via the Walsh function. It turns out that the proposed approximated fuzzy model could be realized via some digital logical devices. We use the recursive least squares method with a forgetting factor to tune the coefficient of the proposed method. Hence, the proposed method not only can implement the fuzzy model via digital logical devices, but also has fast computation speed.

articleTitle: The credibility analysis of a kind of system identification method based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The credibility analysis of a kind of system identification method based on genetic algorithm (GA) is studied. First, the system identification based on response curve fitting and the sensitivity of various model fitting precision to the model parameter perturbation are analyzed. Then, the credibility and efficiency of this kind of system identification approach based on various GAs is compared, and an extended GA which can improve the efficiency and credibility of system identification is proposed. Finally, the experimental result shows the sharpness of the improved GA.

articleTitle: The design of new joint control board used in precision assembly robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We have designed and developed a joint control board used in a precision assembly robot with the in-system programmable large-scale integration device GAL20V8 ispLSI1016. We introduce the board's circuit and working principles and its interface with the PC's ISA bus and analyse the design's advantages over one using a conventional IC device.

articleTitle: Digital voice processing system based on high-speed multi-DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this article, we introduce the design of the digital voice processing system based on multiple high-speed DSP chips. This system mainly consists of the digital voice processing module and route protocol processing module. We use six TMS320VC549 high speed 16-bit fixed-point DSP chips in the design of the digital voice processing module. Every module can process 16-channel voice signals. High performance DSP ships make it possible to accurately process a large amount of speech data at a time, forming the basis of the IP phone.

articleTitle: Contact analysis and cooperation in automatic robotic assembly
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents the concept of force screw and displacement screw, and studies the rule that can analyze point contact states in robot automatic assembly on the basis of the screw theory and the virtual work. The cooperation between several equipment is shown with an example.

articleTitle: The geometric way of portfolio investment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: By setting up a critical line equation of portfolio investment without or within a non-negative restriction, we advance a method to find out the optimal weight of portfolio investment, whether its yield or its risk is given.

articleTitle: Filter design with expected covariance and disk area constraint
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A filter design problem for linear continuous stochastic systems with multiple indices is considered, such that the steady-state covariance of the filter is less than the expected steady-state covariance, and the poles of the filters is constrained to a given disk area. The design formula is proposed, and the method of computation is given.

articleTitle: Researching the feed-orward neural network by using the piecewise linear division (PLD)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The mechanism of conventional feedforward neural networks is discussed from the viewpoint of pattern recognition using piecewise linear division (PLD). The decisive factor of the first hidden layer is emphasized. It is pointed out that in the first hidden layer the neural elements provide a group of hyperplanes to cut the pattern space and the first hidden layer is free from the influence of other layers. The role of the other layers is to organize the subspaces to satisfy the demands for classification. The PLD provides not only a fast method to determine the connecting weight sets, but also can establish the structure for the feedforward neural network according to the complexity of the classification problem. Some examples are presented to explain the PLD method and others are given to compare it with the conventional NN method.

articleTitle: A research on neural network based optimal control for greenhouse climate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Making use of the greenhouse and other assorted equipment, protected horticulture realizes the control of temperature, light, water, fertilizer and air to obtain the production of horticulture under the condition of the best growth environment. The typical mathematical model of greenhouse climate is given in the paper, and based on this model, the control relationship of the key parameters is described. In the latter part of the paper, the control model of greenhouse climate and the structure of neural network model are given, and we discuss the optimal control of a practical greenhouse in the end.

articleTitle: A training method for improving the generalization performance of radial basis function networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: To improve the generalization performance of RBF networks, samples having been divided into a training set and an evaluating set, a novel training algorithm is proposed for adjusting the width of the center point set based on the standard deviation of evaluating set error. Simulation results show this method is effective in improving the generalization performance of RBF networks. The performance of generalization of a RBF network can be remarkably improved by using this training method.

articleTitle: An AHP-GP model for determining weights
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the methodologies of the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and goal programming (GP) the paper presents a goal programming model that can easily determine the index weights by utilizing only the upper triangular elements of the pairwise comparison matrix in AHP. An example is illustrated, and a comparison between the eigenvector procedure and our model is, in the light of least distance approximation, also made.

articleTitle: Dissipation design for uncertain discrete-time systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Considers dissipative analysis and synthesis problems for a class of signal processing systems with uncertainties satisfying some summed quadratic constraints. For dissipative analysis, we are concerned with deriving conditions such that a given system is of a desired dissipative property. As for the latter problem, we focus on compensation design for each of the subsystems to achieve certain dissipative property such that their interconnections will be stable. Our solution to the above two problems are in terms of the feasibility of one or more linear matrix inequalities which can be solved efficiently.

articleTitle: Leak detection and data collection system of oil pipeline
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The integrity of oil pipeline is always a major concern to the operators and public, so the supervisory control and data acquisition system have become a essential part of modern long distance oil pipeline operations today. The general framework of the system is given and the fundamental of the statistical method of leak detection for oil pipeline is discussed. The function and structure of the supervisory control and data acquisition system based on PLCs and fiber optic communications are also designed.

articleTitle: Large signal analysis of arc welding power supply based on Matlab modeling and simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In view of the large signal characteristics of the dynamic process of arc welding, a nonlinear model of a control system for a welding inverter has been put forward and computer simulation is conducted. From the comparison between the simulation and experiments, it is proved the model is correct, and the method is a useful approach for analysis of arc welding power supply.

articleTitle: A research and application of mechanism of multi-agent cooperative inference
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The formal system of a multi-agent system based on modal logic and nonmonotonic logic are inadequate for complex objects in open and dynamic environments. The basic structure of the agent is analyzed in the paper. A cooperative inference system of a multi-agent system is constructed too. Agents cooperate to solve problems by different inference abilities and different knowledge bases of heterogeneous agents. The reliability is analyzed also. This method improves the inference ability of an agent and makes the system robust and reliable. When the multi-agent system designed in the paper is applied to analyze and adjust the components of a nutritional solution, the primary disadvantages of traditional methods are overcome.

articleTitle: The single-neural cascade control system of intelligent switch regulating devices and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A regulating device which consists of a main regulator, sub-regulator and regulating valve, is proposed. The control device has a structure of double-loop cascade control that can realize intelligent switching. At the same time, a supervisory Hebbian rule based single-neural PSD adaptive controller is designed for the controlled objects with nonlinear parameter loads. Under the condition of configuration using the functional blocks of Bailey Controls' CLC-04 programmable regulator, we controlled the reheated steam temperature of the 670T/H boiler at the 200 MW Shanxi Shentou power plant unit for 78 hours. The results obtained indicate that the single-neural cascade compound control system, which consists of an intelligent switch for the regulating devices, gives good controllability and robustness.

articleTitle: The compensation and the neural network control for the mechanical resonance of the LAMOST reflector servo tracing system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: LAMOST (Large Sky Area Multi-object Fibre Spectroscope) is a huge nationally initiated scientific project. The neural control scheme for the full state feedback compensation of the mechanical resonance existed in the LAMOST reflector servo tracing system is described. The result of MATLAB simulation is given.

articleTitle: CMAC NN-based adaptive control of non-affine nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the implicit theorem and variable structure control (VSC), an adaptive control method is proposed for a class of non-affine nonlinear systems using CMAC neural networks (NN). The proposed controller ensures that the output of the system tracks a given bounded reference signal and that the output tracking error converges to the origin. The neural network weight learning laws are determined by Lyapunov stability theory and the stability of the closed loop system is guaranteed. The simulation results have shown the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Robustness for the uncertain systems with guaranteed cost design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, we present a robustness analysis method by using robust bounds for the uncertain systems with guaranteed cost design. Parameter dependent robust bounds are derived. An optimization problem for improving the robustness of quadratic guaranteed cost control systems with parameter uncertainty is proposed. The corresponding optimization technique is also given.

articleTitle: Modeling and optimization of product development process in concurrent engineering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Several existing modeling methods of product development are first discussed. A modeling system of product development in current engineering is then proposed and its structure is described in detail. Moreover, the optimization method based on the modeling system described is expatriated. Finally, the modeling system and optimization method are briefly summarized.

articleTitle: Hybrid system modeling based on ECPNs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A general system structure for hybrid system modeling is proposed along with their formulations. An extended colored Petri net (ECPN) is proposed to implement the hybrid system modeling, its key ideas are dynamic colors, dynamic transitions and dynamic places, which make ECPNs capable of modelling both variables governed by continuous dynamic and the ordinary Petri net tokens for discrete events. Finally, an example shows how to use ECPNs for hybrid system modeling.

articleTitle: Self-calibration algorithm of rotation cameras
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We overcome the shortcomings of Hartley's self-salibration algorithm, and obtain the following major results: 1) a rotation camera about coordinate axis, the formula of camera intrinsic parameters and practical algorithm are obtained; and 2) a rotation camera about unknown axis. A family of camera intrinsic parameter matrix, consisting with 2D projective transformation, can be obtained. It was proved that the local camera intrinsic parameter matrix can be uniquely determined through the method based on two different unknown rotational axes. Meanwhile, its practical algorithm is provided. Tests with synthetic data and real images indicate that the algorithms presented are robust and practical.

articleTitle: Constructive sufficient conditions for fuzzy logic controllers to approximate C/sup 1/ functions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: For a class of fuzzy logic controllers, constructive sufficient conditions under which they can approximate any C/sup 1/ functions to any required accuracy on a compact domain are established. Explicit formulas which can be used to calculate the number of fuzzy rules needed are derived simultaneously. For the case that the C/sup 1/ functions are polynomials, we also prove that our results are less conservative than the ones in Hao Ying (1994).

articleTitle: Determining the best strategy to fault isolation by genetic programming algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on a functional block diagram and signal flow of equipment, the fault information matrix of the equipment is structured, then a genetic programming algorithm (GPA) for finding the best strategy for fault isolation, composed of some ordinal test points, is consequently developed, which can isolate the failed component with the fewest test points and the least time.

articleTitle: The application of dither in high speed and high resolution ADC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Dither and its application in A/D converter are briefly summarized. By analyzing the architecture of subranging flash A/D converter, the author establishes an A/D converter simulation system. In addition, a 12 bit, 65 MHz A/D converter testing system is set up for analyzing. The simulation and real testing results show that dither improves the static frequency dynamic range of high speed and high resolution A/D converters. The effects of dither on ADC are discussed and summarized.

articleTitle: Hybrid neural network and variable structure control for robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper proposes a neural-network and continuous sliding mode hybrid control method for robot manipulators, which has a unknown model. First, a feedforward neural network is used to learn the characteristics of the robot system (or specially its inverse dynamics) for accurate trajectory following and smooth torque control. Then, a saturated-function-based continuous sliding mode controller is used to guarantee the convergence of the tracking errors, reduces or even eliminates the chattering. Simulations of a two-link robot are given to illustrated the good transient performance and smooth control torque.

articleTitle: Energy balance control used for main steam temperature in power plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A conventional controller based on feedback was designed based on the dynamic property of the object. The paper gives a method that is based on the energy balance in the main steam temperature control of the boiler. The energy of the steam obtained from gas in the superheater must be balanced under static and dynamic conditions. It involves all the properties and heat transfer coefficient calculations of the work medium including water, steam, gas and air. The formulas or equations are from engineering manuals. The method can calculate the flow rate of spray water according to energy balanced under static and dynamic conditions. The paper gives design methods and rules, and provides test results from a power plant simulator. The results show excellent stability and robustness compared with a traditional controller. The controller based on this method can be easily used by a DCS.

articleTitle: Tracking control of an automatic paper joining system: design and experiments
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents the results of an experimental setup for an automatic paper joining system that controls a joining device and tracks the moving paper so that the working paper and the next paper roll to be used are connected while the paper is still moving. The tracking control employs a reflective-type optical sensor mounted on a servo controlled table to measure the relative positions between a mark on the working paper and the table so that the mark alignment can be controlled during the joining process. The application of this system shows clearly the benefit of being able to reduce the time taken to complete the paper joining procedure, therefore improving efficiency and increasing productivity.

articleTitle: The intelligent control for dust trap system of a boiler
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A kind of intelligent control with reduced energy is presented for a dust trap system of a boiler. A basic output value is given via a basic controller, and the value of smoke quantities produced in different steps can be predicted by a BP network, then the work points of the system can be changed easily and the regulation of the rotational speed of the dust trap fans and dreggy pumps as well as the required water quantity of the dust trap system can be adjusted. The impact of the dust trap system in different steps can be compensated via a fuzzy controller. The practical application shows the method is a good way to reduce the energy cost of the dust trap system.

articleTitle: GA method for solving minimum rank problems in reduced-order H/sub /spl infin// synthesis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Reduced-order H/sub /spl infin// synthesis can be referred to as a minimum rank problem under LMI constraints, which is a non-convex optimization problem. The paper presents a numerical method for solving the non-convex optimization problem using genetic algorithms, by which the minimum order k of the H/sub /spl infin// controller and a corresponding parameter pair (X, Y) can be effectively found. The obtained results can be used to design an excellent reduced order H/sub /spl infin// controller. Due to not depending on initial points, the proposed approach is characterized by global search. A numerical example illustrates the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Parametric design method based on a directed acyclic hypergraph and object oriented technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We use the parametric figure model based on the directed hypergraph to represent the store structure of pressed cross chains, and carry it out using the object oriented method. By making use of a clear data structure to store the constraints model, we can implement the spreading and solving of the constraints and represent the bidirectional constraints conveniently.

articleTitle: The application of optimal sliding mode control in DC motor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: According to control ability of DC motor this paper proposes a new optimal sliding mode control scheme based on the virtual state. The sliding mode surface design is based on the augmented system. The dynamics of this sliding mode have a higher order than those of the original system. Using the virtual state, we can make the motion go into sliding mode state at the initial state. At last, simulation proves the effectiveness of the scheme in DC motor control.

articleTitle: The application of intelligent control for thickening process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Since the model of thickening process is difficult to build, an intelligent control scheme is suggested for optimal operation of the process. The scheme effectively deals with the nonlinear and coupling characteristics inherent in the thickening process. The practical operating result in a gold mine concentrator shows the correctness and validity of this intelligent control scheme.

articleTitle: Study on systematic stability of optic fiber displacement sensor with intensity compensation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Using interrelated check technology and a reference channel, one can realize compensation of unstable factors of an intensity modulated optic fiber sensor. The author analyzes the compensatory mechanism. Theoretic analysis and experimental results support the adoption of the compensatory technology. The optic fiber displacement sensing system can effectively compensate the influence on measuring accuracy and stability of various factors including light power fluctuation, reflector surface property, optic fiber transmission loss changes, and environmental light interference.

articleTitle: Combined PLC/VSC for linear systems with input constraints
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We give a design method of a stabilizing control law for linear systems with input constraints, input additive uncertainties and disturbances, referred to as the combined PLC/VSC state feedback. It combines two useful design techniques, PLC (piecewise-linear LQ control) and the VSC (variable structure control) design techniques. It inherits the advantages of both design techniques, while avoiding their disadvantages. The stability of the closed-loop system is analyzed by using Lyapunov nested level sets and stability theory. The simulation results of a simple pendulum are presented to illustrate the developed control scheme and its performance.

articleTitle: Research on nonspecific vocabulary speech recognition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In automatic speech recognition, speech problems are related to nonspecific vocabulary, i.e. nonspecific vocabulary speech recognition. In this paper, some research on the algorithm for nonspecific vocabulary speech recognition has been done. In order to get excellent recognition result, the breadth-first dynamic time-warping algorithm is set forth and implemented. The algorithm gives more considerations on breadth of search, therefore, it avoids being trapped in local minimum point. Because no specific vocabulary is given, it is impossible to apply statistic method in pattern recognition, and the model match method is the only choice. Due to the consideration about recognition ratio, the method of fuzzy pattern recognition has been adopted The classification of different pattern is based on degrees of membership of these patterns, and the degrees of membership is calculated according to the accumulated distance between the recognized order of speech vector and the order of speech vector in speech model base.

articleTitle: The site interference analyses and counter measures in the big controlled system by computer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Describes sources of interference and ways in which it can enter a system. Discusses effective countermeasures against its entering the system. Indicates how computerised control (centralized control, centralized and scattered control, site busbar) can operate safely, normally, stably and reliably in the big full automation system under conditions of all kinds of interference (site disturbance, operational overvoltage, thunderstroke, electromagnetic radiation, cosmic rays).

articleTitle: Multi-channel digital automatic ultrasonic detecting system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This article introduces a kind of multichannel digital automatic ultrasonic detecting system, emphasizing its structure, working principle and basic techniques. It also briefly introduces the design of an analog input A/D converter FIFO digital signal processor and system software. The device is used in the train wheel inspection work in Ma'anshan Steel and Iron Company.

articleTitle: Applications of competitive learning and fuzzy associative mapping in classification of power quality disturbances
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Proposes a neural-fuzzy technique based classifier for the recognition of power quality disturbances. The classifier adopts neural networks in the architecture of frequency sensitive competitive learning and learning vector quantization. With the neural network, a set of code words is derived from training samples for each type of disturbances. The code words are then exploited to evaluate similarity measures, which in turn are used to determine the disturbance type together with a belief degree through fuzzy associative memory mapping.

articleTitle: A high efficient algorithm of mining sequential patterns
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Sequential pattern is a very important and useful pattern in time-related transaction databases and it is an important field in the knowledge discovery in database (KDD) research. To improve the efficiency of sequential pattern mining has been a key problem. This paper presents a novel and high efficient algorithm for mining sequential patterns by elaborately arranging the data structure.

articleTitle: Distributed multi-robots' communication system design based on CSMA/CD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Distributed robotic system domains consist of systems of robots that need to collaborate in an adversarial, dynamic environment. Thus, how to deal with sharing the communication resource is a crucial issue . We introduce a general strategy based on CSMA/CD and communication protocol, which is designed for use in inter-robot environments with unreliable, single-channel, low-communication. It is shown that the communication and protocol is effective, efficient and robust.

articleTitle: A recursive batch least square (LS) identification algorithm with constant observation matrix dimension
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A batch least square (LS) identification algorithm with recursive formulation is proposed to deal with the problems occurred when the ordinary to algorithm is applied to real-time and online identification. The fundamental feature of this algorithm is to fix the observation matrix's dimension, making use of a definite amount of newly obtained data and ignoring the older data. Taking advantage of the recursive formulation, this algorithm avoids the inverse operation and thus reduces the calculation, making itself capable of application in real-time and online identification case. Simulation shows that this algorithm has rather good precision and tracking ability, which are greatly influenced by the dimension of the observation matrix.

articleTitle: The QoS-MS of Internet based on agent technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the Internet, which is a complicated and dynamic environment, the QoS-MS (quality of service management system) has many problems to be overcome and also there is a need to introduce new methods to meet the demand of future development. We introduce the advantages of multi-agent technology, which is a hotspot in distributed artificial intelligence, we propose an Internet QoS management scheme based upon a hierarchy agent (hierarchy agent Internet QoS management, HAIQM). We analyze the architecture, characteristics and components of HAIQM, and validate that the agent based QoS negotiation has better time-efficiency and application horizon. We also give the future direction of the HAIQM as a systematic solution of opening QoS-MS.

articleTitle: Study of clustering validity based on fuzzy similarity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A clustering validation method based on fuzzy similarity is presented, which is characterized by its distinct concept, low computing cost, and good robustness. Finally, two experiments have been carried out with satisfactory results.

articleTitle: The properties and performance analysis of 1 1/2 -spectrum
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The properties of 1 1/2 -spectrum are proved and the performances are analyzed in this paper. By means of the spectrum, the fundamental frequency component of the harmonic signals can be enhanced. The Gaussian color noise and symmetrical distribution noise can be cancelled and non-quadratic phase coupling harmonic components can be eliminated.

articleTitle: Modeling for a complicated industrial object based on recurrent neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper discusses the architecture and algorithm of a class of dynamical neural network, the Elman recurrent neural network (RNN). Based on this network an approach for modeling a nonlinear time-varying industrial object, the direct current arc, is proposed. Compared with other modeling method for the object, the model based on RNN is proved to have better performance.

articleTitle: Decentralized control of a class of uncertain interconnected systems via output feedback
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The problem of decentralized stabilization of a class of uncertain interconnected systems via static output feedback is considered. A kind of robust decentralized controller for the systems is proposed and a numerical example is given to illustrate the result in the paper.

articleTitle: A study of acceleration sensor-based control for lead-screw drive system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper the static and dynamic friction of the constructed lead-screw drive system are studied. The acceleration feedback control combined with the fuzzy parameter self-modulated method is presented and applied to the system to improve the performance. Experiments on the step response and disturbance suppression were performed, and the results obtained confirm the effectiveness of the presented method.

articleTitle: Researches on fuzzy control of a new rectifier for DC EAF
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a rectifier based upon the combination of free wheeling diode with neural and shifting control. It uses an anti-flicker control model. It is used in a DC electric arc furnace. This paper analyses the work principle and special qualities of the new rectifier. Computer simulation with fuzzy control shows that the new rectifier results in a significant decrease of the flicker effect as well as a reduction of reactive power consumption. In addition, it can run with a higher power factor compared with traditional rectifier.

articleTitle: The apply of concurrent multiple tasks in computer control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper presents a new program framework and scheduling management method in terms of the features of concurrent multiple processes and the requirements of real-time processing in the computer real-time control management system so as to promote the efficiency of use of system resources and make the response speed faster as well as achieve real-time processing of concurrent multiple processes.

articleTitle: Application of hypergame analysis to virtual enterprise research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on analyzing the characteristics of a virtual enterprise, the infeasibility of the old theories and methods for the distribution of the benefit and risk in the virtual enterprise are dealt with. On the idea of the limited reasoning, the application of hypergame analysis to the research of virtual enterprise is given, and an example is used to illustrate the method.

articleTitle: The generalized properties of KYP and its applications in H/sup /spl infin// method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper studies the relation between r-passive systems and the H/sup /spl infin// control problem, introduces the generalized properties of KYP (Kalman-Yacubovich-Popov), provides the possibility for solving V(x) and proves that a nonlinear control system with the generalized properties of KYP is globally asymptotically stable.

articleTitle: Structure optimization strategy of neural networks - research on the pruning algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We analysis the major factors which influence the generalization performance of the neural networks, carry out a survey on structure optimization methods and present several kinds of pruning algorithms to simulate the multilayer feedforward network on two kinds of typical problems. The result suggests that the pruning algorithm can effectively optimize the structure of neural networks and notably improve their generalization. Finally, some new developments of the pruning algorithm are summarized.

articleTitle: Variable structure control of vibration isolation systems based on Ackermann's method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, authors present a design methodology of the sliding mode control of the active vibration isolation, based on Ackermann's method. The control design makes the controlled system move in a time-variant sliding mode surface from the beginning, which ensures the stability robustness of the active isolation system in respect with the external turbulence from the base and the uncertainty parameter of system parameters. Realization of the control strategy at the active vibration isolation is also reliable and simple, as the study shows. The methodology this paper suggests will open a new way for the active robust control of vibration isolation systems.

articleTitle: H/sub /spl infin// control for Lipschitz nonlinear systems via output feedback
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of disturbance attenuation via output feedback with internal stability for Lipschitz nonlinear systems. The main result is given in terms of the solutions of a Riccati equation and a Hamilton-Jacobi inequality. The method is shown to be suitable for linearized systems and, locally, for some general nonlinear systems as well. A numerical example is studied to show the feasibility of the presented approach.

articleTitle: The Smith neural networks pre-estimated control for a kind of system with large time-delay
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents an improved Smith-NN pre-estimated control method which is designed to overcome the effect caused by controlled object's time-varying, nonlinear and uncertainties when large time-delay is compensated. The studying of the closed loop neural controller and the Smith pre-estimated controller designing and testing prove the method is feasible. From control system simulation, especially experiments on the pH process and dynamic ration weighing process, confirm the effectiveness of the method to overcome large time-delay. This method can easily be realized by intelligent tools based on the assembly language.

articleTitle: The application of data fusion based on fuzzy theory in temperature judgement of rotary kiln
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An algorithm of data fusion based on fuzzy theory is proposed for temperature trend judgement of an industrial rotary kiln, which is key to the control system for this complex industrial process. The temperature measurement is based on the flame image processing which is easily disturbed by the dust and smog in the sintering strand. The algorithm proposed in the paper can overcome this disadvantage effectively. On the other hand, the fuzzy rules can be obtained directly by the data in the industry locale. Application shows that the control system using this method as feedback signal can achieve high robustness and good utility.

articleTitle: Research on the decision support system for yearly production planning in CIMS of the flow process industries
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper analyzes the features of decision support system for yearly production planning based on the coal preparation plant, and the architecture of the decision system in CIMS is also presented. The limited optimization models of product portfolio are built and simulated. The simulation results agreed with the actual production planning for the coal preparation plant. This research is also useful for other industries.

articleTitle: A fuzzy central cluster neural classifier
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Pattern classification is a critical stage in an image recognition system. In this paper, we incorporate the concepts of fuzzy sets into the recognition system, and develop an efficient algorithm based on fuzzy classification decision criterion to classify features of images with a high degree of success. A fuzzy central cluster neural network classifier is proposed, which takes advantages of the neural network's high computation rate provided by the massive parallelism, and fuzzy neural network classifiers can be trained by both supervised and unsupervised techniques.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of automatic routing in simulation graphical software
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: After reviewing and synthesizing all popular automatic routing algorithms, we present a new synthetic automatic routing algorithm, and improve the backtracking mechanism in DFS by employing grid management. This routing algorithm overcomes some defects of the existing routing algorithms, and has a rapid routing speed, strong detouring ability and global placement ability.

articleTitle: A new blind separation approach based on blind localization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, a new approach for blind source separation (BSS) based on blind localization is presented, which makes use of the inherent relationship between separation and localization. The approach incorporates the advantages of classical algorithms of BSS and localization. It can not only determine the number of signal sources, which is difficult to deal with by traditional separation algorithms, but also reduce the adaptive learning time. The efficiency of the approach is illustrated by simulation.

articleTitle: Optimization of EBFN architecture by an improved RPCL algorithm with application to process control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: EBF networks are an extension of radial basis function (RBF) networks. Selecting an appropriate number of clusters is a problem for RBF or EBF networks. The rival penalized competitive learning (RPCL) algorithm is designed to solve this problem but its performance is not satisfactory when the data has overlapped clusters and the input vectors contain dependent components. The paper addresses this problem by incorporating full covariance matrices into the original RPCL algorithm. The resulting algorithm, referred to as the improved RPCL algorithm progressively eliminates the units whose clusters contain only a small portion of the training data. The improved algorithm is applied to optimize the architecture of elliptical basis function networks for process control. The results show that the covariance matrices in the improved RPCL algorithm have a better representation of the clusters.

articleTitle: A new adaptive controller-observer design for manipulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An adaptive velocity observer, and an adaptive combined controller-observer design which is simple and easily implementable, are proposed for a manipulator. The mechanical parameters of the manipulator are uncertain and there are only joint angle measurements. The locally asymptotic convergence of the observation errors and tracking errors of the manipulator's joints is proved. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A graph-based truth maintenance system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The assumption-based truth maintenance system proposed by de Kleer (1986) is the most popular scheme for performing belief revision. The ATMS is a logic-based scheme, which performs its reasoning on the knowledge represented by a propositional theory. In this paper, we propose a causal network called augmented causal network and a graph-based truth maintenance method based on the causal network. We prove that the graph-based truth maintenance method provides correct implementations of the ATMS.

articleTitle: An AI problem: knot-unknotting Chinese puzzle ring by the counting law of Gray code
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper analyzes the knot-unknotting steps of Baguenaudier and its movement. With the law of the increase and decrease of the Gray code, the solution of Baguenaudier starting from any states was figured out.

articleTitle: Neural network self-reliance signal forecast based on LS rule
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: For the problem of signal forecasting a new method, the neural network self-reliance signal forecasting based on least squares (LS) rule, is presented in this paper from the point of view of studying the theory of neural network. The simulation results show that the new method has such advantages as low processing time, high precision, easy realization, etc.

articleTitle: Parameter identification of dynamic nonlinear model based on FLANN
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Describes a method of parameter identification of a dynamic nonlinear model based on a functional link artificial neural network (FLANN), and solves the problems of rounding error and low estimation accuracy of LMS. The result of modelling a robot's multi-dimensional wrist force sensor proved the method correct and effective.

articleTitle: The performance analysis of field communication protocol by time Petri net
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Since the basic Petri net does not have the ability to describe time quantity, this paper introduces several types of time Petri nets and adopts timed Petri net and stochastic Petri net to develop the model for the communication protocol analysis. The two methods are obtained and their performance of field communication protocol are validated using a practical temperature control system.

articleTitle: Animated simulation of human-robot interactions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An animated simulation program of human-robot coordination and interactions is developed. The purpose is to perform the simulation before any physical experiments with robot hardware are conducted. The outcome of the simulation may give an insight into any unexpected interactions which may endanger the human operator as well as equipment. The human operator may learn from these experiences and be aware of the problems which may appear when physical experiments are performed.

articleTitle: Chinese word classification based on statistics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Chinese words classification based on statistics plays an important role in natural language processing, such as speech recognition, intelligent Chinese input method, and so on. We first do statistics and calculation work on the large-scale corpus text, and then use the average mutual information as the global cost function for clustering all Chinese words into a predefined number of classes with a hybrid top-down splitting and bottom-up merging approach. The result of classification is encouraging and can be used in the class-based language model.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of fieldbus interoperability
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Fieldbuses are playing a more and more important role in industrial automation. This paper mainly discuss the interoperability and integration of hetero-fieldbus devices through the detail analysis of fieldbus devices. Finally, the method of building and implementation of interoperability and integration of hetero-fieldbus is given by means of function block, object directory, device description and OPC.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a dual-server fault-tolerant real-time processing system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A fault-tolerant computer system is one such that if problems arise then the system itself has the capacity to find and correct or eliminate them and ensure that the whole system runs normally. The dual-server real-time processing system discussed in this paper is a dual-module hardware redundant system. This system has two Sun workstations as dual-server. First we review the design of the whole system, then we focus on discussing how to resolve the problems of communication, synchronization, and problem detection and correction between two Sun workstations. The result shows that this system resolve those problems existing in the dual-server redundant system. This system can be widely used in many real-time processing fields such as power supply scheduling, technical production control and so on.

articleTitle: Generalized predictive control using fuzzy neural networks in T-S model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A fuzzy neural networks in Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) model is constructed, where BP algorithm is applied to train the parameters of the fuzzy neural networks. On this basis, a generalized predictive controller is designed whose effectiveness for nonlinear systems control is verified via simulation studies.

articleTitle: Integral sliding mode variable structure control based on fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on fuzzy logic, a method of integral sliding mode variable structure control is presented, which is applied to a class of linear system in the presence of disturbances and model uncertainties. This method is formed by combing sliding mode variable structure control with fuzzy control, furthermore an integral control is introduced into it in order to eliminate steady-state error and improve control precision. Simulation results show that the control system not only exhibits strong robustness, excellent tracking characteristics and controlling effects, but also avoids the chattering phenomenon.

articleTitle: Genetic TD(/spl lambda/) learning algorithm for policy evaluation problems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, tabular TD(/spl lambda/) learning algorithm is combined with genetic algorithm (GA) to solve stochastic policy evaluation problems. Unlike conventional TD(/spl lambda/) algorithm which has fixed control parameters, the proposed genetic TD(/spl lambda/) algorithm makes use of GA to optimize the control parameters while evaluating stochastic policies. Simulated experiments on stochastic policy evaluation problems show that genetic TD(/spl lambda/) algorithms not only realize the auto-tuning of control parameters but also have improved performance.

articleTitle: Fuzzy CMAC and its application in function learning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: To avoid the shortcoming of normal CMAC which only works on some discrete points, a fuzzy cerebellar model articulation controller (FCMAC) with fuzzifying and defuzzifying process is proposed. The fuzzifying process of the input layer enables the FCMAC to accept a continuous quantum as its input. A concept mapping algorithm and learning algorithm of the FCMAC, which makes the association space rather small and the velocity of convergence rather high respectively. This is illustrated by the results of simulations given in the multiple-inputs case.

articleTitle: Air material inventory optimization model based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper applies air material operation rate formulas to establish air material inventory model before a genetic algorithm is applied to solve it. The example calculation indicates that the method is scientific and reasonable, and has a lot of use value.

articleTitle: The basic pattern of model free controller and analysis of application effect
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper contains two parts: (1) introduces the basic pattern of a model free controller and analyses the convergence of the model free controller (2) the general pattern and the application effect of this controller are presented. It can be shown that, this control law has obvious better qualities than the PID regulator. Using the model free controller will enhance control functions of a DCS and a fieldbus.

articleTitle: Integrated intelligent fault detection and diagnosis system and its application in urea synthesis process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the essential requirements of the CIPS, the paper presents an integrated intelligent fault detection and diagnosis system. A urea synthesis process is used as an illustration and the structure, functions and realization are discussed specifically.

articleTitle: A rule based human-like intelligent control method for electrical arc furnace
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A PLC based electrodes regulating system is discussed. By combing the intelligent control technology and the classical control mechanism together, a rule based human-like intelligent control system structure is presented. The problem of how to realize the control strategy in a complex system by a classical mechanism is discussed. Meanwhile a method is also presented by which the system parameters can be given online through minimum I/O points in the PLC based system.

articleTitle: Digital power system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Integrating e-intelligence into product and service automation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Based-on nonlinear compensation self-tuning PID control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A new kind of self-tuning PID control method based on nonlinear compensation is developed in this paper. The results of simulation demonstrate that it has a better control performance than the conventional PID controllers.

articleTitle: Comparison analysis and simulation of capacity of model free (non-modelling adaptive) controller with PID regulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We design a kind of simulation to compare a model free controller with a PID regulator. The comparison shows that model free control is better than the PID regulator in many places.

articleTitle: The innovation of relay-contactor controlled machine tools by PLC techniques
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper discusses some common questions about the improvement of relay contactor controlled machine tools by using PLC techniques.

articleTitle: The variable pairing in multivariable control system and its decoupling research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper analyzes the variable coupling relations among the three objects of coal grinding machine in a power plant. A new variable pairing is introduced. Meanwhile, a partial decoupling method is designed to control the system. The simulation results show that the method give good effective control performance.

articleTitle: Management information system for hospitalization insurance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This article introduces the design idea, main functions and data flow analysis of the management information system for hospitalization insurance developed by the authors.

articleTitle: Automatic recognition and monitoring system for road toll station
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Provides a set of integrated and useful automatic monitoring systems for toll stations, especially in image processing, the system adopts bipack conversion, VBR technology, frame store, multi-parameter comparison, sample storehouse, dynamic video frequency storehouse division, and transducer technology. Therefore, the system can ensure precision of the type and the weight of vehicles.

articleTitle: Adaptive evaluation model for complex system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Base on the complex systems, we establish the evaluation model, in which we bring the variable weight in the model to adjust indices which affect the whole systems. The results for system evaluation are multipurpose, including the degree of operation expansion, harmonisation, stabilization and flexibility between subsystems. Also, the parameters in the models are discussed.

articleTitle: The equivalent system of DEDS and the rank of dioid matrix
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, based on the studying of the rank of dioid matrix, some characteristics and laws of the rank of dioid matrix are discussed. Meanwhile, it is applied to the equivalent system and simplification of the dioid model for DEDS.

articleTitle: The optimal control of flatness in four-roll CVC mill
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
