abstract: This paper describes the optimal control and mathematical model of the four-roll CVC mill. From the practical applications, it is suitable for flatness control of the similar mills.

articleTitle: Digital power system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Homotopic mapping and pole disposition of control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Several basic questions about homotopic mapping are studied. The equivalent conditions for homotopic mapping and pole disposition for system control are deduced and it is proposed that the dimension restriction in the theorem of pole disposition is less restrictive in homotopic mapping.

articleTitle: Research on single chip microprocessor based intelligence testing method and equipment for switches
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The author presents a new single chip microprocessor based test equipment for use in on-off rotary switch manufacturing to replace the traditional manual testing method.

articleTitle: Data detection technique in quick pressure test
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper introduces a method that effectively eliminates interaction in quick pressure tests using AC. A filter program eliminates detection error. Multinomial simulation can improve accuracy of the test curve.

articleTitle: Deadlock and deadlock avoidance of batch processing system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the colored time constrained hybrid Petri net, we discuss the deadlock avoidance of batch production processes due to various intermediate stock policies and the sharing and competing of limited resources. The necessary and sufficient conditions of system deadlock and critical deadlock are presented. Finally, we introduce the corresponding deadlock avoidance policy.

articleTitle: Brushless direct current motor (BLDCM) intelligent controller design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An intelligent controller is designed for a BLDCM system. Fuzzy control and an adaptive PID controller based on a single neuron are better together as each advantage is applied to the control in different situations. Simulation research and real time operation results show that this intelligent controller has not only satisfactory static and dynamic performance, but also high robustness and adaptive ability.

articleTitle: The implementation of CAD-based fuzzy control design software
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Fuzzy control has been widely applied, but it is restricted because of the difficulty in designing the fuzzy controller for a complicated system. In order to standardize and simplify the design of a fuzzy control system the CAD (computer aided design) technique is adopted. In the paper, the design ideas and design methods of fuzzy control system CAD software (FuzzyCAD) are discussed. In addition, FuzzyCAD is used to design a fuzzy controller according to some digital simulation objects and the simulation results are fine, thus the software is proved to be valuable and practicable.

articleTitle: The research on fuzzy control for performance improvement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Several methods on fuzzy control for performance improvement are introduced in the paper, then their specialities and areas of application are summarized.

articleTitle: Analysis and decision by using fuzzy information of fuzzy graph
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Uses fuzzy graphs to analyse and deal with fuzzy information about people's knowledge, determination, judgment etc. and studies the condition and structure of this fuzzy information. Furthermore, the paper puts forward an example which uses a fuzzy graph to carry out social investigation analysis and establishes a social graph.

articleTitle: Fuzzy reaching law control for a digital AC position servo system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method of reaching law control based on fuzzy rules is present, which is that the reaching law parameters is online adjusted by fuzzy rules. This method is used in a digital AC position servo system, the simulation results show that the system designed by this method has both satisfactory quality and very smaller chattering.

articleTitle: Application of LR analyzer to artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Having analyzed the function of an LR analyzer, the paper reduces the LR analyzer used in artificial intelligence inference, which based on objectives, is more simple and more efficient than the general conventions one. It illustrates a far-ranging application prospect for study on intelligent problems based on objectives.

articleTitle: H/sub /spl infin// controller design for large flexible simulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper studies a robust controller design for a large flexible simulator using the H/sub /spl infin// loop-shaping method. The model of the large flexible simulator is presented, and then a robust controller is designed by the H/sub /spl infin// loop-shaping method, and the authors finally provide the computer simulation results of the closed-loop system.

articleTitle: The research on equipment management system for large enterprises
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper analyzes the requirements and architecture of the equipment management system. The database structure design and implementation are discussed in detail. The system has been implemented in a large enterprise and some good results were obtained.

articleTitle: The resonance problem of concatenate system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the design of a concatenated system when the main-object and the vice-object are cut apart. The time constant of the main-loop and the vice-loop can not be matched suitably, so the resonance phenomenon will take place easily. The paper gives an analysis of the resonance phenomenon with control theory knowledge.

articleTitle: An angle measurement method with variable amplification
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An angle measurement method with variable amplification by means of optical gratings is analyzed in detail in this paper. Mechanism and conditions of this method are analyzed. The characteristics of amplification of angle measurement are also explained by computation of some examples.

articleTitle: A fuzzy course control system for ships
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents a mixed controller based on the combination of regulation's self-tuning control and bang-bang control according to the problem of ship's conventional autopilot. The controller was tested on ship maneuvering simulator. The result of test has showed that it has good control performance.

articleTitle: Enterprise network and distributed control network platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the model of the computer integrated plant automation, this paper presents the enterprise network composition and the enhanced Jini and CORBA distributed control network platform for implement of the enterprise network.

articleTitle: Study on development of advanced design techniques
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to review the importance and developed progress of advanced design technology, and to introduce some new advanced design techniques. The authors propose their own ideas on the developing tendency of modern design technology, the critical problems in the design area, and the methods for solving these problems.

articleTitle: Design of adjusting-free AC intelligent instrument
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The design technique of multi-combination AC intelligent instrument with AC sampling, which is free from adjustment, is discussed. The calibration method combining 3-point calibration inside of the instrument with outside calibration is advanced. The paper analyses errors of temperature drift and time drift.

articleTitle: Establishing corporate technology information management system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: On the basis of analysis of technology management research and technology of corporate management, the authors consider establishing a corporate technology information management system.

articleTitle: Study on software fault-tolerance of computer-based measuring and controlling system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This article discusses the application of software fault-tolerance in the railway computer-based measuring and controlling system, according to the feature of railway transportation and the theory of software engineering. The further study on the feasibility of this method based on the technique of redundancy is also posed. This paper will be a reference for understanding the fault-tolerance in the computer-based measuring and controlling system and its programming.

articleTitle: Digital power system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Application of double models fuzzy-PI control in the braking system of a mine winder
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper analyzes the problems existing in the application of a loop-locked control system regulated by general PI control in the braking system of a mine winder. A viewpoint is put forward to rebuild the braking system of a mine winder by using double models fuzzy-PI control. A design is given for the braking system controlled by double models fuzzy-PI by combining the features of the braking system of a mine winder and the experience gained from on-the-spot operation. Finally, an analysis and a forecast are made of the prospect of the spreading of the braking system controlled by double models fuzzy-PI.

articleTitle: The study of simulation for induction motor direct torque control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a numerical simulation method for an induction motor control system based on MATLAB-SIMULINK. The arithmetic model of the induction motor is proposed based on /spl alpha/-/spl beta/ coordinates using flux linkages as state variables, the required voltage is determined by the switch state of the converter. Its simulation program is simple, usual and accurate. Using this program the performance effect of the direct torque control system caused by various adjustors is studied in detail.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control for plant with delay time
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the characteristic analysis for the plant with time delay, this paper presents a fuzzy compensation rule. And compound control scheme to combine fuzzy controller with fuzzy compensator is applied to the plant with time delay. The simulation results for practical plants show that this control scheme has better control effects.

articleTitle: An intelligent instrument to measure the vapor-to-carbon monoxide ratio in the synthetic ammonia process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A new kind of intelligent instrument designed to measure and display vapor-to-carbon monoxide ratio for water-gas-transform reaction in the synthetic ammonia process is developed. It has a good effect on directing operation in order to save in energy and stabilize yields.

articleTitle: Application of GA on freeway traffic flow model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the application of genetic algorithms (GAs) on traffic flow model in freeway is discussed, and an improved method is proposed. Simulation results indicate the advantages of GAs in robustness and identification precision.

articleTitle: Integrating e-intelligence into product and service automation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Real time tracking in robot teleoperation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The robot teleoperation system based on stereo vision was developed by the State Key Lab of Intelligent Technology and System of Tsinghua University. The paper presents the design frame of the whole system, and describes in detail some of the key design and implementation problems. Finally, the paper analyses the difficulty of applying this technology to virtual reality and augmented reality systems, and some suggestions are provided. The success of this system can contribute to further research on augmented reality.

articleTitle: Application of simulation human intelligence controller in production
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: With the development of computer technique more and more modern control theories and methods are applied in process of production. But PID controllers are still predominant in industrial processes. How to improve the control quality of standing order PID controller and making it more robust and more adaptable in changeable product process is very important. This article introduce the design and application of Simulatire human intelligent controller.

articleTitle: The simulation research on AC VFSR using two - three dimensional complex fuzzy controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: On the basis of research into three-dimensional fuzzy controllers, the two-three dimensional complex fuzzy controller is used to solve the contradictions among stability, precision and quickness. The simulation results have proved that the controller is highly effective. This controller has simple structure and is suitable for real-time control.

articleTitle: The development of oil loading distributed control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Adopting a small distributed control system (DCS) structure, an oil loading distributed control system is developed, which is composed of the process management level and process control level. The hardware configuration, software function and the method of realizing distributed communication are presented. The technical approaches of optimizing loading process management and enhancing process control reliability are used, which are PLC techniques, IC card, and multi-display.

articleTitle: Intelligent control of parallel double-loop DC motor speed control systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, a new switching scheme is proposed for parallel double-loop DC motor speed control systems and an intelligent control method is used in the speed-regulating loop. The simulation results show that the performance is remarkably improved.

articleTitle: The hard bound models of uncertain object set and synthesis of robust controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the paper the hard bound models and random sample models of an uncertain linear multivariable object set as proposed. The distributions are estimated for closed-loop poles of a sample model set. The normative synthesis method for a robust controller is proposed by statistical deductive theory for several distributive characteristics and capacities of the sample model set.

articleTitle: A technique of fuzzy reasoning and control based on degree function
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the paper, the fuzzy rule is looked on as a corresponding relation between language values and their degree. Thus, a concept of degree function is presented. Consequently, the fuzzy reasoning is changed into simple symbolic inference and functional computation, and the fuzzy control is realized by three steps: number/(language value, degree) conversion, (language value, degree) transformation and (language value, degree)/number conversion.

articleTitle: General-purpose software design for DAQ system based on Windows 95
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Data acquisition system is one of the most important PC-based devices, its features and functions are related to the operating system. We introduce the way to develop the hardware driving software based on the Microsoft Windows 95, and the design structure of the DAQ software.

articleTitle: The model and analysis of the optimum periodic contract of venture capital
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper tentatively discusses the design of the optimum periodic contract of venture capital, compares it with the conditional investment contract and reveals some characteristics of the venture capital contract.

articleTitle: A study of harmonic reduction, detection and evaluation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The method of harmonic reduction using a 36-phase rectifier with an interphase transformer is studied. A neuron adaptive detection approach of harmonic current using the APF harmonic reduction technique is discussed. In order to solve the problem of harmonic effect on energy measure, the method of harmonic evaluation is presented.

articleTitle: Intelligent information agents design and realization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper introduces the needs of Web information mining. It describes the attributes and the architecture of an intelligent information agent that is used for Web information mining. The paper presents a design scheme of the intelligent information agent having learning functions and its realization process.

articleTitle: Data fusion model of target identification in the battle field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of mobile target, a practical mobile target-identifying model of opposing forces has been put forward. According to the multilayered trait of target information, we will give a multisensor reasoning model of target identification and decision-making model.

articleTitle: An investigation of inductive inferential laws
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents an inductive inferential algebra, which enable us to obtain inductive conclusions for practical problems. The algebra is formulated as a set of axioms and theorems established on the basis of Boolean algebra. Instead of complementary law in Boolean algebra, we use classificatory axiom and change denial definition for handling practical inductive problems. The algebra involves mathematical descriptions of thought laws thus proving the way of obtaining inductive conclusion by symbolic operation.

articleTitle: Optimization of mother wavelets and time-frequency detection of signals
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the optimization of mother wavelets, a new method for detecting time-frequency of signals using continuous wavelet transform is proposed. This method satisfies the distinguishing rate for detecting time-frequency because it uses more than one mother wavelet to decompose signals. Theoretical analysis and computer simulations show that the proposed scheme is effective.

articleTitle: A length measurement on-line and multi-place display system of steel plate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An online measurement and multiplace display system for steel plate length measurement is presented. The system uses a photoelectric coder to measure the length of a steel plate, and has a single chip for computation. It has been applied in industry.

articleTitle: Integrating e-intelligence into product and service automation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Digital power system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: The technique of digital frequency and waveform generator used in a highly stable gyro power supply
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper introduces the key technique for a gyro power supply to realize highly stable frequency output and highly precise waveform output-the technique of digital frequency generator and digital waveform generator. The applied circuits are presented and the chief test results obtained in our lab are reported.

articleTitle: Application of the fuzzy identification with PID grade algorithm in the missile pose control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the design of the missile autopilot, the fuzzy PID grade identification algorithm is used to estimate the time-varying aerodynamic parameters precisely, which results the autopilot designed with filter control properties. New ideas are proposed for the missile autopilot design.

articleTitle: The flatness preset on cold rolling and its adaptation and inheritance algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Describes the presetting of flatness control for cold rolling and its adaptation and inheritance algorithm.

articleTitle: Memory mechanism research for the brain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper begins first with memory phenomena of the brain, and presents the process by which external information is kept in mind under the control of the awareness centre. The paper also deals with the question of the memory model and construction.

articleTitle: A nonlinear PID controller based on fuzzy-tuned immune feedback law
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A new nonlinear PID controller is presented in this paper by combining the immune feedback law with conventional PID control. Focusing on the immune feedback mechanism of biological immune systems, we first propose a P-type immune feedback controller. The P-type immune feedback law is tuned online by a fuzzy logic controller. Then we extend it to a PID-type immune feedback controller based on the PID control structure. The effectiveness of this control approach is examined in the control of a third-order plant and a nonlinear plant. Computer simulation results demonstrate that the control performance of the immune-based controller is superior to that of the corresponding linear PID controller.

articleTitle: Fuzzy CMAC and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The cerebellar model articulation controller (CMAC) is a local neural network, which has an attractive property of learning speed. However, its rigid structure makes it difficult to approximate certain functions and apply it to industrial processes. In the paper, we first propose the fuzzy CMAC (FCMAC), which uses the fuzzy weights, and the mapping algorithm and learning algorithm are presented. The numerical example and industrial application results show that the FCMAC neural network proposed in the paper is satisfied and feasible.

articleTitle: Uncertainty measures of roughness of knowledge and rough sets in incomplete information systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper we address uncertainty measures of roughness of knowledge and rough sets by introducing rough entropy in incomplete information systems. We make only one assumption about unknown values: the real value of a missing attribute is one from the attribute domain. However, we do not assume which one. We prove that the rough entropy of knowledge and the rough entropy of rough sets decrease monotonously as the granularity of information grows smaller through finer partitionings. These conclusions are helpful to understand the essence of rough set theory and essential to seek new efficient algorithm of knowledge reduction in incomplete information systems.

articleTitle: Study on multi-objective genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The multi-objective genetic algorithm (MOGA) is an effective approach in solving multi-objective optimization problems. The current multi-objective genetic algorithms are reviewed in the paper, and a new form of MOGA, steady-state non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (SNSGA), is realized by combining the steady-state ideas in single-objective genetic algorithm (SOGA) and the fitness assignment strategy of the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm. The fitness assignment strategy is improved and a new self-adaptive decision scheme of /spl sigma//sub share/ is proposed. This algorithm is proved to be successful with some test problems including the GA difficult problem and the GA deceptive problem.

articleTitle: Variable structure control theory and application: a survey
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The recent development of the variable structure control (VSC) is discussed in this paper. It can be summarized as follows: main theoretical problems of the variable structure control (VSC) are investigated deeply and comprehensively; some new synthesis methods of VSC are presented and are extended to many kinds of systems, thus the distance between theory and practice is much shortened; variable structure control integrates with other control strategies (for example, classical control, adaptive control and fuzzy control, etc.). The key problems for the study of VSC are the robustness and the reduction of chattering. With the development of VSC theoretical research, many real application results are reported recently.

articleTitle: Mind-evolution-based machine learning and applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This work describes the foundation of proposing MEBML (mind-evolution-based machine learning) that was recently presented. Then the paper analyses the performance mechanism of MEBML which is different from GA (genetic algorithm), and its characteristics. With its own distinctive mechanism MEBML improved the efficiency and convergence rate greatly compared with GA. The paper also summarizes the recent development of researches on MEBML, which includes several different strategies of similarity and dissimilarity, the proof of convergence of MEBML and its applications. In addition the authors discuss the future work of MEBML.

articleTitle: Haptic tactile feedback in teleoperation of a multifingered robot hand
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents a teleoperated robot hand system with haptic tactile feedback. This system enables an operator to control a multifingered robot hand while feeling interactions of the robot hand with the remote environment. We have designed a fingertip tactile sensor to capture high resolution and high quality tactile images between the finger-tip and the environment based on the optical total reflection principle. In order to feed back the tactile information to the operator, an electrotactile glove has also been developed. The haptic glove generates excitations when a touch/contact between the fingertips and the environment occurs. We have integrated the tactile sensor and haptic glove into the CUHK five-fingered hand system and examined/demonstrated their performance/effectiveness by experiments.

articleTitle: Mind-evolution-based machine learning: an efficient approach of evolution computation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper analyses mind-evolution-based machine learning (MEBML) that has been proposed recently. The paper first discusses the practical problems in the implement of MEBML in numerical optimization. Then the paper gives the criterion used to judge whether a group is mature, also the paper proposes a adaptive method to adjust the parameters in similar taxis. The results of the experiment of numerical optimization are given. The experiment shows that the global convergence rate and computation efficiency are both improved above 20% compared with standard genetic algorithm. The improvement in convergence rate and efficiency is due to the distinctive structure of MEBML and the introduction of similar taxis and dissimilation.

articleTitle: The method of designing the filter for a class of linear discrete generalized stochastic systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, using the singular value decomposition of matrix and generalized inverse of matrix, the filter for linear discrete generalized stochastic system - Ex(k+1)=Ax(k)+Bu(k)+D/spl omega/(k), y(k)=Cx(k)+/spl upsi/(k)(E and A is not a square matrix), has been studied. Based on this, a new method of designing the Kalman filter for this system is given.

articleTitle: An architecture of agent-based intelligent control systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Intelligent control is an intersectional subject based on a combination of artificial intelligence and automatic control. Agents are a major area of distributed artificial intelligence (DAI) research. From this point of view, this paper discusses the feasibility of agent-based distributed hierarchical intelligent control (ABDHIC). According to the hierarchical structure of intelligent control systems, we put forward the concept of distributed hierarchical intelligent control (DHIC) that blends the division of hierarchical systems and the natural division of distributed control systems. A multiagent system (MAS) was constructed by taking agents as intelligent controllers of DHIC. Contraposing to the characteristic of DHIC, this paper proposed a dominant-subordinate mechanism to coordinate this kind of MAS, analyzed the commonness of agents in the MAS and discussed the agent's compound structure and implementation scheme of the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of electrical faults for switched reluctance motor driver
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper introduces the main electrical faults of an switched reluctance motor drive, which appear in the motor, power converter and rotor position detector. Effects of the electrical faults on the output of the drive are described, and analyses of the fault tolerance are made. Finally, a comparison between the four-phase motor drive and the three-phase motor drive was made with aspect to the current requirement of the normal phases with the fault tolerant control, keeping the output same as in the normal condition.

articleTitle: Studying on path planning and dynamic obstacle avoiding of soccer robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper introduces the optimal way of path planning. A dynamic grids algorithm and a dynamic obstacle avoidance algorithm have been proposed which include the position-forecasting and obstacle checking and controlling methods. An enhanced algorithm, introduced also in the paper, based on both of the technologies, results in simple and effective controlling in the soccer robot tournament.

articleTitle: Application of the zero-crossing rate, LOFAR spectrum and wavelet to the feature extraction of passive sonar signals
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the features extraction of passive sonar signals and classification recognition of underwater target are introduced. Due to the complexity and non-stationary of underwater signals, the zero-cross ratio is first used to initially classify the noise signal; then the LOFAR spectrum reflecting non-stationary signal is extracted, and during which the wavelet transform is carried out for some classes of signals. Finally, a fuzzy ART neural network is constructed to carry out the classification. Results of the experiment show that, for six-class target 147 running environments, 5000 realistic data of ship, the mean correct ratio achieves 89%. The result obtained is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Premature convergence in genetic algorithm: analysis and prevention based on chaos operator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel genetic algorithm containing chaos operator based on the analysis of population diversity and premature convergence within the framework of Markov chain. This algorithm increases the population size dynamically so as to restore the population diversity and prevent premature convergence effectively. Its validity and superiority are illustrated by two applications.

articleTitle: A method for trajectory planning of robot manipulators in Cartesian space
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a technique for robot continuous-path motion trajectories planning in Cartesian space. The motion trajectories are specified by a group of parameter equations in Cartesian coordinates. The time interval [0, T] is divided into m segments, and the coefficients of the polynomial at each segment can be obtained in recurrence form. The problem of minimum time trajectories planning and the determination of m are also studied in the paper.

articleTitle: Chaotic neural networks and their applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Many difficult combinatorial optimization problems arising from science and technology are often difficult to solve exactly. Hence a great number of approximate algorithms for solving combinatorial optimization problems have been developed (Reeves, 1993, Zanakis et al., 1989). Hopfield and Tank (1985) applied the continuous-time, continuous-output Hopfield neural network (CTCO-HNN) to TSP, thereby initiating a new approach to optimization problems. But the Hopfield neural network is often trapped in local minima because of its gradient descent property. A number of modifications have been done on Hopfield neural networks for escaping from local minima. So far, incorporating chaos into the Hopfield neural network has been moved to be a successful approach to improving the convergent property of the HNNs. In this paper, we first review three chaotic neural network models, and then propose a novel approach to chaotic simulated annealing. Second, we apply all of them to a 10 city TSP. The time evolutions of energy functions and outputs of neurons for each model are given. The features and effectiveness of four methods are discussed and evaluated according to the simulation results. We conclude that the proposed neural network with simulated annealing has more powerful ability to obtain global minima than any other chaotic neural network model when applied to difficult combinatorial optimization problems.

articleTitle: Online hand-sketched graphics recognition based on attributed relational graph matching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The recognition of online hand-sketched graphics is studied. First, the attributed relational graph (ARG) representation of online hand-sketched graphics is discussed. And then the pattern similarity measure which is computed by using A* algorithm is defined. Finally, a strategy of model matching and a way of model organizing are proposed in order to improve the recognition speed.

articleTitle: An mind-evolution method for solving numerical optimization problems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: MEBML, mind-evolution-based machine learning presented in Chengyi Sun et al. (1998) has many superior qualities for solving the premature convergence problem of genetic algorithms and non-numerical optimization. The similar taxis and dissimilation operators have some shortcomings and no theoretical analysis method, so that the efficiency is lower. For numerical optimization problems, the construction methods of the similartaxis and dissimilation operators are given in the paper, and the effectiveness is proven through examples.

articleTitle: Application of the mind-evolution-based machine learning in mixture-ratio calculation of raw materials cement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Mind-evolution-based machine learning (MEBML) is an evolutionary computing algorithm. It inherits "colony" and "evolution" of evolutionism. MEBML adopts "similartaxis" and "dissimilation" operators, which possess the more rapid convergence and the higher calculation accuracy. Aiming at a difficult problem for the accurate mixture ratio of raw materials of cement processing, MEBML is proposed, which calculates the mixture ratio of raw materials of cement and overcomes the defects of general calculation methods. The simulation example is given to show that this algorithm not only has a rapid convergence rate and high calculation accuracy, but also has not the prematurity problem of a genetic algorithm. This algorithm can be applied to any mixture ratio calculation of other materials.

articleTitle: Globally stable robust tracking of uncertain systems via fuzzy integral sliding mode control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy integral sliding mode control (FISMC) is proposed to deal with three problems of the conventional sliding mode control: steady state error, robustness and unknown uncertainties during the reaching phase. The design procedure of FISMC controller consists of two steps: first choosing an integral sliding surface, instead of conventional sliding surface, then constructing a sliding mode controller with fuzzy logic control (FLC). It is shown that the global robustness and stability of closed-loop system can be guaranteed with the proposed control strategy. A step tracking control of a longitudinal motion for a helicopter near hover is investigated to show the effectiveness of the new method.

articleTitle: A ship fire alarm system based on fuzzy neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The purpose of a ship fire alarm system is to detect a fire at an earlier stage in the ship and then to give a highly reliable judgement result. The paper presents a multi-sensor fire detection algorithm using two fire parameters (temperature and smoke density). The processing of the sensor signals are carried out by a fuzzy inference system based on a neural network with genetic algorithm learning method. The use of more than one sensor in the fire alarm system provides additional information on the environmental condition and allows a less erroneous alarm between the fire and no-fire case. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Real-time bilateral control of Internet-based teleoperation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The growth of the Internet has been accompanied by an increase in its applications. One of the most interesting of these is teleoperation, where the Internet is used as a bridge between operators and machines. However, teleoperation over the Internet comes with several problems: delay, lost packets and disconnection. All of these limitations may cause instability in teleoperation systems, especially for those systems include haptic feedback. Most of the previous work in Internet based teleoperation rests on many limiting assumptions, for example, time delay is constant or has an upper bound, control is not in real-time. This paper presents a new real time haptic feedback system that deals with these limitations and difficulties without making any assumptions regarding the time delay. The approach is based on the event based control, which has been implemented or a mobile robot over the Internet. The haptic information include real-time feedback of force and video.

articleTitle: Logistic-map chaotic spread spectrum sequences under linear transformation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A typical chaotic system, Logistic Map, is studied under linear transformation. A model, LT-Logistic-Map, is proposed, and its statistical property is derived. The result shows that the model statistical properties are identical with those of white noise. LT-Logistic-Map chaotic sequences are suited for spread spectrum address codes. Using the new model, more chaotic sequences can be generated and the privacy of transmission in the spread spectrum communication system can be enhanced. The experimental results are very close to the theoretical values, which demonstrate that the derivations are effective and reliable.

articleTitle: Application of FTA in operation safety design of nuclear waste carrying manipulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper gives a fault tree analysis on the operation of a carrying manipulator in a storehouse of solidified nuclear waste. By means of improving the man-computer interface and judging program for operation settings, and other measures, the operation validity of the manipulator is raised, and the working safety is insured. The validity of this method is proved by practice.

articleTitle: Nonlinear decentralized robust governor control for hydroturbo-generator sets of multi-machine system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A new approach to nonlinear decentralized robust governor control of hydroturbine generator sets in a power system is discussed. Non-elastic water hammer and disturbances are considered in the model. Based on the differential geometry theory and nonlinear robust control principle, as well as the dynamic feedback method, the nonlinear decentralized robust control law for hydroturbine governors is presented. It is beneficial to implement the proposed controller where the variables appearing in the expression of the proposed control law are all local measurements and independent to network parameters. Moreover, the digital simulation results have manifested the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: An algorithm for common quadratic Lyapunov function
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Using Lyapunov mapping, in this paper a necessary and sufficient condition for a set of linear systems to share a common quadratic Lyapunov function is presented. Based on this condition an algorithm has been developed to search such a Lyapunov function. Theoretical proof for the executability of the algorithm is completed. The algorithm has been coded as a software, which shows the algorithm is very powerful. Several numerical examples, that are produced by the software, are presented to support the algorithm.

articleTitle: Stabilization and equilibrium control of super articulated ball and beam system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Deals with the stabilization and equilibrium control of a super-articulated ball and beam system. On the basis of establishing a mathematical model of the plant, we put forward two kinds of design methods of the controller. The state controller is realized via state feedback, where the unmeasurable states are estimated by a Luenberger reduced order observer. Different to the state control, a cascade structure is used for the fuzzy controller, the more simple definition of fuzzy variables and rules as well as a short execution time are the advantages of this structure. We consider disturbance compensation in the controller designing. Experimental studies are presented at the end of the paper. From the result, we can conclude that the algorithms have high control precision and good stability.

articleTitle: Application of combined neural networks in nonlinear function approximation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Discusses neural networks in combination with mathematical models used to approximate functions whose forms are unknown. The method can speed up the convergence and improve the generalization ability of neural networks. The validity of the method presented is proved by two practical examples.

articleTitle: A study on the convergence of MEBML algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The mind-evolution-based machine-learning (MEBML) algorithm involving a Markov chain is analyzed in continuous state space. By any finite interval approximation, the convergence of similar taxis operation is proved. Meanwhile, the local property of similar taxis operation is shown. To avoid its prematurity, dissimilation operation need to be introduced. With the concept of absorbing field and p-optimal state, the convergence of dissimilation operation is proved. Finally, the functions of similar taxis and dissimilation operations are analyzed with a view to practical application.

articleTitle: Uncertainty network planning technique using the connection number a+bi of set pair analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper uses the connection number a+bi of set pair analysis theory (SPA) to express and process the uncertainties of the time limit caused by fuzzy, random and indeterminate factors in network planning of a large-scale project, and researches the managing and controlling methods of the network planning. The results in the paper illustrate that the network planning and controlling method using the connection number a+bi can provide more useful information such as primary critical paths, secondary critical paths and tertiary critical paths etc. The new uncertainty network planning technique is more flexible and more suitable to the practical application of project than the traditional one.

articleTitle: Research on weather forecast based on neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The traditional method based on aerodynamics and expertise for weather forecast focuses on present data, but the historical database is not utilized. The paper presents research on weather forecasting through the historical database. Because the atmosphere pattern is a complex, nonlinear system, the traditional method is not an effective method. The multi-layer neural network is a potent method for resolving this problem. With the backpropagation neural networks the atmosphere pattern is divided into five patterns based on the rainfall. Comments on this method and a special atmosphere pattern are given at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: The study on the stability of all-coefficient golden section feedback control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper describes the all-coefficient adaptive control theory and its strategy studies the stability of single-variable golden section feedback adaptive control system, presents the constraints on the variable rates of the time-varying parameters when the system is asymptotically stable. Deducing from the research results, the Jury stable criterion can be directly applied to linear slowly time-varying system to judge its stability.

articleTitle: The optimization of PI controller parameters using genetic algorithm in the DC speed control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Given the change of characteristic parameters of the control object, deterioration will result in the dynamic response qualities of the main drive system of a hot finishing mill. This paper studies the optimization of PI parameters, which is adjusted by the improved iterative genetic algorithm, of the speed controller in a two-loop DC speed control system. The digital simulation results show the efficiency and rationality of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Sliding mode model predictive control with terminal constraints
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A new model predictive control scheme is proposed, which combines the receding horizon control and sliding mode variable structure control. By predicting the system states, the pre-designed switching function is predicted, then the control law can be found by solving the constrained open-loop optimal control problem based on the given cost function. The current control is implemented, and at the next sampling time the optimizing procedure is repeated. The proposed scheme has advantage of receding horizon control and sliding mode variable structure control, can deal with constraints online, and has strong robustness on the sliding surface. Furthermore, by constraining terminal sliding mode to be zero, the stability of closed-loop systems is guaranteed. Another scheme, which relaxes equality constraints to inequality constraints, is suggested for less calculation. In addition, the proposed method can be extended to nonlinear systems, and a nonlinear sliding mode predictive control scheme is acquired.

articleTitle: The design of multiobjective fuzzy control algorithm in elevator group control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The essential problem of elevator group control is how to manage the operation of the elevators properly and then to reach the top efficiency; a high efficiency means a shorter waiting time and running time, less crowding, and less power consumption. A good algorithm should be able to select a proper control policy according to the traffic pattern. This paper proposes a new multiobjective elevator group control algorithm based on fuzzy logic, and describes its structure and realization in detail. The algorithm can change the power vector of the multiobjectives automatically. The effectiveness of the algorithm is confirmed by computation result.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis for unknown nonlinear systems via neural networks and its comparisons combinations with RLS based techniques
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An algorithm for the detection and diagnosis of faults in sensors and actuators in unknown nonlinear systems is presented. Firstly the normal operation of the nonlinear system is modelled via a feedforward neural network in order to produce a healthy model which is used later as a redundant relation. A residual signal is evaluated from the difference of the output of the healthy model and that of the system. The estimation of the fault is then computed by minimising the differences between the output of system and that of the healthy neuro model with the help of the gradient descent rule. The algorithm is able to estimate a fault with large magnitude accurately. However, if the fault is small, a linearised healthy model, together with the recursive least squares algorithm, can be used to estimate the fault. As a result, a combination of both methods will provide a powerful technique for accurate fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Layered decision-making and planning in ShaoLing team
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Multi-agent systems in complex, real-time domains require agents to act effectively both autonomously and as a part of a team. Real-time, noisy, collaborative and adversative domains are four characteristics in multi-agent systems. As such, simulated robotic soccer-the RoboCup soccer server-has served as our research test bed; it is a domain which fits all the above characteristics. The paper defines a team member agent architecture which fits the above characteristics. Especially, flexible roles have been used to fit the characteristic of collaborative in robotic soccer. The decision-making is classified in three layers: strategy, tactics, and individual execution. Machine learning and planning are used in the different layers of the decision-making. Using the techniques described, the ShaoLing team was built, which has won a championship in the first competition on RoboCup of China.

articleTitle: A simplified discrete time variable structure control design with alleviation of switching effort
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A sliding mode control method is presented for discrete-time systems. The switching surface is defined by using only output and its delayed signals. In the sliding mode, the closed-loop eigenvalues are proved to be within the unit circle in the z-plane. Therefore, the stability of the control system is guaranteed and robust output performance is ensured with the presented switching surface design. In special cases, a transformation can be made to convert the control system into a form of system with time-delayed inputs. It is verified that the proposed discrete control method indeed assures the robustness against system uncertainties and disturbances.

articleTitle: Task matching and scheduling based on co-evolutionary model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Task matching and scheduling plays an important role in parallel and distributed systems. The efficacy and efficiency of conventional single population-based evolutionary algorithms (CEAs) decrease with the number of independent tasks. By analyzing the mechanism that makes CEA in-scalable, this paper proposes a task matching and scheduling algorithm based on the computational model of cooperative co-evolution, which is inspired by the co-evolutionary phenomena of natural species. Then, we discuss some problems related to the proposed algorithm such as construction of initial population, genetic operators including improved crossover and migration as a kind of mutation, cooperative interactions among species and fitness computation of individual. The algorithm was analyzed mathematically, which shows that the exponential increase index of the co-evolution based scheduling algorithm is higher than that of CEA. Simulation results verify the theoretical result.

articleTitle: The simplification of neural network for quadratic programming problems and its applications in optimal control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, a kind of neural network for quadratic programming problems is first simplified. The simplification is necessary for high accuracy solutions and low cost implementation; the simplified model has high performance. The proposed neural network is used to solve quadratic control problems for discrete linear systems with constraints. The simulation proved the rationality of the results obtained.

articleTitle: Adaptive control of a nonlinear continuous-time chaotic system with uncertainty
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Adaptive control of a nonlinear chaotic system in the presence of model uncertainty is investigated. Control compensation is incorporated into the design of the adaptive controller, and the speed-gradient method is adopted. Simulation demonstrates the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Memoryless robust control of a class of nonlinear uncertain time-delay system in large-domain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The problem of memoryless robust stabilization is discussed for a class of nonlinear uncertain systems with time-varying delay. The time-varying delay is assumed to unknown but known bound. The uncertainties are dependent on the delay states and have known bounds. No matching and Lipschitz's boundedness conditions are required. The continuous state feedback controller is proposed based on the Lyapunov direct methods such that the trajectories of the closed-loop nonlinear uncertain time-delay systems are uniformly and ultimately bounded on a compact set of which the diameter can be made arbitrarily large by choosing design parameters. The authors show that several previous results can be considered as a special cases. The effectiveness of the proposed approaches are demonstrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Design of self-learning multivariable fuzzy controller based on fuzzy sliding-mode
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the definition of fuzzy sliding-mode, a fuzzy control algorithm with generalized control rules and a new controller configuration for dealing with complex multivariable systems is presented. It also keeps the hierarchical self-learning ability without the mathematical model of the controlled plant, and can be easily transferred into practical applications. The experimental simulation results and engineering applications show the effectiveness of the algorithm presented.

articleTitle: The operation supervision management and route guidance for urban taxis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The management mode, organization characteristic and operation manner of the urban taxis are analyzed in detail. Taxis are navigated and located by means of modern advanced technology, such as data communication, navigation and location, computer, artificial intelligence etc., so that operating supervision for urban taxis and timely route guidance can be effectively implemented. In this way, the coordination among the roads, vehicles and drivers for the taxis and supervisors can be enhanced, and the location of the taxis can be monitored. Hence the operation efficiency and safety of vehicular transportation for taxis can be improved, and road traffic congestion can be avoided or reduced.

articleTitle: A new continuous t-norm and its application in fuzzy control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In conventional fuzzy control, MAX and MIN operators are usually adopted, but MIN and MAX operations only consider the extreme elements and ignore the contributions of other elements, which will inevitably affect the control performance. To solve this problem, we presented a new kind of t-norm and t-conorm, which can vary through Lukasiewicz operators, probability operators, and Zadeh operators with a correlation coefficient h ranging from [-1, 1]. On this basis we present simplified AND and OR operators to replace MAX and MIN operators in fuzzy control. In the simulation we use genetic algorithms to optimize the correlation coefficients and the simulation result shows that our method is better than the conventional one.

articleTitle: A PGOPO approach to design linear servomechanism of time-varying systems with time-delay
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on a linear, continuous and bounded operator (PGOPO), a more effective approach and optimal control algorithm than by the block-pulse functions and Walsh functions to design the linear servomechanism of time-varying systems with time-delay is proposed. Some illustrative numerical examples are interpreted to support the technique.

articleTitle: Database oriented information system framework design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper presents the system thinking and methodology of designing the information system framework for mining and applying the information resources economically, and aiming for building the computer integrated manufacturing/processing system (CIM/CIPS) progressively, starting from the analysis of accumulation processes in data and information of an enterprise.

articleTitle: AUV global path planning allowing for ocean current
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Proposes a paradigm, which uses the activity propagation algorithm for autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) global path planning. According to the information of the environment structure, the paradigm effectively combines the grid algorithm with the basic idea of configuration space and solves the problem of pole-like robot path planning under the influence of ocean current. In the process of heuristic search, the evaluation function takes into account both the energy cost and the length of paths. The paradigm proves to be flexible and practicable, and improves the autonomy of the AUV greatly.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of parts production quality control management information system in CIMS environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The method and technique of designing and implementing the parts production quality control management information system in CIMS (computer integrated manufacturing system) are described in this paper, and an effective design technique is introduced.

articleTitle: An active path-planning algorithm based on pattern-classification
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Path-planning is a key technology for mobile robots and its quality has close contact with the whole mobile robot's performance. The shortcoming of the traditional solution based on potential field is that all information is reduced to a resultant force, so that it loses some valuable information of obstacles. Furthermore, it potentially gets into the local minima. In this paper, a new robot's path-planning algorithm by classifying patterns is presented. This algorithm is easy to implement, and it improves the adaptability and reliability of path-planning.

articleTitle: A long-distance high-speed data acquisition and controlling system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Introduces a kind of long-distance real-time data acquisition and control system which is based on a PCI bus. The front PC and data acquisition cards are controlled by a back PC which is located dozens of kilometers away, the two PCs are connected with a fibre optical link. The system uses several error-correction techniques to ensure communication reliability, such as hardware error detection, re-transmission comparison, simple error-correction encoding and decoding, thus the wrong transmission bit rate is greatly reduced and a high information transmission efficiency is achieved. The front PC is supplied by storage power, an effective power-saving method is also designed.

articleTitle: The research to the method of breakdown diagnosis and prediction in aluminum electrolysis process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The breakdowns in aluminum electrolysis have great effect on the quality and quantity of aluminum and cause great waste of electricity. This paper presents a new method to predict and diagnose the breakdowns, which takes the advantage of discrimination and parameter prediction theory. This new method is easy to realize in the computer control systems; this has great significance in improving the quality and quantity of aluminum and in saving the electricity.

articleTitle: A system theoretic foundation for blind system identification and estimation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: H/sub /spl infin// control of overlapping interconnected power systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In terms of the restriction conditions of the inclusion principle and LMI algorithm, an approach of the decentralized robust H/sub /spl infin// controller design is proposed for the multi-area overlapping interconnected power systems, based on the control of two by two area interconnected subsystems. Taking the two-area overlapping interconnected power system as an example, a simulation of the system responds to load step disturbances is presented. The simulation result illustrates, without losing decentralized control capability, the designed controllers improve the robustness of the system and provide the basis for area autonomy decentralized controls, coordination, combined optimization and intelligent control.

articleTitle: Adaptive filter and its application for a kind of nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: For a kind of nonlinear systems, a new adaptive filter is proposed. The error of model linearisation is compensated by fictitious noise compensating technology; noise means and covariance of fictitious noises are estimated by new noise statistic estimators. The effectiveness of the filters described is shown in practical uses.

articleTitle: The invariability of an optimal schedule for single machine total tardiness problem with due date perturbation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The invariability of an optimal schedule for the single machine total tardiness problem with due dates perturbation is discussed. A conclusion is obtained that the range of the due dates in which a given optimal schedule keeps optimal is an interval (i.e. a convex set) when only one job due date varies, and it is not a convex set when multiple jobs due dates vary. Two methods are given to find the interval of any given job due date in which an optimal schedule keep optimal: the dynamic programming algorithm and trial method.

articleTitle: On the qualitative behaviour of solutions of a third order difference equation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Consider the following third order difference equation /spl Delta/(1/b/sub n//spl Delta/(1/a/sub n//spl Delta/x/sub n/))+c/sub n/x/sub n/=0, we study the qualitative property of the above equation, give the global structure of its solutions, and analyze its asymptotic behavior and oscillation.

articleTitle: The new demodulate technology of fiber optics gyroscope
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The measurement of rotation is of considerable interest in a number of areas. It is not only used in aircraft but also in new application fields such as automobile navigation, antenna/camera stabilizer, crane control, unmanned vehicle control. The FOG with scanning phase-shift based on anti-noise filter circuit and improved DSP-software algorithm, and the FOG using scanning phase-shift modulation are presented in the paper. The results of experiment show that the proposed FOG is insensitive to interference intensity and changes of light contrast, the stability of FOG is improved greatly.

articleTitle: Fuzzy logic control of wind pressure of cigarette making technological wind power
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the cigarette making wind power system the characteristic of the pipeline system changes continuously resulting from the variation of densities of cut tobacco. The cut tobacco stem and dust in the pipelines makes the operating wind pressure of the cigarette making machine fluctuate. It is necessary to suppress disturbance as soon as possible and to maintenance a stable wind pressure in order to improve the quality and productivity. However, the system is nonlinear and the characteristic of the pipeline varies continuously, which makes it unsuitable to use the convectional PID control approach or other model based controls. In this article, a self-organizing fuzzy controller with learning ability was employed to improve both the system performance and adaptability. This control strategy was implemented on a small wind power system and the experimental results were satisfactory.

articleTitle: Estimation of reduction in CO/sub 2/ emissions to shift commuters' travel mode from private cars to public transportation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We develop a model for forecasting the amount of CO/sub 2/ emission due to urban commute travel. The model consists of three sub-models: a sub-model for estimating the number of commuters, a fuzzy mode choice sub-model and a sub-model for estimating the amount of CO/sub 2/ emission. Using this model, we analyze and forecast the effect of policies to shift the commuters' travel mode from private cars to public transportation for decreasing the amount of CO/sub 2/ emission.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy pattern recognition to electrical apparatus evaluation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We discuss pattern recognition models of electrical apparatus evaluation, by the application of fuzzy maths and online dynamic properties. From the example of a CJ20-100A AC contactor and the application of fuzzy maths to its synthetic evaluation eigenvalues, a pattern recognition model which is suitable for evaluation of electromagnetic apparatus, is figured out to be significant for the development and production of electromagnetic apparatus.

articleTitle: Feature extraction and selection of neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents the feature extraction and feature selection methods for the wood veneer inspection application using neural network classifiers. The paper emphatically describes the statistical method of feature extraction and feature selection. The intra-class variation, inter-class variation and feature correlation are introduced to measure the discriminatory power of the wood veneer image.

articleTitle: Optimization for a class of self-adaptation neuro-fuzzy models and its application to CSTR modeling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We study the model structure and parameter optimization for Takagi-Sugeno type neuro-fuzzy models based on the statistical information criteria, matrix singular value decomposition, rule elimination method and rule merging methods. Some novel parameter self-adaptation algorithms are presented in this paper, which can be used to modify cluster center values, cluster radius values and parameters of consequent functions of the neuro-fuzzy models. The neuro-fuzzy model and methods presented have been successfully applied to modeling a continuous stirred tank reactor (CSTR).

articleTitle: A robust adaptive controller based on neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a robust adaptive neural network controller for an uncertain nonlinear system. The controller is realized by correcting the predicted-output of the neural network and using the idea of optimization and network identifier. The simulation results show that the system has strong ability against disturbance.

articleTitle: Optimal arrangement of error sensors in AANC system based on the genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: During the course of adaptive active noise control (AANC), the final noise cancelling effect of the AANC is in close relationship with the arrangements of error sensors. In this paper, the problems of optimizing positions of error sensors were investigated by using the genetic algorithm (GA), which are difficult to be solved by using the conventional gradient search method. The computer simulations show that the optimal positions found by the GA coincide with the theoretically calculated results.

articleTitle: Some aspects of synchronization in coupled systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper reviews and proposes some theoretical problems in the synchronization theory of coupled dynamical systems.

articleTitle: On the Lyapunov control of a typical nonlinear chaotic system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, we develop a feedback control method for a typical nonlinear chaotic dynamic system, which is of the so-called Lyapunov-type. We discuss the development of the feedback control strategies, and show that the approach can suppress the typical chaotic motion toward any given smooth orbit, including a fixed point or a periodic orbit. Some simulation examples support the developed methods.

articleTitle: A genetic-algorithm-and-table-rotating-based method for optimizing fuzzy control rules
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: It has been demonstrated many times in practice that fuzzy logic controllers have an important role in rule-based expert systems. However, it is essential for a fuzzy logic controller to have an appropriate set of rules to perform at the desired level. The linguistic structure of the fuzzy logic controller allows a tentative linguistic policy to be used as an initial rule base. At the design stage, if one can assemble a reasonably good collection of rules, it may then be possible to tune these rules to improve the controller performance. In the paper, a genetic-algorithm-and-table-rotating-based method for optimizing fuzzy control rules and the simulation result are presented. Finally, the results are discussed.

articleTitle: Bid mechanism and sensitivity for deregulated power markets
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Sensitivity analysis for electric power markets is very important since it can provide useful information for designing bidding strategies. By analysis of the market mechanism, a model is developed in the paper to calculate the deviation of the market clearing price due to changes of bid curves. Numerical test results show that the model can catch market price deviation and is useful for optimizing bidding strategy.

articleTitle: Online intelligent system for operation support
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
