publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents a novel formulation for integrated bidding and hydrothermal scheduling, where the market clearing price (MCP) is modeled as a Markov chain and the risks are directly formulated in the objective function in terms of MCP variances. The self-scheduling requirements and interactions between the energy and reserve markets are considered. A Lagrangian relaxation based algorithm is then developed to solve this problem, and a stochastic dynamic programming approach is developed to solve the unit subproblems. Since the bidding of pumped-storage units plays important roles in both the energy and reserve markets, and significantly affects thermal biddings, it is the focus in this paper. Effects of self-scheduling constraints, risk management and reserve market on the energy bidding strategies are analyzed. Numerical testing based on an 11-unit system in New England shows that the method can generate energy and reserve bid curves in 4-5 minutes, and risks of buying power at high market price are effectively reduced.

articleTitle: Agent architecture: a survey on RoboCup-99 simulator teams
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: RoboCup is an attempt to foster AI and robotics research by providing a common task for evaluation of various theories, algorithms, and agent architectures. In the RoboCup simulation league, software agents play soccer games on an official soccer server over the network. When constructing these software agents, issues in area of agent architecture arise to satisfy the properties specified by agent theorists. This paper presents an overview of the agent architectures used in the simulator teams in RoboCup-99. Many types of agent architectures are reported and compared. We also provide some open questions for discussion and give some possible answers to be verified in the near future.

articleTitle: Sensor fusion: the application of soft computing in monitoring and control for railroad maintenance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We attempt to identify which sensor fusion techniques are among the most promising ones. The starting point of our discussion is the observation that the added value of fusion of similar sensors must originate from a nonlinear combination of sensor data streams. This observation naturally gives rise to the application of nonlinear models, e.g., from the area of soft computing, viz. fuzzy logic, neural networks and evolutionary programming. At Strukton a sensor fusion approach for railroad maintenance management has been adopted, in which an integrated approach towards sensor optimization, sensor management, and early fusion is pursued. In this way one may hope to attain the goal of sensor fusion, viz. an improved situation assessment and early warning to trigger preventative maintenance.

articleTitle: Flow and congestion control: modeling and analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In order to model and analyze the data traffic behaviors with feedback mechanism in high-speed data communication system, we start from the feedback control model proposed by Izmailov (1996), which is based on differential delay equations. However, instead of specifying the processing rate to be constant, we extend it to a general functional model. We also add a random item for describing the uncertainties in a real communication system. We analyze the stability of the system with these models. Theoretically, the results show that the system can be stabilized and that the buffer size can be controlled even if the system is suffering from a large delay or has variations in its delay, or if some other uncertain situations are present.

articleTitle: High precision observer of an induction motor with variable structure control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents a new observer for an induction motor, the nonlinear time-variant multivariable system. The method uses only the stator current to observe simultaneously the speed and the rotor current. The law of Lyapunov-stability underlies the observer. During the design, a variable structure term is introduced to counteract the uncertain terms, which leads the condition of Lyapunov-stability is satisfied. Consequently the good properties of the observer, such as the strictly asymptotical convergence, high precision and the robustness against the parameter variation, are ensured by the theoretical analysis. The simulations show the feasibility and the good performance of the observer.

articleTitle: GA-based multi-objective optimization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Proposes a hybrid algorithm for finding a set of multi-solutions of multi-objective optimization problems. In the proposed algorithm, a genetic algorithm is adopted to solve the multi-modal function optimization problem, a local search procedure is applied to each solution generated by genetic operations. The aim of the proposed algorithm is not only to determine the global optimal solution, but also to try to find all the non-dominated solutions of a multi-objective optimization problem. The choice of the final solution set is left to the decision maker's preference. High search ability of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Satisfactory output-feedback for discrete systems with pole and output variance constraints
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Pole location and output variance are important dynamic and steady performance indices respectively for some engineering systems. The consistency of circular pole and output-variance upper bound constraints is firstly studied for a class of stochastic output-feedback systems. Via LMI approach, a good range is presented for the output-variance upper bound which is consistent to the pre-specified pole index. Then an LMI-based method is proposed to obtain a satisfactory control for the systems under given consistent constraint indices.

articleTitle: Estimation of attraction domain and exponential convergence rate of continuous feedback associative memory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We revisit the study of the attraction domain of memory patterns and exponential convergence rate of the network trajectory memory patterns for the continuous feedback associative memory by using some analysis techniques and the Lyapunov method. Some new estimation results are obtained and can be used for the evaluation of fault-tolerance capability and synthesis procedures of continuous feedback associative memory networks.

articleTitle: A finite horizon scheduling model based on optimal inventory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An optimal production and setup scheduling model is discussed in an inflexible manufacturing system with jump Markov disturbances consisting of a single machine. The system can produce several types of products, but at any given time it can only produce one type of product. A setup (with setup time or cost or both) is required if production is to be switched from one type of product to another. The objective of the problem is to minimize the costs of setup, production, and inventory. The decision variables are a sequence of setups and the production plan. The optimality condition in the case of finite horizon based on the optimal inventory is also addressed.

articleTitle: Research into quasi-decentralised control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Quasi-decentralised control for complex systems is proposed in the paper. Different forms of input-output participation factors (IOPFs) are also introduced mainly to help to determine a suitable decentralised or, if necessary, a quasi-decentralised stabilising scheme. IOPFs can be used to identify practically fixed modes which cannot be detected by the most existing mathematical tools, and to compare the effectiveness of different input-output pairs. The proposed concepts and approaches are illustrated by a power system stabiliser design problem for a sample system. Two other applications of IOPFs and some suggested future research are also presented.

articleTitle: Automatic Chinese text error correction approach based-on fast approximate Chinese word-matching algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A fast approximate Chinese word-matching algorithm is presented. The algorithm can be used to implement the Chinese fuzzy-matching conception. Based on the algorithm, an automatic Chinese text error correction approach using confusing-word substitution and language model evaluation is designed. Compared with Zhang's (1994) confusing-character substitution method, this new approach can deal with not only character substitution errors but also insertion, deletion and string substitution errors. Besides, the algorithm can handle Chinese "non-word" error, making it possible and easy to establish a two-level structure in Chinese spelling correction.

articleTitle: Adaptive predictive control for bilinear systems with model indeterminacy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An adaptive predictive controller is proposed for SISO bilinear systems with model indeterminacy by a combined input/output linearization method with linear predictive control. The normal RLS algorithm is used to estimate the adaptive parameters online. This new controller makes perfect control performance and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Trajectory planning of robot manipulators by using spline function approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a method for trajectory planning of robot manipulators by using a spline function approach. The motion of each joint of the robot is specified by a set of spline functions. The method is simple and needs less computation. In addition, the singular-point problems can not appear in the proposed method. So the method can be used to generate a smooth, steady and noiseless trajectory of robots.

articleTitle: A rotary machinery fault diagnosis approach based on rough set theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Rotary machinery fault diagnosis can be treated as a pattern classification task. Based on the vibration characteristic spectrum, a rotary machinery fault diagnosis approach using the rough set theory is proposed. Accurate diagnostic results can be obtained directly from a set of complete fault spectrum samples; satisfactory diagnostic results can also be derived from a set of incomplete fault spectrum samples using the approach. The inherent redundancy in the spectrum information is revealed. The approach presents a new idea to rotary machinery fault diagnosis based on incomplete characteristics. Examples show that the proposed approach is very effective.

articleTitle: Pollution control of a large scale water-drainage-area system with delay
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the setting of auto monitoring of the water quality in the Huizhou-Dongan reach of the East River in GuangDong Province in which it has multi-sections and multi-inputs of sullage, a practical mathematic description of the control system with multi-delays is presented. The Lyapunov equivalence method of interconnected stabilization of the linear constant control system with validity and practicability of stability analysis, and the design method of stability control, are given.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting using neural networks combined with linear models
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents a short-term load forecasting approach for power systems. This approach combines neural networks with linear models. The electric load is assumed to consist of several components. Some components are described with linear models, and the others are captured with multilayer feedforward neural networks. The combination of neural networks with linear models brings the advantages of each to this short-term load forecasting approach. After training with adequate policies, each component model describes the corresponding load component. This ensures the robustness of the forecasting approach. Testing this approach with load and weather data reveals satisfactory performance with mean absolute percentage error of 3.14% for ahead-time within one day and 3.70% for ahead-time within one week.

articleTitle: Problems in GA and necessities of importing immune function
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Genetic algorithm (GA), as an effective method of functional optimization and combinatorial optimization for planning and scheduling problems, is showing its wider application prospects. However, the average GAs are confronted with a few inevitable issues. These issues not only seriously influence the efficiency of GA operations, but also seriously limit the application range of GAs. This article put forward a kind of GA with immune function, and its efficiency is showed by an example.

articleTitle: Global smooth time-varying exponential stabilization of nonholonomic chained form systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: It is well known that nonholonomic chained form systems cannot be stabilized by continuous pure state feedback. The solutions include time-varying feedback stabilization and discontinuous time-invariant feedback stabilization. Most of the existing time-varying control results suffer from the drawback that the designed control laws are very complex. Moreover, the control laws using smooth time-varying feedback do not stabilize the system with exponential convergence rate. It is pointed out that controlling nonholonomic chained form systems with discontinuous controls may be difficult to implement. In this paper smooth time-varying feedback control laws, which globally stabilize the system with exponential convergence rate, are developed. Besides the advantage of design simplicity, the convergence rate of each state can be specified in a prior. The method has no constraints on the initial value of states. The simulation results show the efficiency of this method.

articleTitle: Development of the computerised management system of production control in EAF steel making factory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The computerised management system of production control in Fu Shun Special Steel Company has been developed for improving the production management, reducing the production cost, and increasing the production efficiency. The system kernel is the production planning, and the production control management is based on the liquid steel temperature and work schedule. The system provides the functions that includes online supervision of each production equipment status, periodic liquid steel temperature prediction, real time status displays and historical data query.

articleTitle: Dynamic bit-rate estimation and control for constant-quality communication of video
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In video communications, the complexity of image contents, the available bit-rate for communication, and the quality of video are all closely related. The paper describes a quality control scheme for a variable-bit-rate (VBR) video encoder. The Bayesian estimation approach is used to establish a bit-rate prediction model. The model defines the required bandwidth for a future frame according to prior information and performs a posterior estimation after the bit-rate of the new frame is determined. When the estimated bit-rate exceeds a certain threshold, adjustment to the quantization parameters has to be made such that the quality of the video is kept constant.

articleTitle: Design and control of flexible transfer system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The flexible transfer system (FTS) is a self-organizing manufacturing system composed of autonomous robotic modules which transfer a palette carrying the machining parts. For the control of FTS, two functional requirement must be considered: one is the optimization problem of the system performance such as the amount of transported material; and the other one is the realization of the adaptability to dynamical environmental changes by unexpected machining problems or sudden changes of the machining task. In this article, we propose a centralized and distributed control method for the FTS, and discuss how to realize both the efficiency and flexibility.

articleTitle: Optimal guaranteed cost control for a class of linear uncertain time-delay systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Studies the optimal guaranteed control problem for a class of linear uncertain time-delay systems. The systems under consideration are described by state differential equations with time-varying unknown but norm-bounded uncertain parameters and time-varying unknown but bounded delay in states. An upper bound of the performance measured by standard quadratic function is constructed and based on the delay-dependent stabilizing approach, a method of designing a state feedback robust quadratic stabilizing control law guaranteeing this quadratic performance index be less than the constructed upper bound is derived. A procedure is given to select an optimal state feedback controller in the sense of minimizing this upper bound of the quadratic performance index. The results depend on the size of delay and are given in terms of several linear matrix inequalities.

articleTitle: Identification of MIMO nonlinear system based on Volterra kernel matrices
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Volterra series representation for general MIMO nonlinear systems is discussed, and the existence conditions of Volterra kernel matrices are given and proved. Two identification methods of Volterra kernel matrices, which are the random response method and the pulse response method, are presented. The calculating formula of Volterra kernel matrices by using input and output signals is presented. Finally, the methods are validated by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Prediction principle and realization of coal and gas outburst electromagnetic radiation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Analyzes the distributing characteristics of coal and gas outburst electromagnetic radiation signal's power spectrum theoretically, and the signal's connection with the radiation resource, introduces the hardware construct and main characteristics of the monitor equipment for coal and gas outbursts and electromagnetic emission. This monitor equipment has been put into practice in a coal mine, which provides correct original data for the analysis and forecast of coal and gas outbursts.

articleTitle: A knowledge discovery algorithm based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Data mining is a new hot research subject in the database field. However, in general, data mining acquires knowledge from large quantities of data. In this paper, we discuss a new knowledge discovery from database algorithm based on genetic algorithm, called GAKDK (genetic algorithm based knowledge discovery from knowledge). This algorithm is based on the crossover and mutation between knowledge trees. It can retrieve undiscovered knowledge from raw rules.

articleTitle: Inverse kinematic analysis of general 5R serial robot based on Sylvester linear transformation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the Sylvester linear transformation theory, a general method for inverse kinematic analysis of 5R serial robot is proposed in this paper. Using this method, a polynomial equation which contains only one variable and no extraneous roots can be derived from 3 original kinematic equations, whereas the traditional method needs 4 equations. The assembly condition of 5R manipulator (5R loop) and its application in kinematic analysis are discussed. This assembly condition is very useful for finding 6R manipulator's real configuration.

articleTitle: Delay dependent guaranteed cost control for linear uncertain time delay systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The problem of designing state feedback guaranteed cost control laws is studied for a class of linear uncertain time-delay systems. By using the linear matrix inequality approach, the existence conditions are derived and a parametrized representation of the delay-dependent guaranteed cost controllers is presented. Furthermore, a convex optimization problem with LMI constraints is formulated to design the optimal guaranteed cost controller.

articleTitle: BP based soft measurement of flash point of lubrication oil
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Energy optimal control of solvents recovery device is to minimize the stream consumption of unit product (lubrication oil), and to assure product quality at the same time. The flash point, which is the quality index of product, must be realized online real-time measurement, to assure real-time modeling and closed-loop optimal control of the ketone-benzol de-waxing device. Based on the special nonlinear mapping function of BP neural networks, a kind of soft measurement technology is created to predict the flash point. Its input are assistant variables, its output is the main variable, and the soft measurement is realized by network learning. It is pointed out that the space distribution of learning samples and learning methods largely affects the characteristics of the ANN. For large-scale complex process, multiple networks and local learning method are applied to avoid too much neural units and too slow learning speed. Actual application result obtained proves its effectiveness.

articleTitle: An application of expert system to equipment operation of 500 kV substation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An intelligent approach to generating switching sequences for the 500 kV Shuanglong substation is presented. A method for developing a practical expert system is presented, which uses the technologies of facility modeling, network topology, SCADA information, special expert knowledge database, hierarchical inference engine and so on. To solve the main problem of "state recognition" and "state change", an online network topology analysis algorithm is used to replace an inefficient special rule. So the proposed expert system has high intelligence and a good recognition ability of the run mode of the facility. The node-model and bus-model for the primary device and the incident-model for the secondary device are created. The real time SCADA information is utilized. A multi-production system is used to implement the knowledge expression for the expert system. Having designed an explanation engine, the inference process and the used rules can be explained in detail. The system has been used at the 500 kV Shuanglong substation, Jinhua, Zhejiang, since May 1999.

articleTitle: Transfer alignment from airplane GPS/MINS integrated system to SAR strapdown navigator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern science and technology, higher resolution images from an airborne synthetic aperture radar (SAR) are required, so, more accurate motion compensation needs to be applied to the radar returns to reduce image degradation which is caused by spurious motion of the antenna phase center (APC). The paper studies an improved SAR motion compensation system (SARMCS), which includes a master INS (inertial navigation system) and a GPS receiver located near the mass center of the aircraft, and a slave low cost strapdown IMU (inertial measurement unit) mounted on the antenna structure. A Kalman filter is an integral part of the SARMCS; it acts to continuously transfer alignment from a high accuracy GPS/MINS integrated navigation system to the less stable strapdown navigator. Simulation results show the absolute velocity error of the strapdown navigator is smaller than 0.3 m/s and the absolute attitude error of the strapdown navigator is smaller than 180 arcsec. So this SARMCS is effective.

articleTitle: Design and control of flexible transfer system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Research on intelligent decision support system for virtual cooperation partner choosing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The key decision link of virtual cooperation selection brings new challenges to enterprises. They are the dynamic behavior of partner combination, multi-variety of evaluative indexes, and the actual effect of evaluative selection. On the basis of analyzing selected strategic features of the virtual cooperative partner, the article puts forward the topology of a reconstruction mechanism evaluative model and synergetic evaluation with a multi-intelligence system. Finally a total structure model of an intelligent decision support system for virtual cooperation partner selection is set up.

articleTitle: Designing neural networks based on structure decomposition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper discusses the theory and methods for structure decomposition of multioutput feedforward neural nets, i.e., whether a feedforward neural net can be decomposed and how to decompose it. We find that such decomposition does exist, and in a decomposed system each subnet will have fewer hidden units, so the system will generalize well. Based on above theory, we propose two methods for designing neural nets: structure decomposition based weight decay method (SDBWD) is a pruning algorithm and structure decomposition based dynamic nodes creation (SDBDNC) is a construction method. These two methods show better performance on coal mixing and multiconcept learning examples.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm approach to more consistent and cost effective unit commitment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Genetic algorithms (GAs) have been demonstrated to be an effective technique to solve the unit commitment (UC) problem due to its capability in dealing with mixed-integer problems and ease in handling constraints. However, it is clearly indicated that GAs exhibit two major drawbacks in solving the problem which excludes them from real-time applications: one is their slow processing speed, and the other is their solution inconsistency from different GA runs. This paper proposes a mechanism to solve the UC problem with GAs so that the solution variation is reduced from run to run and the solution speed can be improved. The effectiveness of the proposed method is illustrated on a 6-generator system.

articleTitle: Sliding mode control technique for chaotic systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A sliding mode control technique is presented to suppress a class of chaotic systems whose nonlinearity vanishes on a sliding surface, a method of pole replacement is used to design the sliding mode and an exponent approaching law controller is used in order to guarantee high quality of controlled systems. Theory and experiments show that this technique is robust and the equilibrium jitter can be reduced.

articleTitle: A method of wavelet-based edge detection with data fusion for multiple images
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Edges of an image reflect the main information of the image and contain the basic character. Several images of the same area from multisensor are fused together to maintain most of details, restrain noise of the images and enhance the rate of detection. Edges are extracted from the fused result image. The method of image fusion and edge detection based on wavelet transform is described. This method is proved to be effective.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy rule-based hierarchical intelligent control in mill system of thermal power plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on analyzing the characteristics and the control tasks of the storage pulverized-coal mill system, the paper describes a fuzzy rule-based intelligent control strategy and applies it to the start-stop and running control of the storage pulverized-coal mill system. The application to the 200 MW unit indicates that manual operation is reduced dramatically and the performance is improved greatly after it has been put into use.

articleTitle: Modeling method of machine joints' tangential contact damping based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: To realize the unified modeling of machine joints' tangential contact damping under multijoint conditions, the description method of the basic influencing factors' characteristics of machine joints' tangential contact damping is discussed. Then, the concepts of dynamic-intelligent neuron, generalized-intelligent BP network and generalized intelligent BP algorithm are proposed. On this basis, the unified modeling method of machine joints' tangential contact damping under multijoint conditions is put forward based on artificial neural network technology. This is proved feasible by the given modeling example. This modeling method has the characteristics of both a traditional modeling method and the building of a database.

articleTitle: The advances of multi-agent system (MAS)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A multi-agent system constitutes a focus of distributed artificial intelligence (DAI). We first introduce some concepts of an agent and a multi-agent system (MAS), and then describe the structure of the MAS's organization. We also discuss the main research areas in MAS, such as, communication, collaboration and coordination, machine learning, its dynamical characteristic etc.

articleTitle: The research on knowledge management and knowledge portal framework based on agent mechanism
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: With the fast development of information techniques, the problem of processing and transferring information with low efficiency is improved. But another problem is arising, in which the scarcity of knowledge and the creating ability for knowledge become the bottlenecks of the social and economic development. The concept of knowledge management (KM) is presented to improve the organization and utilization of information and knowledge. The concept of knowledge management and the difference between KM and information management (IM) are studied in the paper. After analyzing and extracting the key problem in KM, the concept of a knowledge portal is presented. A knowledge portal framework based on an agent mechanism is presented with further analysis on the function demand of the knowledge portal. The primary analysis and design of the function and structure of the framework are introduced and the general structure of agent is proposed.

articleTitle: A modified genetic algorithm based on the best schema and its application for function optimization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The genetic algorithm (GA) is a wildly employed evolutional algorithm in the field of combinatorial optimization. Criticism of this approach includes slow speed and premature result during the convergence procedure. Through introducing new crossover and mutation operators based on the best scheme, the paper proposes a more efficient method to improve its performance not only with quicker convergence speed but also with more opportunity to reach a global optimal value. Finally, the paper demonstrates its effectiveness by an example of a multi-peak function optimization problem.

articleTitle: Measures of fuzziness and entropy of fuzzy information
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Vagueness of knowledge results from the imprecision and uncertainty of knowledge. In fuzzy theory, much attention has being paid to the measure of fuzziness of a fuzzy subset, while entropy, as a measure of uncertainty, plays a significant role in the field of information theory. The paper discusses, when there is or not a probability distribution on the non-empty definite universe U, the measure of fuzziness and entropy of a fuzzy subset and the conditional fuzzy entropy of a fuzzy subset, when there exists additional probability information and fuzzy information.

articleTitle: Generalized predictive control based on error correction using the dynamic neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Considering the influence of modelling error on the robustness of nonlinear predictive control, the paper proposes a generalized predictive control algorithm based on error correction using the dynamic backpropagation network, the algorithm has dynamic compensation capability so that the dynamic error of the model can be effectively reduced and the modelling accuracy can be raised. The simulation results show the algorithm is effective for nonlinear systems.

articleTitle: An improved learning rule for a neuron controller in a quick locating system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: As an important branch of intelligent control, neural network control (NNC) is used in many kinds of high performance systems more and more widely. However, there are many parameter decisions, which is perplexing in system design. It is very important for a neural network controller, such as a single neuron controller, to make a suitable decision of learning rate, weighing factors, attenuation factor and sampling period. The paper presents a design of a neuron controller (NC) using the method of learning rate self-setting and applies the improved NC to a quick locating system. The comparisons of the system performance before and after using the method of learning rate self-setting are made. The simulation results show the improved NC is effective and feasible and the system performance is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Multivariable model-free neurocontrol for a unit power plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A multivariable model-free neurocontrol method based on diagonal superiority is proposed in the paper. The coordination control system is designed for a unit power plant integrating a boiler, a turbine generator and electricity in itself and simulation tests of a unit power plant coordination control are made. The results show that the neurocontrol method has very strong adaptability, robustness and satisfied performances even if the plant dynamic characteristics change greatly. This multivariable method is very simple and can be easily used in practice.

articleTitle: PID-augmented adaptive control of a gyro mirror LOS system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, a composite control scheme using a synergy of PID and adaptive control is proposed. Adaptive control provides an adaptive feedforward control signal, while the PID provides feedback control for robustness against both parametric and nonparametric modeling errors. Conditions for the stability of the proposed control system are derived and provided in the paper. The control scheme developed is relevant to general nonlinear systems. In this paper, it is specifically implemented and demonstrated on a gyro mirror line-of-sight (LOS) system.

articleTitle: A novel multi-agent Q-learning algorithm in cooperative multi-agent system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Q-learning can provide a robust and natural means for agents to learn how to coordinate their action choices in multi-agent systems. We examine some of the factors that can influence the dynamics of the learning process in such a setting. We first distinguish reinforcement learners that are unaware of (or ignore) the presence of other agents from those that explicitly attempt to learn the value of joint actions and the strategies of their counterparts. We study Q-learning in cooperative multi-agent systems under these two perspectives, focusing on the convergence to Nash equilibrium. We propose an exploration strategy to increase the likelihood of convergence to an optimal equilibrium.

articleTitle: A modular DSP system for use in embedded electro-optical applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper describes the development and application of a modular digital signal processing (DSP) system using the 2101 analog devices processor. Two noncontact applications are described: the measurement of pipe cross-sections and 3D measurement using multiple camera views.

articleTitle: Decentralized H/sub /spl infin// control for interconnected large-scale systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The problem of decentralized H/sub /spl infin// control for interconnected large-scale systems is considered, and a complete design approach for a local state-feedback decentralized H/sub /spl infin// controller is proposed. The solution for local controllers is carried out merely by iteratively solving a set of local algebraic Riccati equations. Finally, the effectiveness of the approach is verified by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Digital finite-precision controller realizations with sparseness considerations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a study on the finite word length (FWL) implementation of digital controller structures. The relevant FWL closed-loop stability related measures are investigated, and an algorithm is provided to search for the sparse controller realization that yields a computationally efficient structure with good FWL closed-loop stability performance. A numerical example is included to illustrate the proposed design procedure.

articleTitle: Using genetic algorithm to optimize autonomous and cooperative behaviors of multiple mobile robots system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: To exploit the advantages of a multiple mobile robots system, the robots must have some degree of autonomy and cooperation. However, autonomy and cooperation are contradictory to each other, which makes it difficult to optimize the control parameters of robot's behaviors manually. Genetic algorithms are used in the paper to solve this problem. By altering the weightings of the autonomy and cooperation measures, the robots can exhibit different "personalities", which is testified by a simulation experiment.

articleTitle: An improved recursive prediction error algorithm for training recurrent neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, a fast and effective learning algorithm for training recurrent neural networks, which is realized by introducing and improving the recursive prediction error (RPE) method, is proposed. The improving scheme for RPE algorithm is adding a momentum term in the gradient of Gauss-Newton search direction and using the changeable forgetting factor. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm achieves far better convergence performance than the classical backpropagation with the momentum term algorithm, and has superior performance compared with the conventional RPE algorithm.

articleTitle: The research of automatic indexing system for Chinese archives
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper introduces the method of automatic indexing for Chinese archives. The authors have made some researches on the algorithms of subject indexing and classification indexing. The weight function of indexing descriptors and the thesaurus of keywords-descriptors are organized in a logical way. The fuzzy relation is used in the classification indexing of archives.

articleTitle: An algorithm of locating laser spot center
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Because of the influence of various factors, laser spot intensity distributes nonuniformly, so that the deviation between the geometric center and the intensive center of the spot is relevant in large-scale ranging based on optical triangulation. The conventional methods of locating spot center are then unsuitable. According to the feature that the better part of circle spot can be obtained by the image of spot, a new algorithm based on Hough transform (HT) for locating laser spot center is presented. The experimental results show the method can effectively raise the measuring precision of distance.

articleTitle: Discovery of sequential patterns from large database in supply chain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: There exist some kinds of sequential patterns in several supply chain echelons, such as production, distribution, etc. The Bill of materials is a simple static example of such cases, which has multiple levels but is dependent on the time in the production stage. Sequential patterns mining from large business database is a hot topic in database system and modern business management. Previous work was focused on searching efficient algorithms of mining sequential patterns. Since most of the algorithms need to scan the database for many times, this cannot be resisted because the size of the database is often very large. In the paper, we first give the modeling description of the distribution stage in supply chain, and then discuss the necessary of the sequential pattern mining. Finally, an effective algorithm in the solution of mining sequential patterns is introduced.

articleTitle: Using the Markov chain of the best individual to analyze convergence of genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The convergence analyses of genetic algorithms by applying the Markov chains of populations usually depend on the representation of solutions. This paper models the homogeneous finite Markov chain of the best individual in populations, and presents a precise definition of the global convergence of genetic algorithms according to the limit distribution of the chain. Two unified decision theorems about the global convergence are proposed and proved strictly, which are independent of representation and selection mechanism. The results of analysing the convergence of different genetic algorithms illustrate that the unified decision theorems are generally practical.

articleTitle: A method of local enhancement based on fuzzy set theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Due to the effect of illumination, some image contrasts are often not uniform. Image enhancement becomes an important problem in these images processing. This paper presents a method of local enhancement based on the fuzzy set theory to improve the image contrast. The method includes the following three steps: 1) the image is divided into sectors; 2) a kind of fuzzy enhancement method is implemented on each sector; and 3) the maximum and minimum gray levels are constants within sectors, but different for the various sectors. Finally, we re-divide the image into sectors with more pixels, and repeat step 1 and 2, until the whole image includes only one sector. Experimental result shows that the method of local enhancement based on fuzzy enhancement is better than the conventional fuzzy methods.

articleTitle: An approach of keyword spotting based on HMM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Keyword spotting is one of important topics in speech recognition. The paper presents a model of keyword spotting and the training method of relevant keyword models and anti-words models, then we give a strategy of keyword spotting. Experiment indicates the strategy is effective.

articleTitle: Relay feedback PID auto-tuning: algorithm and application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Describe a PID auto-tuning algorithm based on relay feedback. By placing test signals on the process to make it surge stably and continuously, we can obtain the process data with which to calculate the critical gain and critical surge period, then proper PID parameters can be computed with the improved Ziegler-Nichols formula. Some software based on this algorithm has run successfully on some large industrial equipment for over 7 years.

articleTitle: Synchronizing of friction-hoisting mechanisms mounted symmetrically on both sides of rope suspended robot with fuzzy logic control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The robot, which is used for high building cleaning, hoists frictionally up and down along wall by means of the friction between two friction-wheels mounted on both sides of the frame and steel ropes which are suspended on the top of the building. In order to keep the frame in horizontal so that the robot can work smoothly, the two hoist mechanisms on both sides of the frame must be run synchronously. This paper discusses the design of the detector, which is used to measure the declining angle of the frame caused by nonsynchronal running of hoisting mechanisms, and fuzzy controller, which is used to harmonize the friction-hoisting mechanisms. The result of experiment shows that fuzzy controller can keep hoisting mechanisms running synchronously and hold the frame's posture in horizontal and the method is feasible and satisfied.

articleTitle: Computer integrated control for fermentation workshop
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper introduces the computer integrated control for fermentation workshop realized by distributed control system. According to the dynamic characteristics of various plants in workshop, authors use the corresponding control methods to realize automatic control, also sequence control for production process. Especially, Smith predictors and multivariable method for frequency domain are firstly used for fermentation temperature control. Thereby, automatic level for beer production is raised and the operators are decreased, but output and quality of beer are improved.

articleTitle: Expert system of fault diagnosis based on the neural network and regulations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: After pointing out the limitations of expert system and neural network respectively, this article gives a model of fault diagnostic expert system which unifies the neural network and production rules. It also improves the BP neural network model and drives a global optimum algorithm that improves the ability of network. Practical applications prove that this method can solve the fault diagnostic problem of multi-fault and multi-procedure complicated mechanical devices.

articleTitle: Design and control of flexible transfer system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Pole assignment for infinite dimensional generalized systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Many results have been obtained in the study of finite dimensional generalized systems, and the relation monographs have been published. However, only few results have been obtained in the study of infinite dimensional generalized systems. In this paper, the problem of state feedback and pole assignment for infinite dimensional generalized systems is discussed. The solutions of the problem and the constructive expression of the solutions are given by the generalized inverse operator.

articleTitle: EPICS based HLS control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: EPICS (experimental physics and industrial control system), a distributed control system, is introduced in the paper. The structure and components of EPICS are described in detail. The upgrade of HLS (Hefei synchrotron light source) control system, which is a part of the NSRL phase II project, is also described. The control system is developed under EPICS and mainly based on PC hardware.

articleTitle: Discrete fuzzy number and its application in decision problems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In decision problems, there are many relevant uncertain factors affecting the psychological judgements of decision-makers. The use of fuzziness in psychological measures is the key to predict the outcome of the decision making process. The discrete fuzzy number and its algorithms proposed here can appropriately express the uncertainty and fuzziness of prediction and decision under fuzzy environment. Its feasibility and validity is shown by an example.

articleTitle: A direct adaptive neural-network control of nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A direct adaptive neural-network control strategy for a class of nonlinear system is presented. The system considered is described by an unknown NARMA model and a feedforward neural network is used to learn the system. Taking the neural network as a model of the system, control signals are directly obtained by minimizing either the instant difference or the cumulative differences between a setpoint and output of the model. To accelerate learning and improve convergence the technique in generalized predictive control theory and the gradient descent rule are used in this paper. The effectiveness of the proposed control scheme is illustrated through simulations.

articleTitle: Process parameter setting using case-based and fuzzy reasoning for injection molding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The trial and error method is mainly used for process parameter setting of injection molding. This method, however, heavily relies on skilled operator's experience and is time consuming. In this paper, a method of integrating the case-based reasoning with fuzzy reasoning to solve the problem is proposed. The method initially applies the former injection experience for the injection setting and then uses fuzzy reasoning to adjust the corresponding injection parameters. The conducted experiments show that the suggested method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Study of computer aided conceptual design based on rhombus thought method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, a new computer aided conceptual design method based on rhombus thought is proposed. It is designed to imitate human creativity activity. This method attempts to solve the bottleneck problem in intelligent CAD based on the extension theory. The divergence tree method and convergent thought method are described according to the rhombus thought model of products conceptual design. It has been successfully applied to the vacuum cleaner conceptual design. Theoretical and experimental results demonstrated the method is much more accurate, objective and efficient than the traditional one.

articleTitle: Digital power system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The concept of a digital power system (DPS) is set forth in the paper. The definition, the contents, the function, the hardware and the software conditions for implementing it are discussed. Moreover, the necessary basic research work for implementing a DPS is also discussed. The DPS may be defined like this: the digital power system is the digital, figuration and real time description and reappearance of physical structure, technical characteristic, management system as well as personal information system of a real power system which is in operation. The DPS will be able to make a significant contribution to administrating and decision-making more scientifically, improving security and stability online, online making and implementing economical operation strategy and carrying out emergency and anti-fault control, etc.

articleTitle: A CGPC controller in continuous casting process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A more accurate useful model of mould level control system is obtained by introducing the colored noise term in the system model. On the basis of this model, a robust generalized predictive control method (CGPC) which can distract the effect of colored noise, such as speed changes or other disturbances, is used in mould level control. The simulation experiments show that the robustness and error of mould level controlled by CGPC are greatly improved than the conventional GPC.

articleTitle: Study on high speed sampling and processing of arc dynamic image for low voltage apparatus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A method of observing electrical arc movements for developing and producing high performance low voltage apparatus is presented. In hardware design, high frame rate CCDs and a straight fiberscope are used as the image sensor, and an advanced system of testing high speed arc images and high speed data transfer with RS-422A has also been designed. Using this testing system, the analogous electrical arc image can be converted into digital image for convenience of computer processing. With the high speed DSP (TMS320C40) and memories as the core of the testing system, the interface of the high rate data buffer between the computer and the CCD camera has been implemented.

articleTitle: Prediction of engineering testing parameters with fuzzy set-valued statistics reasoning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Changing engineering testing parameters will affect the performance parameters of the test piece when engineering testing is being carried out. Since measurements of the performance parameters are often inaccurate, the measured data (x/sub i/, y/sub i/) are often assumed the form of (x/sub i//spl plusmn//spl Delta/x/sub i/, y/sub i//spl plusmn//spl Delta/y/sub i/). For this reason, the prediction model with fuzzy reasoning is set up according to the fuzzy set-valued statistics reasoning, and it is applied to predict engineering testing performance parameters. A method to alter the original fuzzy implication relation is discussed when the predicted results differ from actual results. Finally, this paper analyzes and predicts the effects of welding temperature on the tensile strength of welding joint taking vacuum diffusion welding of 35 CrMo steel as an example, and the prediction results show that the method is practical and feasible.

articleTitle: An agent team for RoboCup simulator league
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: RoboCup is an attempt to promote AI and robotics research by providing a common task, soccer playing, for evaluation of various theories, algorithms and agent architectures. RoboCup consists of both the real robot league and the simulator league, where the soccer server is a standard software platform. A wide range of key issues on AI research emerges when designing simulator teams, such as the agent architecture, multi-agent teamwork, machine learning, etc. These issues are what we concerned most when developing our simulator team. Our team participated the first RoboCup tournament in China, and won the second place in the competition.

articleTitle: NN-based environment recognition of pipeline robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Aimed at the environment recognition problem of pipeline robot in bent pipes this paper constructs the characteristic rotating vector description of images and uses RBF neural network to recognize the direction of turn. Experiments prove that the speed and accuracy of the algorithms can meet the requirement of visual servo control in pipeline robot.

articleTitle: A bit-rate control method in video communication
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Bit-rate control is one of the most important issues in video communication. We introduce PID into the picture layer bit-rate control in H.263+ application, which is characterized by its open structure. The combination of PID feedback control and model-based TMN8 bit-rate control method will improve the adaptability of the rate controller. This method will scale-down the effect of random disturbance and the error caused by the variance between the real system and its model. Furthermore, it applies to both constant bit-rate (CBR) control and variable bit-rate (VBR) control.

articleTitle: Design of performance robustness for uncertain linear systems with state and control delays - an LMI approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the performance robustness problem via state feedback controller is studied for a class of uncertain linear systems with state and control delays. The uncertainties are norm-bounded time-varying and the time-delays are uncertain, independent of each other and allowed to be time-varying. The integral quadratic cost function is employed to measure the system performance. Sufficient conditions for the existence of the controller to guarantee an upper bound of the system performance are given in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs).

articleTitle: The associative memory with optimal error-correcting performance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper the character of the associative memory is discussed emphatically from the viewpoint of the storage capacity and the associative ability of the network. The associative memory function can all be realized by utilizing the feedback network on competition. The competing classifying (CC) algorithm is presented here. Compared with any other associative memories that already exist, the neural network determined by the algorithm has very good performances such as high error-correcting capability, large storage capacity, no "rejected-point" and no spurious attractive center. The obtained network exceeds the storage capacity of HAM and BP networks.

articleTitle: Human simulating fuzzy quality control model of nickel flash furnace in Jinchuan smeltery
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A quality control model (QCM) of a flash furnace based on the Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) fuzzy method is presented in the paper. The structure identification of the human control action and parameter adjustment of the model are also discussed; two different adaptive human control action models for the furnace are suggested. One is static and the another is dynamic. The performance of the dynamic human simulating fuzzy quality control model has been tested in the flash smelting furnace for two months. The production runs successfully.

articleTitle: Nonlinear model predictive control based on multiple neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Improved predictions can be obtained by using multiple neural networks instead of trying to find a single optimal network as usual. All the component networks of MNN model are selected using generalized information entropy, and the accuracy and reliability of overall model are significantly improved. Based on such an MNN model, a new nonlinear model predictive control algorithm is proposed. Simulation results of a pH CSTR demonstrates that the method is effective and practical.

articleTitle: A new agent architecture for RoboCup tournament: cognitive architecture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Many researchers are involved in designing and manufacturing new-types of robots to win the RoboCup tournament. As for the simulator league of RoboCup tournament, the SoccerServer system is a typical multi-agent system. In general, there are three kinds of agent architectures: deliberation, reactive agent and hybrid architecture. In imitating the cognitive architecture of the human's brain, a new type of agent architecture-cognitive architecture-is proposed and a robot soccer team underlying this framework is established. Our goal is to enable the intelligent robots possess the same structures as our brain and to develop the functions for each module to improve the intelligence of the robots.

articleTitle: Sliding mode control of nonlinear system based on neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In order to minimize the information needed from a plant, an adaptive sliding mode control scheme for a nonlinear plant without any model is proposed based on strong robust sliding mode control with the favorable approximation ability of basis function neural nets. The global stability of the control system is proved by theoretical analysis. Simulation shows the strong robustness and feasibility of the control scheme.

articleTitle: The electrochemical rectifying stable-current supply scheme based on genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, according to the parameter-optimized in the PID stable-current-controller of electrochemistry rectifying supply, an adaptive algorithms was developed based on genetic algorithms. Good result was obtained, and the parameter optimized in the control system using genetic algorithms was realized.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of fuzzy controller based on observer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents stability for a class of uncertain discrete-time nonlinear systems and a method for designing robust fuzzy observer and fuzzy controller to stabilize the uncertain nonlinear systems whose states are unobservable. To design fuzzy observer and fuzzy controller, uncertain nonlinear systems are represented by Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy models (1992) with uncertainty. The concept of parallel and distributed compensation is employed to design fuzzy robust observer and fuzzy robust controller from T-S fuzzy models. Stability conditions are derived from quadratic stabilization and linear matrix inequality (LMI).

articleTitle: Towards more intelligent network management: service-oriented proactive fault management using KDD techniques
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, we present a knowledge discovery system, Data Fusion Supported Frequent Episodes Discovery (DFSPED), for service-oriented proactive fault management in communication networks. The concept of network service topology is proposed first, and context-free grammars and network service dependence graph are used to model the service-oriented proactive fault management. Secondly, with the approaches of data fusion, two catalogues of important fault-pertinent data sources, i.e., service-oriented trouble-reporting data and real time alarm messages, are fused by temporal and spatial associations. KDD techniques are applied to perform incremental mining in the fused sequential events, finding frequent episodes among faults, alarms and service. Fast restoration of key service interruption, fault prediction and preventive maintenance benefit a lot from the discovered episodes.

articleTitle: The asymmetric control strategy of ASVG
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The ASVG (advanced static VAr generator) system with high power thyristor GTOs, is an important device in a FACTS (flexible AC transmission system). The research into asymmetric control of an ASVG takes an important role in reforming of the power net and improving its technology in the 21/sup st/ century. The paper presents a control strategy which is based on fuzzy-self-study control theory, which accomplishes the corresponding control with a multi-object in a nonlinear ASVG system.

articleTitle: A pattern recognition machine with fuzzy clustering analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A pattern recognition machine with fuzzy clustering analysis, PRM, is proposed in this paper, which is with a twofold task, learning knowledge from the sample patterns and applying the knowledge to the observed patterns. With the same fuzzy clustering procedure, the PRM does its twofold work. By fuzzy clustering analysis on the sample patterns in the pattern space, the PRM establishes its clustering criteria, the sample cluster structure and the expected cluster structure. The observed pattern is added to the sample pattern set to form the extended sample set, and the same clustering scheme for the sample pattern set is applied to the extended sample set by the PRM so that the observed pattern is recognized under the clustering criteria. The paper examines the PRM theoretically and develops some significant conclusions. At the end of this paper, an illustrative example is given to show how the PRM works.

articleTitle: A survey: RoboCup and the research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Robot soccer, as the ideal field for research of AI, robotics, and cybernetics, has become a hot topic among researchers. This paper gives a brief introduction of the RoboCup, including the basic rules of RoboCup, the competition environment, and typical research work over RoboCup. A simple comparison between RoboCup and FIRA is also given.

articleTitle: Single neuron self-adaptive PSD control and its application in reheat steam temperature control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A new cascade feedback control system with load feed-forward of reheat steam temperature is proposed in this paper. Single-neuron self-adaptive PSD algorithm controller applied to outer loop and double-degree PID controller is applied to inner loop. The methodologies of design and configuration the implementation was made with single-loop digitizer regulator CLC-04 of Bailey Inc. The simulation and practical results show the satisfactory control results have been achieved.

articleTitle: Martingale hyperconvergence theorem and convergence of robust output tracking for time-varying systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Stability of adaptive control for time-varying systems (TVS) is surveyed and then a powerful mathematical tool-martingale hyperconvergence theorem-is presented which can be successfully applied to analyze the convergence of various identification algorithms and adaptive control algorithms for TVS. It makes an important advance in the study of the convergence and stability problems of TVS. The analysis indicates that the output tracking error given by adaptive control based on the projection algorithm is consistently bounded. The authors state that this is the best convergence result in the area of adaptive control for time-varying systems up to now.

articleTitle: Multivariable intelligent decoupling control and its applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Neural algorithms of two-dimensional packing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A detailed review of mechanism and method of packing's neural network algorithms is made. Through a set of heuristic rules, a two dimension rectangular packing problem is mapped to Hopfield neural network. Research on application of Boltzman machine and Cauchy machine to solve packing problems is carried out, and firstly the chaos neural network is applied to two-dimensional packing problem. Then through simulation, characters of different neural network models and influence factors are studied. The experimental results indicate that compared with traditional packing algorithms, the results obtained by packing neural network are more stable and quicker due to the infinite parallelism.

articleTitle: A new method of converting database into knowledgebase
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A method of converting a database into a knowledgebase is described in the paper. Our approach consists of: (1) the selection of a development tool; (2) the expression of knowledge; (3) the designing of a database; and (4) the conversion of the database. Finally, the applicability of the suggested method can be proved by successful operation of the DCS fault diagnosis expert system.

articleTitle: An optimal design approach for fuzzy systems based on hybrid genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper proposes a hierarchical hybrid genetic algorithm (GA) based on an adaptive fuzzy-neural network with varying nodes. This algorithm extracts important rules from a given large rule base to construct an optimal fuzzy model using the GA, and parameters of the model are estimated using a hybrid of the gradient descent and least square estimate in terms of the characteristics of fuzzy systems. The hybrid GA combines the advantages of GA's strong search capacity and the fast convergence and accuracy of the conventional optimization. Therefore, the algorithm achieves a trade-off between accuracy, reliability and computing time in global optimization. The simulation and application example given demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Study on tamper-proofing of digital media
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The applications of fragile digital watermarking for the tamper-proofing of digital media are discussed in this paper. A novel fragile watermarking approach and related tamper detection are proposed. Taking still image as an example, the watermark are embedded in the discrete wavelet domain of an image, so tamper detection is possible in localized spatial and frequency regions. Specially, this method can provide information on specific frequencies of the image that have been modified. This is different to previously proposed techniques. The result of experiment shows that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Model reference adaptive identification of induction motor parameters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the two-phase stationary coordination, this paper proposes two kinds of model reference adaptive identifier: one is used to identify the stator flux, and the other is used to identify the rotor speed when the parameters of the induction motor are unchanged or changed. With the Lyapunov stability lemma, the updating laws of parameters are obtained.

articleTitle: Model reduction of flexible manipulators
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We present a simple, efficient method for model reduction of flexible manipulators. The region in which the dominant poles are situated, the steady-state covariance value and the steady-state mean value respectively represent the transient and steady-state performances of a flexible manipulator system, and the reduced model must approximate the original system in these three respects as well as possible. We employed the proposed method to reduce the order of a flexible manipulator model such that a model-based scheme can be implemented. The method was illustrated by an example.

articleTitle: Application of intelligent switch and intelligent fuzzy controller in reheated steam temperature system of power plants
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An intelligent fuzzy controller is designed for the controlled objects which have the characteristics of time-delay nonlinear and variable parameters. The controller is composed of mindlike intelligent integral and two-dimensional fuzzy control. A regulating device is proposed for the valves that are always out of control. The device has the structure of a double-loop cascade control system and can realize intelligent switching. A number of simulations and practical applications show that the intelligent switch and intelligent fuzzy cascade reheated steam temperature control system which are configured and realized by using the CLC-04 programmable regulator have better controllability, anti-jamming, and robustness than that of a PID cascade system and a robust state-feedback cascade system.

articleTitle: A fast algorithm for training a class of fuzzy neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A fast algorithm for training a class of fuzzy neural networks (FNN) is studied. The proposed algorithm is called least square-simplex (LS-simplex). The algorithm obtains the performance of global convergence and avoids the inherent local convergence when adopting a grads algorithm to train the FNN, also it accelerates the FNN's training and can be used online which is impossible when using a genetic algorithm (GA). Compared with the grads algorithm and GA, the LS-simplex owns more accurate precision and faster convergent speed, and the FNN obtained has excellent generalization performance.

articleTitle: A nonregular case of the Jury test
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The Jury test problem of determining the root distribution of a real polynomial with respect to the unit circle, was solved by Jury (1964), and was later simplified by Raible (1974). Keel (1999) presented a new simple proof of the Jury test. But they assumed that the characteristic polynomial has no root on the unit circle. However, this is the regular case. In this paper, we discuss a nonregular case in which all entries of some row of the Raible's table become zero. Finally, we draw some important conclusions.

articleTitle: Target number detection based on time-range-Doppler image
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
