abstract: As the targets flying in groups may spread over several range cells and their Doppler frequencies are time-varying, a scheme of target number detection in groups on a conventional low-resolution radar is proposed based on a time-range-Doppler image cube which is constructed by substituting a time-frequency transform for the Fourier transform in the conventional range-Doppler imaging. The image cube provides not only a clear range-Doppler image with superior resolution at each time instant but also the time-varying history of the images, hence a good solution to the problem of range spread and image blurring. The experimental results of actual target echoes demonstrate the validity of the scheme with successful detection of four targets flying in groups.

articleTitle: The working principle, application and current study of CBR
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The working principle, application and technology of case based reasoning (CBR) are presented first and the reasons of why CBR systems are superior to rule based reasoning systems are also given. After that, application of CBR in several fields and current study of CBR are presented. At the end of the paper we point out the potential development direction of a CBR study.

articleTitle: Neural feedback linearization and its application in radar servo systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper proposes a feedback linearized design method for a kind of affine nonlinear system with unknown nonlinearity and/or uncertainty. A neural network is used to approximate the unknown function and/or uncertainty in the system. Then the neural feedback linearized controller without off-line training is obtained using conventional feedback linearization. According to the Lyapunov stability theory, the weight update law of neural network, the adaptive law of error bound and the feedback control are obtained, thus the stability of closed-loop control system is ensured. This design method can be applied to radar servo system. The novel radar servo system using neural feedback linearization is constructed and its effectiveness is verified through simulations.

articleTitle: Gradient control of liquid level control system dynamics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Controlling chaos is a new concept. The paper is concerned with an algorithm based on gradient control. The control method of the liquid level control system is simulated. It is shown that the method in the paper is a very effective one for analyzing perturbation control for nonlinear dynamic systems.

articleTitle: A new model of the variable current servo-system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A detailed calculation shows that the SPWM frequency converter of a single-polar synchronous modulation model with the carrier ratio N=27 and modulation depth M=0.99 can constitute a new-type of current servo-system controlled by the amplitude, and gives good system's performance.

articleTitle: A neuron controller with self-tuning gain for anti-lock braking systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: By analysing the dynamic model of a wheel under braking, and based on the neuron model and neuron control method given by Wang Ning et al. (1991), a new neuron model-free controller with self-tuning gain for the anti-lock braking system (ABS) is proposed in this paper. Simulation tests of the ABS using the neuron controller were made. It is shown that good performances of the anti-lock braking system were obtained under various conditions of road surfaces. This new control method is very simple and suitable for practical use.

articleTitle: A new stochastic search algorithm for global optimization based on mutation operator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We present a random restart heuristic for the global optimization problem that is based on the principles of mutation inspired by biology, it only uses the mutation operator to search the solution space. Combining local optimization by the mutation operator and random restart method in order to increase the reliability of finding the global optimum, the new algorithm can obtain satisfactory results in limited time. The superiority of this methodology over the conventional genetic algorithm is established on some problems of optimizing complex functions.

articleTitle: Digital image sampling curve feature extraction using triangle fractal method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on discrete Lyapunov theory, the paper first gives the definition of a chaotic curve, then according to the fractal character of such curves, an iterative function system (IFS), which consists of a series of affine transforms on a triangle basis is designed, so a triangle fractal feature extraction method is introduced. The result of an experiment indicated the mathematical model we proposed has fast converge speed and can provide rich and accurate features of the curves.

articleTitle: A forecasting support system based on neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents a new type of forecasting support system because it is very difficult to build an accurate model for some systems, such as the hotel. The forecasting analysis method is based on the radial basis function neural network. The entire forecasting support system data are stored in the database. According to the varies forecasting support subsystem, the synthesized datum and information, which can be taken as the forecasting input samples, are filtered by online analysis processing and data mining. When this method is used in the forecasting support subsystem of the material department of a hotel, it can provide forecasting data for the department manager. With this method the manager can make scientific stocking arrangement. Furthermore, it assures the correct level of materials being stocked in the department for effective running of the hotel.

articleTitle: Simulated annealing genetic hybrid algorithm and its applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Genetic algorithm (GA) search methods are rooted in evolution mechanisms and the nature of genetics. They have been applied to a wide range of industrial applications but research shows that standard genetic algorithms have some defects such as unsatisfactory local searching ability and premature convergence. The article proposes a genetic algorithm to overcome these shortcomings. The simulated result shows that the hybrid algorithm helps the practical system achieve a better performance.

articleTitle: Robust stability of single predictive model control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The algorithm of single prediction model algorithm control (MAC) for single-input/single-output (SISO) system is given. Mode uncertainty is parametrized in terms of maximum and minimum limits for the impulse response parameters. Robust stability of the resulting closed-loop system is analyzed by using criterion when the model-plant mismatch is under a certain boundary.

articleTitle: Study on vibrator wire weigh sensor and data processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper describes the structure, theory and data processing system of vibrator wire weighing sensor. The sensor's output is a digital signal, which can easily be input to a computer. The sensor measures a range of weights.

articleTitle: Research of dynamic error model of the angle measuring system of amplitude discrimination mode
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper gives the angle measuring system schedule when the induction synchronizer is working under the bi-phase excitation, single phase output and amplitude discrimination mode. On the basis of analysing the static errors, this paper establishes the model of dynamic errors and analyses the errors. A method for reducing the errors and the related conclusion are given.

articleTitle: The online measurements and estimation of nutrient solution in greenhouse agriculture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An online phosphate nutrient estimation model is constructed by a regressive analysis method. Electrochemistry sensor technology is introduced to measure nitrogen nutrient, kalium nutrient, calcium nutrient and a PH.A method is put forward to make online analysis of nutrient solution in greenhouse agriculture. A real system of nutrient solution online analysis is constructed. All this makes a good base for the control of the nutrient environment in greenhouse agriculture.

articleTitle: An optoelectronic isolator without drift based on chopper and DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The design and realization of a long pulse optoelectronic isolator based on chopper and DSP (digital signal processing) technology are studied in this paper. According to the requirement of the optoelectronic isolator, a high-speed photocoupler 6N136 was used. By using the chopper and digital signal processor, a long pulse optoelectronic isolator without drift and a special circuit are designed and developed.

articleTitle: A new method for design of fuzzy logic systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of a chaotic optimization method, the paper describes a hybrid algorithm called chaos-simplex search by combining a chaotic optimization method and a simplex search. Then this new algorithm is used for design of a fuzzy logic system. Simulation results show that the chaos-simplex search algorithm can avoid a great deal of adjusting work of the design process and is a more effective and simple method for design of a fuzzy logic system.

articleTitle: Related value set algorithm for robot to distinguish image
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The image recognition from image database is different from robot vision in real world because the robot concerned is movable. The size of the image that captured by the robot varies with the distance between robot's camera and the real picture, or object. We analyzed the process of how human remembers and identifies an image. We derived eight properties of the key feature in an image. We then developed a related value set algorithm. With the algorithm, we defined a set to represent the key features of an image. The elements of the set are represented with the related value. The key features retrieved from an image with the algorithm satisfied the eight properties, thus the algorithm can be used for robot to distinguish images or object. The key features can also be used in image knowledge representation.

articleTitle: Wait time for multi-messages polling system under mixed service
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the paper, a multi-queue system with cyclic mixed service is analyzed through random observation and renewal theory, and the mean waiting time of different classes of objects are derived. The mean waiting time is compared with that under single service conditions, and the comparison indicates the performance of the multi-queue system under mixed service is improved.

articleTitle: The application of charge balance transmission technology in real time data monitoring system of the power plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the technology of charge balance transmission for real time data monitoring of the economically run computer network system for 1-2 unit of a power plant is presented and the application of the technology in system communication is explained in detail. Using the advanced technology ensures the reliability and real-time operation of communication in strong electromagnetic environment.

articleTitle: Design and realization of the intelligent distributed control system of tobacco warehouse
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Proposes an intelligent control system of environment parameters for a tobacco warehouse, which determines the operation status automatically from the enthalpy of air and the optimum operation time of the air-conditioning system by a BP neural network, and realizes the air-conditioning system's operation control with a multi-model human-simulating intelligent control algorithm. The designs of its software and hardware are also discussed. The practical operation result is given finally.

articleTitle: Precise integration method for finite horizon H/sub /spl infin// generalized regulator problem
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The controllers for H/sub /spl infin// generalized regulator problem exist if and only if two given Riccati equations have solutions and the product of the solutions meets the restrictive condition of spectral radius. Then the controllers can be generated with these data. Up to now, the existing algorithms could only be used to solve Riccati algebraic equations and compute the corresponding optimal H/sub /spl infin//-norm, which arise from the infinite horizon H/sub /spl infin// control problem. The precise integration method, which is developed on the basis of the theory of analogy between structural mechanics and optimal control, can be employed to solve both Riccati differential and algebraic equations. Therefore, the finite and infinite horizon H/sub /spl infin// regulator problems can be solved using the same method. The paper presents the procedure of solving the Riccati differential equations and computing the optimal H/sub /spl infin//-norm combined with the extended W-W algorithm. It is the essential step in synthesizing controllers for the finite horizon H/sub /spl infin// generalized regulator problem.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of an agent-based CSCW environment for pattern design system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The graphics design and printing of industry patterns are being widely applied in dyeing, chinaware, advertising, carpet and other industries. With the development and advancement of the technology and increasing competition, a new concurrent and integrative development method on pattern products is required to reduce the production costs and design cycle. We use the advanced agent and Web technologies to develop an agent-based CSCW environment for a pattern CAD/CAM system which supports several users concurrently in designing the same pattern, and it has been widely used in the distributed intelligent pattern printing and dyeing system and other CAD/CAM systems.

articleTitle: Research on the structure of planning and scheduling system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: With the severity of market competition, planning and scheduling play an important role in modern enterprises. Because the traditional planning and scheduling strategies ignore the resources restriction and exogenous events, they can not monitor the process of the task quickly. In the paper, we propose a planning and scheduling structure based on timed Petri nets. The structure consists of several modules, among them the reference PN model synchronizes the affect of resources restriction and a monitor PN model watches accidents, so the manager can repair the planning and scheduling strategy or replan and reschedule according to the structure.

articleTitle: Applying fuzzy control system to food presser
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper discusses how to apply the fuzzy control system to food presser. The basic structure and realization methods of the presser based on the fuzzy control principle are described. It proves the advantages of the system by simulation on computers.

articleTitle: Accelerated simulated annealing algorithm for IMC scheduling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An accelerated simulated annealing is discussed to solve the neural network energy function of IMC schedule. Simulation results are given. It is shown that the method described is more cost effective than conventional optimal computation.

articleTitle: Soft sensors in fluid catalytic cracking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Through analyzing conventional GA, a new real-coded GA based on annealing chaotic mutation operator is proposed. By introducing the intrinsic stochastic property and ergodicity of chaos movement and variable evolutionary rate, this algorithm can better simulate the process of biologic evolution, and possess the better hill-climbing ability. And it adaptively changes the operating order of evolutionary operators in the different evolutionary stage. So it overcomes the shortcoming of premature convergence and stagnation, and effectively solves the problem of global convergence. Compared with some self-adaptive GA, the test results show that this algorithm is easy to be implemented, and its efficiency is higher in the rate of convergence, accuracy and reliability, so it is effective for optimization problem.

articleTitle: An adaptive method of signal selecting based on the strategy of fuzzy clustering and expert reasoning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In order to pick up effective signals a real control system, the paper discusses an adaptive method of signal selection based on the strategy of fuzzy clustering and expert reasoning. Compared with known methods, it can not only pick up system characteristic frequency efficiently in the allowable error range, but also reduce the calculation and enhance the real time property. In order to demonstrate the merits of this method, an application example is then given.

articleTitle: Study and realization of design and simulation system of ship stance control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the software called "the system of ship stance control and random sea wave simulation", the paper studies the design and realization method of real time simulation software for CAD and CAI. At the same time, the criterion of system simulation and design methods of modern software are used.

articleTitle: Adaptive control system of speed sensor-less AC motor variable speed drive
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: According to the principle of the model reference adaptive control theory, the novel method using Popov's hyperstability criterion to solve the convergent problem of the speed identification algorithm in a speed sensor-less direct torque control system is presented in this paper. Theory analysis and simulation study show that the suggested method can assure global asymptotically stability of the speed identification algorithm.

articleTitle: Automatically generation technology of a domain information system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Three stages of automatic generation of information system are proposed on the basis of automation and automatic generation of software. Construction of a domain component based and basic integration method of application program are also discussed in detail. The natural correspondence of MIS is described. With its component base, it turns a complicated user definition into a two dimension relationship table data, which is a good method.

articleTitle: Research on applications of three layers neural network in dynamic modeling of jig system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The recurrent neural network has strong dynamic approximating capability. It can be used to describe a kind of complex nonlinear time-varying dynamic system. In the paper a model of a three layer recurrent neural network is proposed. The dynamic backpropagation method is put forth to train the weights of the network. Simulation shows the model has good performance in approximating dynamic systems.

articleTitle: Dynamic model estimation and speed control of a switched reluctance motor drive
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the quantitative speed control for a switched reluctance motor (SRM) drive is studied. First, the drive circuit with proper current control for the SRM is implemented, and the dynamic model is estimated. Then a simple two-degrees-of-freedom (2-DOF) speed controller is presented. According to the estimated dynamic model and the prescribed speed tracking and regulation control specifications, the parameters of the proposed 2-DOF speed controller are systematically derived.

articleTitle: Study of the stochastic method of dynamic programming for optimizing the storage area network (SAN)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the storage area network (SAN) of data warehouse has been optimized by the stochastic method of dynamic programming, and a method of optimizing SAN has been put forward.

articleTitle: A new approach to robust filtering with specified error variance constraints
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Considers the problem of robust filtering with specified estimation error variance constraints. The system under consideration is subjected to time varying norm-bounded parameter uncertainties in both the state and measurement matrices. In traditional methods, an H/sub 2/ robust filter satisfying error variance constraints can not be obtained by solving only two Riccati equations once. In the paper, the generalized inverse technique of matrices is introduced, and a new algorithm is developed. After two Riccati equations are solved, the filter can be obtained directly, and the variance of estimation error of each state is guaranteed to be not more than the individual specified upper bound. Both the continuous-time case and the discrete-time case are considered in the paper.

articleTitle: A new mutation operator and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A real-coded GA based on an annealing chaotic mutation operator is proposed. By introducing the intrinsic stochastic property and ergodicity of chaos movement and variable evolutionary rate, this algorithm can better simulate the process of biologic evolution and possess better hill-climbing ability. It adaptively changes the operating order of evolutionary operators in the different evolutionary stages. So it overcomes the shortcoming of premature convergence and stagnation, and effectively solves the problem of global convergence. Compared with some self-adaptive GAs, the test results show that this algorithm is easy to implement and its efficiency is higher in the rate of convergence, accuracy and reliability, so it is effective for optimization problems.

articleTitle: Programming model for concept learning and its solution based on genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Learning from examples is an important branch of inductive learning, and is also the bottleneck in concepts extraction of machine learning. Based on inductive learning theory this paper applies combinatorial optimization method to setup the programming models of learning concepts of the prepositional logic formulas in the conjunctive normal form (CNF) and disjunctive normal form (DNF). Then, genetic algorithms (GA), specified to CNF learning, is designed. GA can find the multiple optimal solution in theory and practice, and experiments reveal that it runs more efficiently compared with heuristic algorithms of the generalisation-and-specialisation (GS) type.

articleTitle: Multi-criteria control system parameters optimization based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a multi-parameter optimization method based on the solution of the multi-criteria optimization problem using a multi-objective constrained genetic algorithm. By incorporating the fuzzy rules in the fitness assignment procedure, the GA can simultaneously handle multiple design objectives and constraints with relative importance. Simulation results show that this algorithm can obtain acceptable solutions satisfying all constraints.

articleTitle: Memoryless robust control for uncertain systems with time-varying delays
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The problem of stabilization of uncertain dynamical systems with time-varying delays in the control is considered. The memoryless feedback control laws are derived by constructing a proper Lyapunov function, vector inequalities and Riccati equation. The results are extended from simple delays systems to multiple delay ones.

articleTitle: A method of fuzzy modeling for non-linear systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A method of fuzzy identification based on a new objective function is proposed. There are two items in the new objective function, including the goal of fuzzy clustering and the goal of identification. It is testified that the method could simultaneously make the structure of the fuzzy model optimum and estimate parameters of fuzzy model through a theorem. The method makes the fuzzy modeling simple. Simulation results demonstrate that the method could identify non-linear systems and improve identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Event-based discontinuous control for harmonic drive system with the damping enhancement of acceleration feedback
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents an event-based discontinuous control scheme for harmonic drive (HD) transmission. It is composed of two control strategies, namely, the motor-side PD control refined by load-side acceleration feedback, and the output torque control. Switching between these two modes is based on the external working condition of the HD. This intends to generate appropriate control actions according to the actual problems of the HD, which are different and closely dependent on its external conditions. Extensive experiments were conducted on a single link device driven by an AC motor and harmonic transmission to test the performance of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Reactive current compensation of fuzzy controlling parallel capacitor switching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of fuzzy control of parallel capacitor switching, supported by the approach of the artificial neural network dynamic detecting reactive current, using the features of electric railway power system reactive current. It improves power factor and compensating precision with lower capacitor switching frequency. It also prevents the capacitor from resonating with power system. Analysis of compensation features proves that the method is valid and feasible and has superior function. It is the optimizing method of reactive current compensation.

articleTitle: Motion control system's integration into intranet with distribution technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This thesis described the integration of the real-time motion control network with switch high-speed Ethernet technology and distributed database technology. An application is introduced at the end.

articleTitle: A RBF network modeling approach combining GA and orthogonal optimum seeking method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach for the training of RBF neural networks. It combines the genetic algorithm (GA) and orthogonal optimum seeking method, taking advantage of both the GA's global optimization ability and the orthogonal optimum seeking method that can quickly determine the numbers of the hidden nodes, to correctly determine the centers of the RBF network. Simulation results show that it is a simple method, and is more reliable and efficient than orthogonal optimum seeking method in training the RBF neural network for dynamic modeling.

articleTitle: The optimal design on the decision mechanism of credit risk for banks with imperfect information
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We utilize an optimal method to study the decision problem of credit risk for banks. An appropriate decision mechanism of credit risk is given. The study shows banks design a credit contract from a defaulting loan from an entrepreneur point of view. The decision mechanism of credit risk we obtain can efficiently identify the extent to which the entrepreneur reports risk information in credit markets with imperfect information.

articleTitle: Recursive algorithm for constrained receding horizon predictive control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper recursively obtains the solution of constrained receding-horizon predictive control (CRHPC) in order to avoid inversion of higher-dimensional matrices. This method reduces the calculation load greatly.

articleTitle: Path planning using case-based learning and its neural network implementation of the lunar vehicle's self-autonomous navigation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a semi-autonomous navigation method of a lunar vehicle, then discusses the implementation of the case-based learning method by using a neural network. Finally, we discuss the improvement of the BP algorithm using an adaptive learning method.

articleTitle: Internet/intranet based digitized teleservice system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Digitized teleservice system has become a focus of international research and developing. In this paper, the basic function of Internet/intranet based digitized teleservice system was discussed and its corresponding model was proposed. Then its structure was discussed. Finally its design and realization was introduced-associated with SVW-oriented application on Sino-German Cooperation Project.

articleTitle: Coordinate pseudo-stabilization of dynamic systems for multiple mobile robots
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Deals with the stabilization of dynamic systems for two omnidirectional mobile robots by using the inner product of two vectors, one is from a robot's position to another, the other is from a robot's target point to another. The multi-step control law is given, which can exponentially stabilize the dynamic system and make the distance between two robots be greater than or equal to the collision-free safe distance. The application of it to two omni-directional mobile robots is described. Simulation result shows that the proposed controller is effective.

articleTitle: Robust estimation of measurement error covariance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Conventional indirect estimations of measurement error covariance are very sensitive to gross errors. A robust indirect algorithm based on Hampel's three-part redescending M-estimators is developed. Credible results can be achieved either with or without the presence of external causes. Two examples are provided to demonstrate the robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A pruning technique of feasible matrixes of JPDA algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The cause of the computation complexity of the joint probability data association (JPDA) algorithm is that the validation matrix is decomposed to lots of feasibility matrices, and so the number of feasibility matrices increases exponentially with the complexity of the validation matrix. So we think that the speed of the JPDA can be improved by decreasing the complexity of validation matrix with improving the performance of the tracking gate. This is demonstrated, with some simulations.

articleTitle: The application of BP type neural network in speech coding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper discusses the method that uses the BP algorithm of neural networks to code the speech signal by means of nonlinear prediction aiming at the non-stationary and nonlinear features of speech signals. Taking the G.721 ADPCM speech coding algorithm as an example, the method of nonlinear prediction replacing linear prediction is presented. The results indicate that the coding quality using neural network nonlinear prediction is better than that of using linear prediction.

articleTitle: Hopfield neural network via Volterra series implement fast prediction of chaotic time series
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, we construct predictive model of chaotic time series via Volterra series and characteristics of Hopfield neural network, which possess fast and parallel processing. We also induce weight formula of Hopfield neural network. It is shown through experiments that this model is valid.

articleTitle: Review and improvement on several typical regression diagnostics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Review is given on two kinds of regression diagnostics approaches including eight series of algorithms. Based on theoretical analysis and simulation, some shortcomings are pointed out. Three improvements are depicted, and a new detection algorithm is built, which is based on fault-tolerant identification and jackknife algorithms. Simulation shows that this new method is very efficient.

articleTitle: Fuzzy modeling for complex processes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A complex process which is difficult to be mathematically expressed can be described by a set of fuzzy inference rules, and fuzzy modeling has been regarded as one of the key problems in fuzzy systems research. A quick and accurate fuzzy modeling method is presented in accordance with the characteristics of SISO systems. That is, the domain of discourse of the input variable is divided firstly according to the changing degree of the process output while the input variable changes, and based on the above, dividing the total number and the premise parameters of the fuzzy rules can be determined, then because the presented fuzzy model can be expressed as a fuzzy neural network which is a feedforward neural network, so the BP algorithm is applied to obtain the consequent parameters of the fuzzy rules. The effectiveness of the presented fuzzy modeling method and the generalization ability of the fuzzy rules model are demonstrated by a simulation example.

articleTitle: The use of object-oriented Petri nets in design specification of enterprise modelling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the construct-based enterprise modelling (CEM) framework, the paper describes the modelling approach adopted in design specification of enterprise modelling. In the design specification phase, CEM uses an object-oriented Petri nets, called the OPnet, to establish enterprise models. The OPnet enterprise model consists of two parts: static attributes and dynamic behavior. Static attributes are modeled by the object description language (ODL). The dynamic behavior is modeled by the process object nets (PON), process net (p-net) and object behavior net (ob-net). In the CEM design specification phase, ODL are used to establish models of the organization view, information view and function view with the help of ob-net, and PON and p-net are used to establish the model of process view.

articleTitle: Estimated force emulation for space robot using neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper introduces the telerobotic system estimated force emulation using neural networks. A delay-compensating 3D stereo-graphic simulator is implemented in SGI ONYX/4 RE/sup 2/. The estimated force emulation can protect the real robot in time from being damaged in collision. The neural network is used to learn the mapping between the contact force error and the accommodated position command to the controller of the space robot. Finally, the controller can feel the emulated force with a two-hand 6-DOF master arm using the force feedback interface.

articleTitle: Design and research for automatic allocation and compound of dyestuff
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: At present the automatic allocation and compound of dyestuff is a key technique for our dyeing industry. Here a new automatic system for compound of dyestuff is proposed. In the system, a multiphase control is introduced and studied in details. Our study shows that the fuzzy auto-tuning PID control will be more suitable for the automatic allocation and compound than single PID or fuzzy control only and the test running results of the new system shows that our design is successful.

articleTitle: Neural networks recognition of seismic signal for vehicle targets
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A seismic property of vehicle targets is researched and described. An artificial neural networks (ANN) technology is applied to recognition of the seismic signal. An improved BP algorithm is presented. The improved BP algorithm has been used for classification and recognition of the seismic signal for a vehicle target in a special outdoor environment. It can be confirmed that the ANN is effective for solving the problem of classification and recognition of a seismic signal for a vehicle target.

articleTitle: The study of the general structure and design method of the WWW/Internet-based individual character manufacturing system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a concept of the WWW/Internet-based individual character manufacturing system, its aim is to prolong the product line of an enterprise, i.e. to fit the customer into the process of product design, production and management. Key technologies of WWW/Internet-based individual character manufacturing systems are analyzed, an object-oriented structure of product design suited for application of the individual user-Web-based product driving model is also presented, its applied method and characteristic are analyzed.

articleTitle: A modified mutation operator and mathematical analysis of its efficiency
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A modified mutation operator is presented and the mathematical analysis of the operator efficiency is analysed. The examples given show the operator can improved the convergence property of genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Global optimization using Bayesian heuristic approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Traditional optimization evaluates its results by estimating the maximal deviation. The Bayesian approach (BA) can be regarded as an indirect approach using heuristics by assessing a prior distribution. Using BA on the randomized heuristics, the Bayesian heuristic approach (BHA), provides a natural and convenient method to include expert knowledge, and a more flexible optimization means. In this paper, we introduce the basic concepts of BHA, discuss the basic problems and process of using BHA in the continuous and discrete global optimization, respectively, and make some comments on the advantages and disadvantages of BHA.

articleTitle: Nonlinear attitude controller design based on variable structure control with sliding mode
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Proposes a stabilizing control law for a nonlinear spacecraft's attitude control system based on variable structure control with sliding mode. Taking the characteristics of the attitude system and the requirements of the control task under consideration, we conduct the controller design procedure in two steps. Provided that both the three body angular velocities and the three attitude angles can be offered directly by the spacecraft, angle errors are chosen as new state variables. A group of conditions which body angular velocities should satisfy when angle error equations are not only asymptotically stable but also decoupled is presented. Consequently the above group of conditions is used to construct a group of switch surfaces. The nonlinear attitude stabilizing control law is solved by variable structure control method. A numerical simulation for a spacecraft's attitude control system is performed. Simulation results show that the control law designed in the paper is effective.

articleTitle: A fuzzy controller with variable structure and adaptability to overcome the static error effectively
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper explores the reason why the traditional fuzzy controller produces the static error and can not be eliminated. Faced with this shortcoming, a novel fuzzy controller that can overcome the static error effectively is proposed. This controller can proceed with the variable structure control and adaptive control without the smooth transition problem according to the different stages of the control process. Consequently, this controller improves the performance of the dynamic state and overcomes the static error, which gives a new idea for the control of the large time-delay.

articleTitle: Real time path smoothing schemes in teleoperation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The Robot Teleoperation System (RTS) based on telepresence, which is aided financially by the National 863 High-Tech Development Plan, was set up by the State Key Laboratory of Intelligence Technology and Systems. This system consists of three main parts: robot control, stereo vision and hand gesture tracking. The controlled robot and the operator form a closed loop, and the operator views the robot's status and the environment through the stereo vision subsystem. RTS is developed from SAROT (an intelligent assembly robot system), which is logically divided into 5 layers: real time control, monitoring and coordination, motion planning, task scheduling and task planning. The paper proposes several active "path smoothing" schemes implemented in the system, which carry out the operator's hand gesture tracking in 7 DOF (position: 3, orientation: 3, and pitch: 1).

articleTitle: Filter algorithm of Bayesian state estimation using FFT
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the paper, a filter algorithm of Bayesian state estimation using fast Fourier transforms (FFTs)is proposed. The computation is reduced by using FFTs. The simulation result shows that the algorithm is a very robust nonlinear filter algorithm.

articleTitle: A computer system designed for fashion fitting based on an artificial psychology model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: One main purpose of artificial psychology (AP) is to imitate human psychology with computer, and to provide some subjective evaluations for the objective things. This kind of research is still at the beginning. In this paper, we try to present a AP mathematics model which is applied to a computer system designed for fashion fitting. In the course of the model construction, we unite quantification theory with fuzzy theory and factor analysis so that a qualitative adjective can be transferred to a quantitative variable. In this case, a model of human psychology is developed. On that basis, we compile a friendly human-machine interface with Visual BASIC language and access database to build a computer system for human nature fashion fitting.

articleTitle: Separation of discrete linear mixed chaotic signals
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A separation method of a class of discrete linear mixed chaotic signals is presented, which is based on the chaotic self-synchronization characteristic. The condition of separation, parameter choices and nonlinear map functions are deduced by theoretic analysis. Finally, we illustrate this method by numerical simulation. The proposed method may be used to transmit several information-bearing signals simultaneously with a communication link.

articleTitle: The application of multilayer dynamic forward net in predicting of oil field system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In order to eliminate limitations of conventional modeling and dynamic prediction methods, multilayer dynamic forward networks are considered as the models of oil field systems, the prediction models and technology of multilayer dynamic forward networks are studied. The deficiency of a recursive prediction error learning algorithm is analysed. An improvement scheme is given. So, the algorithm performance is improved. Thus the method of modeling and prediction for an oil field is renewed. During using the new scheme, excellent results have been obtained which proves that the new scheme is very effective.

articleTitle: Process out-of-control cause diagnosis of coal preparation plant based on fuzzy pattern recognition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A new method of fuzzy pattern recognition is proposed considering the importance of eigenvector in recognizing fuzzy patterns. Aiming at the coal preparation process of the coal preparation plant, the eigenvector of process out-of-control cause is attained by using of the integrated environment and other application systems of CIMS. The method to diagnose process out-of-control cause is given based on fuzzy pattern recognition. The data flow diagram of carrying out the system is also given.

articleTitle: Removing distortion in DMT modulation caused by insufficient cyclic prefix length
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: One approach to realizing multi-carrier modulation uses discrete multi-tone (DMT) modulation. When the DMT technology is applied in asymmetric digital subscriber lines (ADSL) and very high speed digital subscriber lines (VDSL) systems, fixed cyclic prefix (CP) length is necessary. When the channel impulse response is longer than the predefined cyclic prefix length, the interactive distortion between the carriers at the channel output occurs. In the paper, an approach that can remove the distortion by introducing a precoder at the transmitter has been proposed. Even though, the introduction of precoder will increase transmitting power, the distortion can be diminished and the system performance improved.

articleTitle: Intelligent control and adaptation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Identification and design of multivariable fuzzy neural network system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A new method of fuzzy neural network identification is proposed. A function for measuring cluster validity is defined with which the number of fuzzy rules can be determined. A sufficient criterion that guarantees the global stability of the fuzzy system is presented. Based on this, a design method to optimize parameters of the fuzzy neural network controller by genetic algorithms is presented. This method is proved to have better effect through a double inverted pendulum by experiments.

articleTitle: Studies on multi-model Kalman filters for stochastic systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents a multiple model Kalman filter method for stochastic systems. The method utilizes a group of linear models, for instance N models, to represent a nonlinear stochastic system. Kalman filters associated with the group of models are used so that an N estimated states are obtained. Then the N state-estimates, each of which is weighted by its possibility that is also calculated online, are combined to form an optimal estimate. Simulation tests were conducted for both a second-order system and a ship-control system, and it is demonstrated that the method is effective for systems with sharply changing parameters. Simulation results also demonstrate that the method is applicable to a number of engineering problems for state estimate and parameter identification for nonlinear stochastic systems.

articleTitle: Discovering and filtering text information from Internet based on inductive learning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper aims at the discovering and filtering of text information from the Internet. Based on the theories of probability and statistics, an essential key word list is established by the statistics of functional words in the sample text and whether or not the text is suspicious. A probability-based inductive learning algorithm is presented to show how to set up and optimize the key words and further more classify the text by the parameter estimation of the text-class attributes. A knowledge-based network information classification and filtering scheme is studied by using the algorithm to different sets of sample text belongs to several domains. The theoretical basis and algorithm implementation are discussed in detail, the experimental results and application examples are also given in the paper.

articleTitle: A learning algorithm detecting the similar Chinese characters' boundary based on unequal-contraction of dimension
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In a recognition system of off-line handwritten Chinese characters, which has a proper recognition rate, improving the recognition rate of similar characters is the key to raising the whole recognition rate. K-L transformation, linear projection, and nonlinear projection are used to visualize the distribution of high-dimension Chinese character vectors. By making comparison experiments between very-similar and very-different Chinese characters, we summarize the distribution characteristic of the high-dimension similar Chinese characters. Utilizing the Mahalanobis distance to measure the similarity of characters and according to the results of statistical experiments, we present a learning algorithm to determine the similar Chinese characters' boundary based on unequal-contraction of dimension.

articleTitle: A generic software of automatic test system: research and implementation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Automatic test equipment (ATE) technology has evolved considerably over the years, matching the diagnostic test requirements of advancing avionics. One of ATE development objectives has been to identify more efficient ways of developing test program sets (TPS). Meeting this objective, we had defined a generic testing software architecture in our generic tester. Testing processes are described in several testing cards which are independent with test executive program. Testing cards can be developed by avionics maintenance engineers who may be unfamiliar with ATE and test executive program, and for whom,therefore, accommodating new TP or modifying old TP is easier. We call this card-driven automatic test software architecture. This paper describes the software structure. Discussing the common process of automatic testing, a generic software structure is proposed and implemented.

articleTitle: A new TF algorithm based on the fuzzy control theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on a classical terrain following (TF) algorithm, the paper presents a new TF algorithm based on the fuzzy control theory, called the fuzzy adaptive angle algorithm, which consists of the self-containing low-attitude penetration system using digital electronic map technologies. The new algorithm not only avoids the problem of depression function and angle gaining, but also avoids the problem of fixing sledge in the classical sledge algorithm. It can simulates human thought and look for a more appropriate observing point as geometry reference to produce the angle control command according to the terrain relative height and gradient in the front of the flight. As the result of simulation, the fuzzy adaptive angle algorithm effectively accomplishes the task of TF and is simple to realize in practice.

articleTitle: The preset algorithm of the controlled cooling system with grouped water-curtain for plate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We study the preset algorithm of the steel plate with water-curtain grouped cooling system. Based on the temperature at the entry and exit of the water-curtain, and gauge, speed, grade of the cooled plate with the working water-curtain number, the flow rate and water-curtain distributed methods which are determined by the algorithm, can be compensated for the uncertainty of the controlled cooling parameters.

articleTitle: An integrated activity driven control system in CIMS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: CIMS is a highly sophisticated system that involves all of activities including engineering design and production and integrates them together. In the course of implementing CIMS, only when the integration of information and function or organization has been completed can the optimal goal of the system be achieved. The paper analyses a CIMS project in Shenyang Blower Works and presents a new approach to integrated activity driven control system (IACOs) that is responsible for managing and controlling all of activities throughout the CIMS. The framework of IACOs is proposed and its function is introduced. Meanwhile, a relative database, rule sets and control strategies are designed.

articleTitle: A genetic algorithms learning based fuzzified CMAC controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A genetic algorithms (GA) learning based fuzzified cerebellar model articulation controller (FCMAC), called GA-FCMAC, where the connecting weights of FCMAC are learnt and optimized by GA is presented in the paper. The GA-FCMAC is adapted to multi-input multi-output systems. The simulation results of a nonlinear inverted pendulum demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An application of real genetic algorithm to feature relation plan matching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Aimed to solving the feature relation plan matching problem in pattern recognition, a new optimizing algorithm based on the real genetic algorithm is proposed. The authors study in detail the possibility of using this algorithm; the steps of performing this algorithm are given. Consequently, a new idea for improving the efficiency of recognizing three-dimensional objects is suggested.

articleTitle: A sufficient optimality condition for piecewise C/sup 1/ extremal controls
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We give an exposition of a few aspects of our methodology for the general nonlinear optimal control in the piecewise C/sup 1/ case. We obtain a sufficient optimality condition for piecewise C/sup 1/ extremal controls by a first order partial differential equation, an optimization process and the Pontryagin principle. We express the optimal value function by Lie series. Finally, we present the application of this method in singular optimal control problems.

articleTitle: Initial state compensation of repetitive controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A design approach of the initial state of the repetitive controller is proposed in this paper. The approach makes full use of the feature of the digital controller and optimizes the transient response without perplexing the controller. A numerical example is presented to illustrate the validity of the approach.

articleTitle: New genetic-based approach to generate fuzzy rules from numerical data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Optimization of fuzzy logic controller by genetic algorithm is a very active research area. This paper develops a new genetic-based method to generate fuzzy rules from numerical data; the fuzzy rules and fuzzy membership functions can be optimized simultaneously in the algorithm. An application to truck backer-upper control is presented. The performance of this new method is compared with a non-optimized method, and shows that the new method has a better performance.

articleTitle: Model of MAS: supporting dynamic enterprise model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The advent of new enterprise paradigms of extended, virtual and agile enterprises presents new requirements on organizational concepts and supporting technologies. Inter- and intra-organizational relations need enterprise information systems (EIS) to support their establishment, deployment and discontinuation. This paper describes the model of multi-agent system (MAS) for supporting the dynamic enterprise model (DEM). It separates the business process from the organizational structure (organizational structure tier and business process tier), models each of them as MAS, and coordinates agents by "yellow page" mechanism. This model not only can regulate itself in terms of DEM, but also centers on the coordination strategies between the agents. It is believed that the model of MAS is a practical way to build flexible EIS.

articleTitle: Adaptive control of a class of nonlinear discrete-time systems with fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The goal of this paper is to design a discrete time adaptive fuzzy control system. The adaptive laws used to adjust parameters in the system are developed based on the Lyapunov synthesis approach. It is shown that the proposed fuzzy adaptive controller guarantees the tracking error, between outputs of considered system and desired values, to decay asymptotically.

articleTitle: Research on the spot pricing system of the plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Decision-making of the price is final benefit in the market competition of power supply industries. According to the operational flow of the electricity market the framework of the spot pricing system for the power industry is established. Based on the analysis of the system modules, the scheme of this pricing system software on the intelligent decision support system is presented. Finally, some advice are given on the practical implementation of this spot pricing system.

articleTitle: The research on overload control algorithms for SCP of intelligent network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: All the nodes in the intelligent network (IN) must have an overload control mechanism which protects the node by rejecting calls when the load on the node is overloaded. Two examples of IN services are: the service control point (SCP) which contains the service logic that is used to provide IN services; and the service switching point (SSP) which detects requests for IN services. The authors investigate the overload control mechanisms for the SCPs. To achieve an efficient control, the rejecting mechanisms are placed in the SSPs instead of the SCPs. It is stressed that the algorithms should be efficient and show fairness among a number of SSPs logically connected to the SCP. The results show that, to have fairness among the SSPs, the SCPs must control the acceptance rate.

articleTitle: Method and system for robot end effector path correction using 3-D ultrasound sensors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A method and system for correcting a preprogrammed robot end effector path to reduce the kinematic error are developed. The approach used in the method is to mount 3D ultrasound position sensor on the robot end effector and compute 3D Cartesian position of this sensor using 1D range measurements between the senders and an array of ultrasound receivers at fixed, predetermined positions. The method and system allow speedy correction of a robot path with economical usage of computer resources. The method includes steps of sensing and measuring path offsets between the idealized end effector location and the actual location of the manipulator end effector at a plurality of waypoints. Then, after appropriate calculations, the method includes the steps of correcting the coordinates of waypoints within the preprogrammed path, transforming the preprogrammed path coordinates into machine control coordinates, and providing a controller for the robot manipulator with such machine control coordinates. A 3D ultrasound position sensor used in the method provides low-cost, high precision measurements of the Cartesian position of a robot end effector within the robot workspace.

articleTitle: A prototype of fault diagnosis based on Petri nets
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A Petri net modeling tool using the object oriented method is introduced in this paper. With this tool, a Petri net-based prototype of fault diagnosis was developed using the model-based method. The prototype was connected to the database by DAO technique, and the firing mechanism and analytic methods of Petri net were used to form the DLL documents. Compared with the method of rule-based expert system, the Petri net-based one has the following advantages: 1) with direct knowledge representation; 2) with convenient knowledge storage in a form of mathematical matrix; and 3) making inference more quickly and effectively.

articleTitle: Combining qualitative simulation with functional labels for automated sneak circuit analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A new method of sneak circuit analysis (SCA) is presented based on qualitative simulation and functional reasoning. To provide a good intuitive model for qualitative reasoning, a way of qualitative representation of electrical resistance is put forward. Qualitative simulation is integrated with functional labels to deduce the actual functions achieved, providing necessary information for SCA. The result of an example shows that the method, compared with manual analysis, can greatly improve SCA efficiency as well as the degree of automation.

articleTitle: A study of mutual information in quantum information systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The mutual information in quantum information systems is defined by using the quantum compound state, and its fundamental properties with an application are studied.

articleTitle: A method of track's nonsmoothness detection based on wavelet transform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the study of the interrelationship between the railway carriage abnormal vibration and the track nonsmoothness, this paper detects track's vertical nonsmoothness by analysing the carriage's vibrating acceleration using the wavelet analysis. From the results of the wavelet transformation carried out on the real signals of railway carriage's vertical vibrating acceleration, it is concluded that track's vertical nonsmoothness can be detected by the approach.

articleTitle: H/sub /spl infin// control of discrete-time systems with norm-bounded uncertainties and time delay in state
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Studies the problem of H/sub /spl infin// control for discrete-time systems with norm-bounded uncertainties and time delay in state. The sufficient conditions for the existence of H/sub /spl infin// filters are derived in terms of a special kind of nonlinear matrix inequality P>g(P), which can be solved by a simple recursive algorithm. Moreover the design method of H/sub /spl infin// control is obtained. The advantage of this approach is that there may be the chance to select the gain K=h(P), where h(.) is a matrix function. The results of Song Seong-Ho and Kim Jeom-Keun (1998) is a special case of the main results in this paper. A numerical example is given to illustrate the main results.

articleTitle: A system theoretic foundation for blind system identification and estimation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Design and control of flexible transfer system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: A new algorithm for chaotic system identification based on self-organizing neural gas
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents a novel algorithm, called the self-growing neural gas network (SGNGN) method, for chaotic system identification. Combined with local linearization of the system state space, the proposed method can be applied to identify chaotic system or predict chaotic time series. Compared to the neural gas network, the SGNGN method allows the population of neurons to grow with the presentation of input vectors. Simulations results show that the proposed method can greatly accelerate the processing of convergence of weights.

articleTitle: Using chaos-parallel evolutionary programming to solve the flow-shop scheduling problem
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the paper, the chaos-parallel evolutionary programming algorithm is presented to solve the flow-shop scheduling problem. First, the individuals of each sub-population in the parallel evolutionary programming are found in the search space by use of the ergodicity properties of chaos states, then each sub-population evolves independently and the best individuals are exchanged between them periodically. Simulation results demonstrate that the new algorithm is efficient for optimizing large scale manufacturing process and the better results can be achieved on both the calculating time and optimizing rate.

articleTitle: EDA and ISP devices
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: On the basis of in-system programmability (ISP) logic devices, the paper discusses the application of ISP devices. The methods to use EDA and ISP devices is given by an example of a program generator.

articleTitle: Closeness theory based fuzzy ART model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A fuzzy ART neural network model based on the closeness theory, called CBFART, is introduced in this paper. It incorporates two concepts of the fuzzy set theory, the closeness and closet principle with the adaptive resonance theory (ART), to form a new neural network model. The model is characterized with a matching-consigning cycle, and classification of patterns in the network is followed by the closest principle. The complement coding, matching consigning, and fast learning-slow re-coding procedure work together to make sure that the learning of the network is converging and stable. The above three elements also make one shot learning to be practicable, so as to improve the learning speed of the network. The concrete algorithm of the model and the result of simulation are given, and an analysis shows that the model has a well clustering performance.

articleTitle: Preprocessing for handwritten Chinese character based on neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Introduces the entropy concept to a backpropagation neural network in order to improve its performance of classifying similar samples. Then, based on the neural network, we propose a thinning model for Chinese characters, and state its preprocessing methods, neural network architecture, learning algorithm and working algorithm. At the same time, we reform the conventional thinning process for Chinese characters in order to improve speed of processing. Finally, combining the nonlinear shape normalization methods and the reformed thinning process, an experiment on handwritten Chinese character preprocessing has been done to test the model, and obtain satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Research on the intelligence control for automotive semi-active suspensions using the multibody model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the shortcomings of traditional automotive dynamic models, a multi-rigid body model is built, the adaptive control strategy based on neural networks is put forward and the neural identifier and controller are designed in the paper. In order to improve the control effects, a compensating network is added to the control system. Simulation and experiment results show that adaptively controlled semi-active suspensions with nonlinear neural networks can achieve obvious vibration reducing effects.

articleTitle: Application of multi-decision model in selecting manipulative project
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper deals with a multi-decision model for selecting a manipulative project of control systems and processing synthetic analysis. The model performs an objective decision evaluation of engineering systems. It gives an analytic method on control systems, which can be applied to many kinds of manipulative projects on how to select the most excellent project.

articleTitle: Dynamic optimization mechanism analysis of evolutionary programming based on differential equation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the population and the conception of online/off-line performances, this paper develops a dynamic optimization differential equation model for exploiting and exploring the inherent operation mechanism of evolutionary programming. Theoretical and numerical results obtained show the correctness of the model, and some meaningful conclusions are given.

articleTitle: Design of stable fuzzy system based on LMI
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the simple description of a linear matrix inequality, a fuzzy controller to make a fuzzy closed loop system stable is given using the control toolbox of a linear matrix inequality combined with the stable condition of the fuzzy system. The simulation of an inverted pendulum shows this method is valid and simple.

articleTitle: Decentralized robust adaptive controller of modular stochastic control systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We study the decentralized robust adaptive tracking problem of control systems consisting of n modular subsystems with stochastic input terms. A nonlinear control scheme for stochastic linear control systems is proposed to design the direct adaptive controller for each modular stochastic subsystem. When the stochastic input terms satisfy some assumptions, we prove that the output tracking error of the closed-loop control systems is globally and asymptotically bounded and can be guaranteed to converge to within the precision prescribed in the actual problems. Finally, an efficient decentralized control algorithm is employed to solve a simulation example.

articleTitle: A low cost display, alarm and control circuit for distributed computer monitoring and control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Introduces the method of the low cost display, alarm and control circuit for a distributed computer monitoring and control system. This circuit has the characteristic of making full use of the hardware resource, flexibility and low cost. The method is not only useful for distributed computer monitoring and control system but also can be used for an intelligent instrument to reduce its cost and reduce its volume. The case study on a coalmine distributed computer monitoring and control system shows the high efficiency and low cost of this method.

articleTitle: The modeling and control of basis weight and moisture content
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Basis weight and moisture content are two important parameters of paper quality. We can preferably pledge quality of production, increase output, economize material, save energy sources through control the two parameters. Computer control system for controlling the basis weight and moisture content of paper machine has a very complicated configuration, much disturbance, and great pure lag. In this paper, we analyse the arts and crafts flow of the papermaking system, and model it using a Petri net. We have simulated the model and found it advantageous.

articleTitle: Fuzzy data association in multi-sensor multi-target tracking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Discusses a fuzzy data association method in multi-sensor multi-target tracking. First, the membership functions of the measurement number and estimation number are defined. Second we define the close degrees of the two fuzzy sets, which are used to construct a fuzzy model of data association. An emulator proves that this method has a good association result.

articleTitle: Multi-agent-based coordination in supply chain management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the concept and requirements of supply chain management in manufacturing enterprises, this paper emphasizes the importance of coordination in supply chain and introduces relative researches. On the basis of the multi-agent theory and its analysis method in distributed artificial intelligence, the paper presents a supply chain management framework, defines the agents' functions and responsibility and studies the contents, features and solutions of coordinated supply chain.
