Finally, the paper presents the software architecture to develop a coordination environment based on CORBA and KQML protocols.

articleTitle: The research on a single phase arc furnace adaptive control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper applies the pole assignment adaptive control algorithm to arc furnace electrode regulator system in order to improve the conventional arc furnace PID electrode regulator system. The simulation results show that adaptive control system has more advantages than the conventional PID either in dynamic characteristics or in resisting the arc length disturbance.

articleTitle: A heuristic for optimal job scheduling problem with a common due window on parallel and identical machines
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper is concerned with the job scheduling problem with a common due window. After giving an optimal algorithm for the single machine problem, a mathematical model for the similar problem on parallel and identical machines is presented. Because the job scheduling problem on parallel and identical machines, which may be NP-complete, is much more complex than that on a single machine, a heuristic algorithm is given to find an approximate solution after two important theorems are proved. The numerical example illustrates that the heuristic algorithm is very effective in obtaining a near-optimal solution.

articleTitle: DSS and business strategic decision making
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper focuses on the application of decision support systems (DSS) to top management level decision making for business development. It describes the experience of Chinese's telecommunication service enterprises in the development of decision making and the related emergence of information-based support organization for business operation, the information and decision support center. The paper offers an example of a decision support system. It also discusses the challenges encountered and lessons learned from the DSS example.

articleTitle: Design of automatic carrier landing system using H/sub /spl infin// control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the design of an automatic carrier landing system (ACLS) is accomplished using H-infinity techniques, in which the single input/output design specifications were translated into the weighting functions of the H-infinity synthesis problem. The objective of the design is to improve the ACLS's path precision under the worst-case condition of a vertical gust during carrier landing. The design yields a satisfactory response.

articleTitle: Two fuzzy cascade control schemes of a triple inverted pendulum
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Studies the mechanism of balancing a triple inverted pendulum and presents two fuzzy cascade control schemes to solve the curse of dimensionality in fuzzy multi-variable control. The first fuzzy cascade control scheme sets the cart position in the inner loop, while the second scheme sets the cart position in the outer loop. The two schemes can balance the triple inverted pendulum very well in simulation, and their strong and weak points are also compared.

articleTitle: Study on a novel hybrid adaptive genetic algorithm embedding conjugate gradient algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A hybrid adaptive genetic algorithm embedding conjugate gradient algorithm-conjugate gradient-adaptive evolutionary algorithm (CG-AGA) that combines the merit of the conjugate gradient algorithm is put forward in the paper. Compared with the conventional evolutionary algorithm, the new algorithm (CG-AEA) is more efficient in local searching, which is the major weak point of the conventional algorithm. Experiments have demonstrated the satisfactory speed and precision of CG-AEA.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic non-linearity compensation of sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: It is necessary to carry out the dynamic compensation for the sensor when its dynamic response speed is slow. Sometimes the effectiveness of dynamic compensation is not good because the dynamic characteristic of sensor is nonlinear. In order to resolve this problem, the dynamic nonlinearity compensation is studied in this paper. The dynamic nonlinearity compensating devices are designed using the FLANN, both the impulse and step responses of robot wrist force sensor are compensated, and good results are obtained. The dynamic nonlinearity compensation results are also compared with that of dynamic linearity compensation, which shows the dynamic nonlinearity compensation is effective.

articleTitle: Modeling and the simulation study of MPEG video traffic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Variable bit rate (VBR) MPEG video is a special VBR video traffic type with wide application future. However, MPEG video traffic characteristics are not understood very clearly. The paper introduces statistical analysis of MPEG video traffic based on our simulation experiments of real MPEG video traces. Also in the paper an MPEG VBR video model is proposed: composite Rayleigh autoregressive (RAR) model. MPEG VBR video simulation traffic can be generated by this model.

articleTitle: The application of intelligent fuzzy self tuning PID controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A kind of intelligent fuzzy self tuning PID controller is described in the paper. With step response information and an expert system the PID parameters can be adjusted adaptively online for varying state of the system. The results of simulation and real-time control show that the controller is effective and has more significant robustness.

articleTitle: Multilevel multi-agent based team decision fusion for mobile robot behavior control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Multilevel fusion is a key issue for developing the decision-making kernel of multi-agent systems. This article presents a formulation of predictive decision-making algorithm for multilevel multi-agent based team decision-making system with the I/O mode characterizations of features in decision methods. The sequential data fusion is conducted through a dynamic behavior modeling method capable of estimating the observed system parameters from the raw sensory measurements over a period of time. The method is implemented for an autonomous tracking system that consists of a target tracking agent whose inputs are visual and ultrasonic range measurements, and a collision avoidance agent whose inputs are ultrasonic range measurements. The experimental results conducted by a mobile robot and intelligent electrical wheelchair demonstrate the feasibility, accuracy and robustness of the system based on the multisensor fusion method.

articleTitle: Pole assignment for a class of second order coupled generalized system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The pole assignment problem of a second order coupled generalized system is discussed in Hilbert space. The solutions of the problem and the constructive expression of the solutions are given by the generalized inverse one of an operator.

articleTitle: Tracking of a moving interface during a 2D melting or solidification process from measurements on the solid part only
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The moving solid-liquid interface of a melting solid in a rectangular enclosure is identified from temperature and flux measurements performed on the cold side of the solid only. The lack of measurement in the liquid phase prevents the interface to be recovered by straightforward use of the direct Stefan solution. The identification of this melting front is an inverse problem that requires particular solution methods. An algorithm is used, based on a regularized least squares approach, that is extended to this nonlinear case by a predictive sliding horizon technique.

articleTitle: The modeling optimization, planning and execution of supply chain management in enterprises integration based on ARIS and SAP/R3
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The development trend of industry production management comes from information and process integration with enterprise integration. Supply chain management (SCM) is a big trend in enterprise integration. The paper presents the definition and the requirements of enterprise SCM and discusses the modeling method of SCM based on ARIS and the optimization, planning and execution of SCM based on SAP/R3. A real SCM example also is discussed and presented.

articleTitle: A fuzzy control algorithm to shape the output waveform of phase-controlled frequency converters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper is mainly devoted to the study of shaping the output waveform of phase-controlled frequency converters. Based on the fundamental principle of the two-variable control theory, a fuzzy control algorithm for improving the symmetry of the output waveform of the converter is proposed and, further, the corresponding firing pulse control is discussed. For comparison, the unimproved time constant table and the output waveforms are also included.

articleTitle: Develop of on-line instrument for measuring the winding temperature-rise of AC machines
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the online method of measuring the temperature-rise of AC machine windings based on resistance method is discussed. The method utilizing a DC circuit composed of a constant source, winding resistance, and standard sampling resistance gets the value of winding resistance through measuring the relevant signals. Compared to the traditional methods, this method is more accurate, its structure is simpler, and it has other benefits.

articleTitle: An optimal self-tuning PID controller considering parameter estimation uncertainty
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: For the tuning of PID controller parameters, two methods are presented in this paper to overcome the uncertainty of the parameter estimation, which are time-varying forgetting factor and model verification using correlation function. Then an optimization criterion is used for the self-tuning of the PID controller parameters. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the presented method.

articleTitle: A framework for adaptive control of virtual production systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Agile manufacturing (AM) requires manufacturing systems to be agile to react quickly to sudden and unpredictable changes in customer demand for their products and services. To meet with this requirement, a paradigm in which several virtual production systems (VPSs) are formed by organizing resources belonging to one or more manufacturing systems according to each individual customer ordered products is proposed in the paper. Since this paradigm combines the two resource structures, that is, functional and product-oriented ones, it can ensure a manufacturing system to be both flexible and easier to be controlled. Furthermore the structure of adaptive controllers of VPSs is presented based on the principle of adaptive control, and the four adaptive mechanisms are specified. The adaptive control can make a VPS to rapidly respond to disturbances and changes encountered during the production of a specific product. The coordination is set up among adaptive controllers of each individual VPSs to resolve conflicts for a shared resource and to optimize manufacturing systems globally.

articleTitle: Modeling capacity planning based on capacity utilization for SMT machine lines
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Models for equipment selection and schedule changeovers for multiple periods are developed. Because of high capital costs and short depreciation cycles for surface mount technology (SMT) placement machines, the target application for the paper, high capacity utilization, is the primary objective in solving the models. A solution procedure is presented for the described model, which first determines a rough set of machines to be added or removed for each machine-line, then applies a branch and bound heuristic to rough sets to obtain a near optimal solution to the problem.

articleTitle: Eigenstructure assignment and robust stable perturbation bounds of optimal control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: An effective method which assigns the closed-loop eigenvalues of linear quadratic (LQ) optimal control system in desired stable locations and which simultaneously selects those eigenvectors which satisfy a quadratic cost criterion with suitable weighting matrices is presented. The optimal feedback gain matrix is determined by means of a recursive method. Meanwhile, a robustness measure bound is introduced for this LQ state-feedback designs in the presence of perturbations, and bounds are obtained for allowable perturbations so that the resulting closed-loop system remains stable.

articleTitle: Improved crossover strategy of genetic algorithms and analysis of its performance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the premature convergence problem of genetic algorithms is analyzed from a point of view of the crossover efficiency, and a new crossover strategy is proposed to make the crossover more efficient. The strategy is effective in preventing incest and overcoming the premature convergence.

articleTitle: Self-learning fuzzy neural network and its application to fire auto-detecting in fire protection systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A fuzzy-neuro network architecture is proposed. An initial fuzzy knowledge base can be built by means of self-adaptive learning from historical data, fuzzy rules and system parameters can be optimized by online learning of the FNN via real-time data, which make the system possess distinguished adaptive features and self-learning capability. Taking fire auto-detecting in a fire protection system as application background, a series of experimental research has been carried out. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility of the neuro-fuzzy system.

articleTitle: Evolutionary algorithm for path planning of mobile robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A genetic path planning algorithm for a mobile robot is proposed. By building the location code based quadtree model (LCQT) of the environment, it is easy to get the codes of the paths. Furthermore, the authors apply the genetic algorithm to the path planning of a mobile robot and discuss several critical problems of implementation. The simulation results demonstrate that, the algorithm can find the optimal path efficiently under randomly shaped and complicated environments.

articleTitle: A novel intelligent coordination control system for a unit power plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the integration of neuron model-free controller with traditional PID controller, a novel intelligent control method is proposed for multivariable systems in this paper. This new control strategy not only retains the characteristics of the traditional PID, such as its simple structure and practicable control algorithm, etc., but also divorces the generation of control signal from the plant model. A PID controller is placed in each main input-output path. Between the PID controller and the controlled plant, a neural network composed of the model-free neuron is set up to compute the control signal according to the online learning from the system error and the outputs of each PID controller. The simulation test results show its good performances and strong robustness in a unit power plant with big uncertainties of the load. This new multivariable intelligent control method is very simple. The parameters of the controller can be chosen roughly. The method can be used conveniently in practice.

articleTitle: The effect of speed on error rate in wireless train control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The fast development of wireless communication technology makes it possible to transmit datum, used for train control between train and ground through radio. The key question is the reliability of wireless transmission, especially in a high-speed railway. We firstly analyze the characteristic of a wireless channel in a high-speed railway environment. After that we analyze the reliability of wireless transmission for high-speed train control, set up the channel model, analyze the effect of train speed on error rate, and give measures to improve the wireless link performance based on the channel property. At the end of the paper, we give the method for deciding if the error rate satisfies the requirement for high-speed train control.

articleTitle: Variable structure control for a class of fuzzy dynamics and its application to the design of autopilot for missile
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper presents the direct variable structure controller and fuzzy variable structure controller for a class of fuzzy dynamics. A linear parameter-varying (LPV) or nonlinear system is first represented by a fuzzy model, which consists of linear time-invariant systems at selected operation points. The variable structure control method is used to solve the controller design for each operation point and the direct variable structure controller for fuzzy system. The proposed methods were applied to the roll control channel in a missile where the plant was regarded as a LPV system, that is, the attitude and the velocity are variable. The simulation results show that the proposed controller performed well over the entire flight region.

articleTitle: A new evolved artificial neural network and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Describes an evolved artificial neural network that is evolved by the particle swarm optimisation (PSO) algorithm. Compared with previous evolved ANNs, both the architecture and weights of this ANN are evolved by PSO, it means that the network architecture is adaptively adjusted, then the PSO algorithm is employed to evolve the nodes of ANNs with a given architecture. This process is repeated until the best network is accepted or the maximum number of generations has been reached. Some techniques, such as partial training algorithm (PT) and evolving added nodes (EAN), are used to maintain a closer behavioural link between the parents and their offspring, which will improve the efficiency of evolving ANNs. An ANN evolved is used in modelling a product quality estimator for a fractionator of the hydrocracking unit in the oil refining industry. The results show that the evolved ANN has good accuracy and generalisation ability.

articleTitle: Notes on the convergence of genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper focuses on the convergence analysis of genetic algorithms, and an equation and explicit expressions are given for p/sup /spl infin//. The convergence of genetic algorithm with elitist model is proved in detail.

articleTitle: Direct adaptive fuzzy controller for hydraulic turbine generators
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A novel direct adaptive fuzzy control approach is proposed for the hydraulic turbine generator with complex dynamic characteristics and uncertainties. Based on the simplified Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy inference rule and the associative learning strategy of neural network for tuning the connection weights, an equivalent fuzzy neural network is given. The controller based on this fuzzy neural network can realize the adaptive fuzzy control law without modeling the plant. A series simulation test for a hydraulic turbine generator show that the control method presented not only has a simple design procedure and strong robustness, but also achieves good performances of the hydraulic turbine generator under difference work condition.

articleTitle: Application of extended Givens-Gentleman orthogonal transformation to robust estimation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The extended Givens-Gentleman orthogonal transformation is applied to robust estimation, the formulas are derived for posterior root mean square error and covariance matrix. The resolution of equivalent weights is discussed and the numerical stability is analyzed for the extended Givens-Gentleman orthogonal transformation. The research indicates that this algorithm resists the effect of gross errors with better numerical stability, and computes with small EMS memory in high speed.

articleTitle: Improvement to Frey's adaptive chaotic encoder
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Using the property that chaotic systems are sensitive to system parameters, an adaptive chaotic digital encoder with variable parameters is proposed which can jump among different chaotic systems at different times. More complexity and much better correlation properties can be achieved to meet secure communication applications. Simulation results and a comparison between the new one and Frey's adaptive chaotic digital encoder are also given, showing the performance of the new encoder.

articleTitle: Slab defect diagnosis and predicting system in CC processing based on rough set theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper discusses a method of using the rough set theory in a continuous casting (CC) slab defect diagnosis and predicting system. The knowledge representation system is used as a tool to unveil the redundancy. The results obtained show that the rough set theory is practical.

articleTitle: The online learning of fuzzy controller in pushing system of air-impact molding line
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: On the basis of analysis with the characteristics of pushing system of air-impact molding line, a new fuzzy control strategy based on the genetic algorithm (GA) and simulated annealing algorithm (SA) was presented. Based on a real run, a judger was used for online learning and testing of fuzzy control rules to determine which to enter into the inference engine, the fuzzy logic controller has been tested in the real plant and results obtained were shown.

articleTitle: A neural network based on mechanism model and it's application in prediction of rolling force
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A synthetic method of neural network and mechanistic modelling is presented. This method merges the mechanistic model knowledge with the neural network structure. It greatly reduces the number of weights of the network. The learning speed, nonlinear approximation precision and generalization performance of the network are improved. The effect of application in rolling force prediction is excellent.

articleTitle: A nonlinear model predictive control strategy based on dynamic fuzzy model using two-step optimization method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The dynamic fuzzy model implements a set of local dynamic models, identified by the least square method, to approximate the dynamics of a nonlinear process. The nonlinear predictive controller consists of a multi-step predictor based on a dynamic fuzzy model, an output optimizer and a robust filter. The output is optimized by two steps, the descent-gradient method first, and then a linear optimization. The robust filter with one adjustable parameter can resist the model mis-match and improve the transient performance. The simulation of pH neutralization process is given to demonstrate the better performance of the proposed control scheme compared with a conventional DMC controller.

articleTitle: Intelligent control and adaptation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: It is well known, the design of an intelligent control engineering system often applies a top-down strategy, which emphasizes centralized control. But for life systems and life-like systems, adaptation is an important property of such systems, and the description of a life system is a bottom-up strategy, which emphasizes a distributed system. From the view point of complexity, the adaptation property of a system emerges by interaction between subsystems of the system, as well as interaction between subsystems and environment. The difference between the concepts of control and emergence is briefly discussed.

articleTitle: Multivariable intelligent decoupling control and its applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Observer-based robust stabilization for uncertain time-varying delay systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The problem of robust stabilization for a class of uncertain time-varying delay systems is addressed. The considered system has uncertainties and delays in both state and control input, the admissible parameter uncertainties do not satisfy the matching condition. A sufficient condition is obtained that the uncertain time-varying delay system is robustly stabilizable via observer-based feedback controllers by linear matrix inequalities.

articleTitle: Performance analysis for distributed track fusion with feedback
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A rigorous performance analysis is dedicated to track fusion with feedback for distributed recursive state estimators of dynamic systems. It is shown that the track fusion formula with feedback is, same as the track fusion without feedback, exactly equivalent to the corresponding centralized track fusion formula. Moreover, the so called P matrices in the feedback Kalman filtering at both local trackers and fusion center are still the covariance matrices of tracking errors. Although the feedback here cannot improve the performance at the fusion center, the feedback does reduce the covariance of each local tracking error. The above results can be extended to a hybrid track fusion with feedback received by partial local trackers.

articleTitle: On multi-agent collaborative planning and its application in RoboCup
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The RoboCup soccer tournament is a very important research area within AI. This paper studies about some theoretical and technical issues of the application of a multi-agent collaborative planning theory to RoboCup. In this paper, a new theory of multi-agent collaborative planning is first discussed, then the framework of a multi-agent collaborative system based on the theory is proposed. Finally, the application of the framework to RoboCup and how machine learning can be integrated in the system are also studied in the paper.

articleTitle: Use of genetic algorithm in optimal orbit manoeuvre
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The application of genetic algorithm is discussed in the problem of minimum-fuel consumption orbit manoeuvre of spacecraft. First, the method of operation is introduced. Two examples are then given: one is soft-landing of a lunar probe from lunar satellite orbit to lunar surface; and the other is orbit manoeuvre of lunar probe from a selenocentric hyperbolic orbit to a selenocentric circular orbit. It is shown that the genetic algorithm has good convergence property and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Varied structure process and its control strategy. I. Control strategy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper shows that almost all of the large scale industrial control processes are variable structure processes, and dimensions of the controlled variables and manipulated variables are different and varied alone with the marketing and operating environments. The problems to control and optimize the variable structure process are discussed. The model predictive coordinated controls with multi-prediction horizon, multi-rate, multi-zone, multi-controller and nonlinear weighting are proposed. A variable structure predictive coordinated controller composed of the model based algorithm and rule based strategies is presented.

articleTitle: Study of self-learning method based genetic programming
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Appropriate symptom parameters used in the fault diagnosis expert system are not being selected fast and truly enough because the diagnosis knowledge of some of the diagnosed-objects is insufficient. In this paper the genetic programming is considered and used to self-reorganize the effective symptom parameters, a self-learning function of the system is achieved, and the precision and efficiency of diagnosis are improved. The obvious effect is proved by the experiment of fault diagnosis for the conic-form bearing.

articleTitle: Predictive control for a class of linearizable nonlinear system with input delay
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A recursive predictive controller is designed for a class of linearizable nonlinear systems with input delay based on geometric feedback-linearization and Smith prediction, which guarantees the stability of the closed-loop systems and effectively restrains the disadvantage caused by delay. The proposed method extends the Smith prediction of linear systems to that of nonlinear systems with input delay. The effectiveness of the presented method is demonstrated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Fuzzy admission control of customers to a three-workstation queueing network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: We consider a queueing network with two classes of customers and three workstations, each consists of one server and one buffer. One workstation is in the first stage and two parallel workstations in the second stage. Each workstation in the second stage receives customers from its own arrival stream. The buffer in the first stage consists of sufficient customers of both classes. A reward is earned whenever the first stage accepts a customer and a holding cost is incurred by a customer in the queue in the second stage. The objective is to dynamically select the class of customer to be next served at the first stage, based on the state of the system, so as to maximize the average benefit over an infinite horizon. In the paper, a fuzzy approach is presented to solve this complex problem. Simulation shows that the approach is efficient and promising.

articleTitle: Study of the modeling of hydroturbine generating set
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Recursive least square estimation (RLSE) is applied to the modeling of a hydroturbine generating set, their transfer functions are set up under three typical states: no-load; single machine with region load; and in a large-scale electric power system. By studying the obtained transfer functions, it is proved that the model for the real machine of the hydroturbine generating set in the no-load state is reasonable. The paper also analyzes the causes of error between the model simulation and the measured values of the state of the single machine with region load.

articleTitle: Research on obstacle avoidance method for evolutionary robot based on artificial neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Obstacle avoidance behavior learning of evolutionary robot is realized by the use of artificial neural network in this paper. First, a robot learning environment and a robot model are presented and the implementation of evolutionary learning system is discussed. Then, the simulation experiments are carried out for obstacle avoidance learning system of intelligent robot that adopted evolutionary learning mechanism. Finally, the simulation results are analyzed and the further research direction is given.

articleTitle: A meta-synthetic intelligent diagnosis system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In order to compensate the shortage of single expert system (ES) method and single artificial neural network (ANN) method in the intelligent diagnosis, the paper develops a relatively widely used diagnosis system which integrates the ES, ANN and "human mind". It has been applied successfully to an intelligent integrate power supply diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Intelligent fusion of redundant measurements of high accuracy attitude sensors on Spacecraft
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, an information fusion concept using redundant measurements obtained by high accuracy attitude sensors on a spacecraft is presented. This ensures attitude determination accuracy for the spacecraft by means of information fusion of redundant measurements obtained by different attitude sensors after autonomous failure diagnosis, location and reconfiguration of some attitude sensors, or fail-operation with graceful degradation.

articleTitle: Nonlinear adaptive decentralized stabilizing control of multimachine systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper describes a design approach to nonlinear adaptive control system with unknown parameters and applies it to the excitation control of power systems. The adaptive control strategy is formed by recursive method without involving transformation of linearization. The characteristic of the controller is that it involves a dynamic estimator of parameters. A general expression of nonlinear adaptive decentralized excitation control strategy for multimachine systems is acquired, in which all of the feedback variables are local measurements. Simulation results on a 6-machines, 22-buses system manifests the validity of the nonlinear adaptive controllers.

articleTitle: Decentralized memoryless robust control for uncertain interconnected systems with time delays
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The problem of decentralized memoryless robust control for a class of uncertain delayed systems with time delay is addressed by linear matrix inequalities and vector inequalities. The uncertainty in the system is value bounded and the system has delays in both state and control input. We present sufficient conditions for existence of decentralized memoryless robust stabilization, and, based on these conditions, the controller is presented. Then, by solving a convex optimization problem with constraints, the systematic methods for decentralized controllers with small feedback gain are presented and we can derive more practical and satisfactory decentralized memoryless robust controllers.

articleTitle: A system theoretic foundation for blind system identification and estimation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: Robust H-infinity controller with pole placement constrains in helicopter control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, the H/sub /spl infin// technique with pole placement constraints is used to design the CH-47 helicopter controller. The benefits from this are that the system not only has satisfied the H/sub /spl infin// requirement but also can force the closed-loop poles into a suitable sub-region of the left-half plan. It avoids over fast dynamic responses for digital implementation and has satisfied damping. In our design, the following problems are considered: How to choose the controller structure? How to design the weighting functions? Should the uncertainty be defined in the input or output? The paper gives the answers to these questions. The simulation results show that the system designed satisfies the ADS-33 requirement and robustness stability.

articleTitle: A new training algorithm for RBF neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, based on the study of RBFNN (radial basis function neural network) training algorithm and genetic algorithm, a new RBF NN training algorithm, the hybrid hierarchy genetic algorithm, is introduced by combining hierarchy genetic algorithm and least-square method. The hybrid algorithm greatly increases the training speed while is still able to determine the structure and parameter of an RBF from sample data The new training algorithm is used to identify and predict M-G chaos time series, and the simulation gives satisfied result.

articleTitle: A non-parametric design method for predictive control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The predictive controller design method proposed in the paper utilizes the finite impulse or step responses, also called system Markov parameters. Its implementation is discussed in detail through the re-design of the closed-loop observer based on the state-space method for predictive control. Compared to the conventional algorithms, such as DMC or MAC, it does not need to truncate the response series approximately to zero or a constant, which gives the computational advantages. Apart from that, it is liable to theoretic analysis, and the closed-loop stability is presented. Thus the proposed method not only keeps the virtues of the previous predictive controllers using non-parametric models, but it also has the features of wide applications and being suitable to theoretic analysis.

articleTitle: A rule based fuzzy-neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In order to solve the contradictions between the accuracy and the number of sub-spaces in general fuzzy systems, the paper proposes a rule based fuzzy-neural network. It uses several rules that describe the system's main characteristics, and represents the system to a certain degree. Finally, it completes creating the rules and refining the parameters.

articleTitle: Control system of a repeater for mobile communication using Intel 80196
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A digital-analog hybrid mobile repeater is introduced and manufactured. The control system of the repeater that is based on the high performance microcontroller Intel-80196 is of high security and supports remote operation and telemonitoring.

articleTitle: A study of the model of the multiobjective fuzzy process control on citric acid fermentation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In order to obtain the highest concentration of citric acid in the fermentation, a model of the multiobjective fuzzy process control is put forward. Also a series of rules determining the values of the control variables in this model, based on the records of citric acid fermentation, mathematical models from biotechnology scientists and experience of the engineers of the fermentation control, is set up and refined stepwise. To examine this model and these rules, experiments were conducted on a 1.5 m/sup 3/ fermenter. The results show that the citric acid concentration reaches 10.39% with the initial glucose concentration 11.30%, in comparison with the citric acid concentration 11.4% with the initial glucose concentration 14.2% in normal control on a 100 m/sup 3/ fermenter. The fermentation time is shortened from 70 hours (normal control) to 63 hours. The residual glucose concentration hits the lowest level 1.36%.

articleTitle: The management system of the special multimedia fiber industrial network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the characteristics of a fiber industrial network (FIN) that can transmit real-time video, voice and data signals more satisfactorily, we principally propose and analyze a feedback model and the layered architecture of its management system.

articleTitle: Application of parallel algorithms to control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: With scale-up and complication of the problems in engineering and technology, control theories are required to meet higher and higher demands. The rapid development of computer technology, especially the parallelization trend, provides new opportunities to the development of control theories. The paper discusses the necessity and prospective of the application of parallel algorithms to control, and illustrates the influence of parallel algorithms on control with the parallel algorithm of the solution to the inverse dynamics problem of six-DOF platform parallel manipulators.

articleTitle: Vapour temperature predictive control based on neuron prediction model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In accordance with the control characters of vapour temperature adjusting process, such as large time lag, large hysteresis and time varying parameters, etc., a kind of CAMIAX model of the process is suggested and the treatment of undetermined pure time lag is discussed. Based on the neuron learning mechanism, a kind of neuron identification algorithm of model parameters and the prediction model of the process are proposed. The predictive model combined with neuron controller constitutes vapour temperature loop control algorithm. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Optimum design and optimal control for hot strip mills control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The optimum design schemes on three subsidiary control systems are described: the hot strip mills subdivision progressive intelligent optimal control structure; tension composite optimal control system; and profile and thickness coordinating optimal control and temperature control based on the established velocity. Applying to the rolling state equation and quadratic model object functions, the optimum tactics in heating continuous rolling process for the closed loop optimum control of the plate shape and thickness coordination, the roll gap correction in the crossing process, the real-time estimation of roller convex degree, the optimum roller convex development and the optimum roll bending force determination, are discussed.

articleTitle: An improved generation algorithm for fractal patterns based on fuzzy stochastic iterated system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The general concept of an iterated function system is introduced and fuzzy theory is drawn into the iterated function system when the probability relative to each affine transformation is chosen, therefore the fuzzy probability is put forward as well as an improved generation algorithm of fractal patterns based on a fuzzy stochastic iterated function system. The algorithm adjusts the probability distribution of each affine transformation in the iterated function system by a fuzzy adjusting factor, thus it better controls the shape and density of the patterns of fractal attractors, and this has been well tested and verified by examples.

articleTitle: A optimal design of neural network control based on fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper presents an integrated design method of neural network control, which is based on the fuzzy logic and FCSP (fuzzy constraint satisfaction problem). The whole procedure is discussed and the proposed methodology is applied to the study of the neurocontrol of a factory boiler model as an illustration.

articleTitle: Offset of NURBS curves by genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new method which uses genetic algorithm to produce offsetting two-dimensional NURBS curves; a parameter optimization method is used for approximating offset curves. The objective function being minimized is the explicit summation of square of errors at sample point piecewise processing which yields valid profiles. The result shows that genetic algorithm is more efficient than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Periodic orbits and chaos in a class of discrete dynamic systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Regular and chaotic dynamics in an extensive class of discrete dynamical systems in the form x/sub n+1/=/spl mu/x/sub n//sup r/(/spl lambda//sub 1/x/sub n//sup k+/spl alpha//+/spl lambda//sub 2/x/sub n//sup k+/spl alpha/-1/+/spl middot//spl middot//spl middot/+/spl lambda//sub k/x/sub n//sup /spl alpha/+1/) were investigated, and consequently the work of May (1974), Chang (1981) and Hu (1982) had been extended to a general case.

articleTitle: Variable-domain hierarchical fuzzy control and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In the paper, a promising fuzzy control, a variable-domain hierarchical fuzzy controller (VDH-FC) is discussed. The simulation results show that the VDH-FC has improved the limitation of the simple fuzzy controller, enhanced the robustness and stationary performance of the system. It needs little computation and can be implemented easily and conveniently. It has a satisfying result when applied to industrial recycled water temperature control.

articleTitle: Equipment MIS in military industrial enterprises
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: With the advent of the information society, information technology is widely used in many fields. Especially in the military field, it has become a key factor in deciding the result of a war. The information system for equipment management in a military industrial enterprise is a specific application of the computer in equipment management. The paper, based on the requirement of equipment management, proposes the software framework of an information system for equipment management, and analyses the mathematical model for amending plans and realization of the model.

articleTitle: Adaptive higher-order nonlinear FIR filter prediction of spatiotemporal chaotic time series
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on the Volterra expansion of nonlinear dynamical system functions and the deterministic and nonlinear characterization of the chaotic signals, an adaptive higher-order nonlinear FIR (HONFIR) filter is proposed to perform prediction of spatiotemporal chaotic time series. The TDO algorithm is used to update the filter's coefficients. A higher-order nonlinear adaptive filtering scheme is suggested in order to track the current chaotic trajectory by using the preceding predictive error for adjusting filter parameters rather than approximating the global or local map of the chaotic series. Experimental results show that this adaptive HONFIR filter can be successfully used to predict spatiotemporal chaotic time series generated by a globally coupled map (GCM), a two-way coupled map (TCM) and a single-way coupled map (SCM).

articleTitle: Intelligent control and adaptation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: A system theoretic foundation for blind system identification and estimation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)

articleTitle: A knowledge discovery method and its industrial applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on rough set theory, this paper investigates a knowledge discovery method of data sets which have continuous attributes, and the main concepts of partition sets, lower-boundary and upper-boundary are presented. We also give an illustration of this method applied to breakouts prediction system for continuous casting machine. Another major part of this paper is to present a paradigm of knowledge discovery process in the industrial applications.

articleTitle: Switched bus in information system-principal and design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Two kinds of bus architectures are compared. Because of bandwidth limitation of shared bus, it is the bottle-neck of system's performance. Switched bus is more capable and scalable. In modem server and router, high-speed serial link and cross point switch is the current trend of technology. A prototype point-to-point 1.25 Bbps backplane is described, the BER of which is less then 1E-12.

articleTitle: The research of remote fault diagnosis system in manufacturing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Based on an analysis of the realization mode of remote fault diagnosis system in manufacturing, this paper introduced the general structure of remote fault diagnosis system in manufacturing thoroughly. The treatment is illustrated by the example of a Shanghai Volkswagen-oriented application in a Sino-German cooperative project.

articleTitle: Dynamic cooperation in intelligent large scale system control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: To deal with the discordance between the distribution and the collaboration demands in large scale control systems and the heterogeneity, autonomy and evolution nature of intelligent control systems, this paper proposes a dynamic cooperation scheme borrowed from the multi-agent theory. The scheme is illustrated through the control of a three tank pilot system.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for neural network architecture study
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The neural network architecture study is one of the most difficult tasks. This paper presents a new algorithm for feedforward neural network architecture using a systematic approach. This approach is based on rough set and knowledge representation of neural network. This algorithm can fix the optimal number of hidden layer units. This new algorithm is also tested in Chinese medicine practical projects. The results show that the new algorithm is of wide applicability for the study of neural network architecture.

articleTitle: The study of flapped fin service system of main/flapped fin stabilizer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper studies the control law of flapped fin service system in the joint control system of the main/flapped fin stabilizer. An LQ inverse design based on the pole placement method is used by means of the state feedback inverse design. The H/sup /spl infin// control theory is also adopted to design the flapped fin service system. The simulation results are given and contrasted with the result designed by the classical control theory. The advantages of the modern control theory are validated.

articleTitle: Study on dynamic recursive neural network structure and learning algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In order to solve the present problem of dynamic recursive neural network such as slow learning speed, low model accuracy and bad application result, several new dynamic recursive network are put forward based on its structure. The approach of neural network automatic design based on the integration of self-adaptive evolutionary strategy and improved backpropagation algorithm is also advanced to realize the rapid evolution of network structure, weights and self feedback parameter in the same time. The actual application of system modeling shows that the advanced dynamic recursive network and learning algorithm is feasible and perfect.

articleTitle: Stable linear d-step ahead predictors with periodic compensation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Linear prediction is a classical problem in time series analysis and system theory and has found a lot of practical applications. In this paper, a stability problem is identified in the design of d-step ahead linear predictors. To resolve the problem, a periodic compensation scheme is proposed which stabilizes the d-step ahead linear predictor and provides minimum amount of computation in implementation of the predictor.

articleTitle: The boiler steam temperature fuzzy-adaptation PI control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Because the boiler steam temperature control has strong dynamic delay and inertia and time-varying nonlinear property, fuzzy-adaptation PI control plan is used. Simulation results show that the control system has better performance and stronger adaptive capability than the conventional control plan. It can raise its robustness and has small capacity for counting. The time suitability of the control system can meet the demands of the operating process.

articleTitle: Research on fuzzy control strategy of burning system of oil-lean burnt boiler
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The primary fuel of the lean-burnt oil boiler is residuum oil. Fuel burning is influenced by factors such as quality, pressure, temperature of the oil and fluctuation of load. As a result the burning system of the lean-burnt oil boiler is a complex controlled object with the characteristics of large detention and strong disturbance. An accurate mathematical model is difficult to construct. In this paper, the fuzzy control strategy for the oil lean burnt system is presented, and the "fuzzy+PI" double model control method and the fuzzy self-optimizing algorithm of boiler temperature are adopted. Neither a precise mathematical model of the controlled object, nor a complex instrument is required. The parameter is modified, improved and adjusted in the control process, making the furnace to burn steadily. Practical operation indicated that this control strategy is robust. The stability and efficiency of the boiler burning system are also improved.

articleTitle: Study of intelligent thermometer for aluminum production
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Studies a method to determine the temperature of aluminum production and introduces the system of an intelligent temperature measurement meter for an aluminum production cell, which was mainly made up of 80C31, 81C55, 28C64, AD521 and 14433. We measured the temperature in aluminum electrolyte and analyzed the processes of the temperature rising of a thermocouple, obtained a mathematical model by the heat transfer rule, and made the program appropriate to the hardware. Experimental results show that the relative error between the intelligent measurement and the ordinary one is less than 0.5%, and the lifetime of the thermocouple is much longer, so the thermometer we designed is valuable in aluminum production.

articleTitle: The self-adjusting intelligent fuzzy control system to superheated steam temperature in monoblock unit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The self-adjusting intelligent fuzzy control system proposed in the paper is based on the hominine control rules of fuzzy control, and the analytics are adopted to describe fuzzy control rules. In addition, the intelligent weight function is introduced in the design of the fuzzy controller. A group of membership functions are inducted for achieving self-adjusting ability of the fuzzy controller. This method is applied in the cascade system of the superheated steam temperature of the monoblock unit. The simulation results show the good clarity, robustness and resistance for varying parameters.

articleTitle: An efficient approach to reduce search space of capacity planning for PWB assembly system: deterministic demand
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A model of production assignment (PA) planning and equipment changeover scheduling (ECSP) for printed wiring board (PWB) assembly systems at the aggregate level is developed. In the described model, three kinds of equipment changeover methods, i.e. adding machine, removing machine and transferring machine, are involved. Since the ECSP model is a large-scale integer-programming problem, two approximate solution approaches for single period problem are described, which will provide a search space for finding a solution to the multiple-period problem. Computational experiments confirm the conclusions.

articleTitle: The exploitation of simulation system of hot strip mill based on client/server system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper introduces the idea of designing a simulation system of hot strip mill based on client/server and the structure and functions of the system. Then the realization of the system is addressed, which includes the realization of the process level simulation computer, the model simulation computer and data communications as well as the key technique used.

articleTitle: Construction of state space in RoboCup
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Machine learning has been widely applied to deal with problems in complex environments such as RoboCnp which is an ideal platform for research on AI and robotic. However, there are some very challenging problems in completing the machine learning in such a complex environment. One of them is how to construct an appropriate state space, which should have two main features to well describe the main characters of the environment states and to be small enough to be processed by ANN, RL, or other methods. In this paper, a new method to construct an appropriate state space in the complex environment is proposed, which fit the above two requirements. The authors also have completed a sample state space to describe the middle field situation in RoboCup simulation game, which can be used to do the route decision in RoboCup.

articleTitle: Application of a new fuzzy neural controller in electric touch quickly heated process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The benefits of fuzzy control and neural network control are discussed. A quick learning control algorithm is given. The controlled object has movement characteristics and quickly-varying parameters. Good control effects are obtained. In control solution space, fuzzy control is used for quick primary partition, then neural network control to get the precise control. It gets successful application in electric touch quickly heated industrial process, and show its good control property and application value.

articleTitle: The combination of genetic algorithms and neural networks used for estimating the LCC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The necessity and feasibility of combining the neural network (NN) with genetic algorithms (GAs) are first discussed, and the notion of using the three-layer feedforward NN as the representation method of genetic and the search technique is then introduced. Finally, the combination of GAs and NN was used to estimate the cost for equipment ordering. The results obtained show that the genetic and backpropagation algorithms improved the capability of fast learning NN and avoided the local minimum numerical value.

articleTitle: An expression method of user-oriented flexible features model and its applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Presents a flexible feature model, introduces its structure and components, and gives the expression instances of the model. This model uses an object-oriented method, and effectively encapsulates constraints methods in the data-structure from which the general processing object program is separated. This model can effectively express two-dimension complex shape features, support online expansion and allow the final user to interactively generate the features. Some applications are given.

articleTitle: An adaptive neural-control scheme based on optimum method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: For unknown nonlinear systems, a new adaptive control scheme based on a neural network is proposed. It combines a neural network with optimum method and makes the output of plants follow the desired output very well. A control algorithm is deduced for SISO systems and MIMO systems respectively. The simulation results have verified the effectiveness of these algorithms.

articleTitle: Chaotic control of a nonlinear continuous-time system with uncertainty
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Chaotic control of a nonlinear oscillator in the presence of model uncertainty in all parameters is investigated. Control compensation is incorporated into the design of the Lyapunov-type control and makes the control system robust. Simulation demonstrates the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Fuzzy controller on generalized distance and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: To reduce the complexity of designing a fuzzy controller, and the difficulty of obtaining the rules from the analysis of the control decision table, this paper presents the concept of generalized distance, then designs a fuzzy controller based on this concept. Simulation on thermal energy engineering plant with big inertia and big time delay, and an application, show that this controller has good robustness and high steady precision.

articleTitle: Approximation of C/sup 1/ functions and their derivative functions by SISO linear T-S fuzzy systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A class of SISO T-S fuzzy systems named as linear T-S fuzzy systems, which employ linear functions of input variable as rule consequent are investigated. On condition that the input fuzzy sets are consistent we proved that linear T-S fuzzy systems are capable of approximating C/sup 1/ function and its derivative function to any degree of accuracy simultaneously.

articleTitle: On line moving obstacles avoidance by velocity potential field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper describes an online obstacle avoidance approach following the idea of potential field. By building a velocity potential field the method uses relative velocity information. It provides the mobile robot with a more efficient motion in a dynamic world with moving obstacles. It can also be used as a distributed algorithm applied to the cooperative avoidance motion of multiple mobile robots.

articleTitle: The real-time prediction algorithm for ultrasonic P/O transducers' VR interface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The measurement of position and orientation (P/O) is an important study area in VR technology, 3D ultrasonic P/O transducers have been widely used in this aspect for its low cost high precision and simple algorithms. But for environment influence and TOF (time of flight) of ultrasound waves, the results of measurement are discontinuous and time-delayed, so they can not be used as feedback signals for control. An improved Kalman filtering algorithm is offered for real-time prediction of the measured object in this paper. As a result, the algorithm also can be used to eliminate measurement errors influenced by the environment.

articleTitle: An improved B-spline fuzzy-neural network controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper proposes an improved B-spline networks in order to increase the ability of rejecting the disturbance when it is as a fuzzy-neural network controller in real applications. By pointing out the shortage existed in the conventional B-spline function as the fuzzy membership function, the paper proposes the relevant improved method in such way as both to satisfy B-spline features, and also avoid system unstable factors. The actual experiments for a DC motor speed control system verify the effectiveness and practicability. The paper gives out the design procedure and the experiment results of the improved B-spline networks.

articleTitle: State observer and robust control for delay systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper considers the existing problems of state observer and the observer-based robust control problems for delay systems. The Lyapunov function method is applied through the paper. For a linear delay system, the necessary and sufficient condition for the system exists linear state observer is presented, and the observer-based robust controller design method is given. For nonlinear uncertain delayed system, the sufficient conditions for the system with linear and nonlinear state observers is presented respectively. The uncertainty which satisfies the Lipschitz condition and the corresponding observer-based robust controller design method are obtained.

articleTitle: Research on control of network system with Markov delay characteristic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Contraposing to the stochastic transfer delay inherently existing in the control network, a novel control mode is proposed, which implements the modeling of the network control system with multi-step stochastic transfer delay. It is proved that under this control mode, the transfer delay possesses Markov characteristic. Also the method calculating the corresponding Markov state transition matrix is given. Based on the obtained mathematical model, utilizing Markov chain theory, the stochastic optimal control law satisfying the pre-specified performance index is obtained. At the same time, a necessary condition guaranteeing the final mean square stability of the closed system is presented. Simulation at the end of the paper shows the correctness and the validity of the proposed theory.

articleTitle: Internet-based remote diagnosis: concept, system architecture and prototype
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper proposes a new diagnostic system framework about Internet-based remote diagnosis system (IRDS). The IRDS's meaning, specific properties, basic functions, system composition and work models are introduced. A computing model based on a three-layer structure is presented also. In the model, the diagnostic network is realized with the embedded Web nets, and the remote diagnostic reasoning engine (RDE) is constructed by two methods: knowledge-based RDE and Java Applet-based BNN RDE agent. An IRDS prototype has been constructed to realize the framework effectively.

articleTitle: Data visualization and knowledge visualization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper implements the data visualization and knowledge visualization with color, shape, graphics, et al., in the framework of the distributed knowledge discovery system CGRKD, which was developed based on the characteristics of Crop Germplasm Resource Database, namely, large volume, high dimension, complicated relations, uncertain and incomplete concept.

articleTitle: What is the minimum function observer order
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The design of minimal order observer which can estimate the state feedback control signal Kx(t) with arbitrarily observer poles and K, has been tried for years, with the prevailing conclusion that it is an unsolved problem. This paper asserts for the first time, that this design problem can be simplified to a set of linear equations K=K/sub z/diag{c:, ..., c/sub r/}D, with D fully determined and other parameters completely free, and where r is the observer order. This paper also asserts that only this set of linear equations can provide the unified upper bound of r, min{n, v:+...+v/sub p/} or min {n-m, (v:-1)+..(v/sub p/-1)}, for strictly proper or proper observers respectively, where n, m, p, and v: (i=1, ..., p) are the plant order, number of outputs, number of inputs (state feedback signals), and descending order observability indexes, respectively. This upper bound is lower than all other existing ones and is the lowest possible general upper bound.

articleTitle: Analysis of the chaotic phenomena in permanent-magnet synchronous motors based on Poincare map
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: A numerical algorithm of a Poincare map is proposed in the paper. Based on the proposed mathematical model of a permanent-magnet synchronous motor, the chaotic phenomenon of a PMSM is analyzed by means of a Poincare map. From the simulation, the Poincare map of the PMSM can concisely exhibit its dynamical behavior. Thereafter, the existence of chaos in PMSM is proved.

articleTitle: Stabilizing fuzzy controller design for uncertain time-delay systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The problem of designing a stabilizing fuzzy controller is studied for a class of continuous time-delay systems with norm-bounded time-varying parametric uncertainty. Based on the fuzzy model of the controlled system, sufficient conditions are first derived for the existence of fuzzy controllers, then a design procedure and a parametrized representation of the stabilizing fuzzy controller is given in terms of the feasible solutions to a certain linear matrix inequality.

articleTitle: Optimum 3D fixture layout design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: Fixture layout is the fundamental task of fixture design, to determine the number, type, and location of the basic fixturing elements of locators, supports, and clamps, as opposed to the detailed design of the fixture assembly. This paper describes an approach based on a novel technique of optimal pursuit to the layout problem. The focus of the paper is on effective fixture modeling and efficient numerical techniques for automatically generating, analyzing, and optimizing fixture layout designs for any complex-shaped 3D workpieces.

articleTitle: Study on PI controller based on single neuron for DC variable speed system in mechanical vibration device
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: The paper proposes a single neuron PI controller based on the characteristics of the DC variable speed system in mechanical vibratory stress control and vibration welding processes. The neural speed controller is designed for DC variable speed system that has resonant load. Simulation experiments and real-time control results show that the effectiveness of this control system is satisfactory. The system has not only good dynamic and static performance, but also high robustness and adaptive ability, and it is very suitable for real-time control.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of a wrist force sensor in the time and frequency domains
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: This paper studies the dynamic nonlinear characteristics of a multi-axis wrist force sensor in the time and frequency domains. The dynamic nonlinearity are analyzed, and the dynamic mathematical models of the multi-axis wrist force sensor are developed. In the frequency domain, when the input is a non-Gaussian signal, the solution of the quadratic nonlinear transfer function is given. In the time domain, a dynamic nonlinear modeling method is proposed based on the functional link artificial neural network. The paper describes accurately the dynamic characteristic of the multi-axis wrist force sensor, and provides a reliable basis for correcting the dynamic nonlinearity. The methods presented in the paper can be applied to the dynamic nonlinear researches of other sensors and measuring systems.

articleTitle: Research of the dissimilation strategy for MEBML
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: MEBML, mind-evolution-based machine learning mainly consists of similar taxis and dissimilation operators. Especially, the dissimilation strategy has important effects on the evolution efficiency and global optimality. In the paper, five dissimilation strategies based on the analysis of effects of the dissimilation operator in MEBML and the dissimilation mechanism. Finally, comparisons of these dissimilation strategies are made through the example of a global optimization problem.

articleTitle: Parallel training algorithm of BP neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: As the training process of backpropagation neural networks converges slowly and immerses in local vibration frequently, an algorithm named the parallel training algorithm is proposed, which is based on the master/slave model and training learning samples in each search subspace at the same time. The experiment results show that this algorithm converges at high rate and reaches global minimum quickly.

articleTitle: Composite control of a gyro mirror line-of-sight stabilization platform-design and auto-tuning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 3rd World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.00EX393)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a composite control scheme for a gyro mirror line-of-sight stabilization system. It comprises of an adaptive controller augmented with a variable structure (VS) to remain efficient in the face of modeling errors and extraneous disturbances. Under an adequate selection of control parameters, the control scheme guarantees an asymptotically stable closed-loop response. An automatic tuning method is developed for the proposed control scheme which explicitly uses inherent properties of the control structure for tuning purposes. Simulation results are provided to illustrate the operational principles of the proposed scheme and to demonstrate its viability in real practical applications.

articleTitle: Automatic error detection and correction approach in Chinese text based on features and learning
